AI.result: 多智能体方法在自动评估和人工评估中均优于直接提示(Direct Prompting)基线方法；实验揭示了在协调动画、旁白和视觉强调方面仍存在持续性挑战。
AI.conclusion: DataReel基准能够系统性地评估模型生成动画数据视频故事的能力；多智能体框架虽然有效，但在协调动画、旁白与视觉强调的同步方面仍有改进空间；数据集已开源发布以促进该领域研究。

title: Can Code Evaluation Metrics Detect Code Plagiarism?
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, accepted at LEARNER 2026 workshop (associated with EASE 2026)
summary:
Source Code Plagiarism Detection (SCPD) plays an important role in maintaining fairness and academic integrity in software engineering education. Code Evaluation Metrics (CEMs) are developed for assessing code generation tasks. However, it remains unclear whether such metrics can reliably detect plagiarism across different levels of modification (L1-L6), increasing in complexity.
  In this paper, we perform a comparative empirical study using two open-source labelled datasets, ConPlag (raw and template-free versions) and IRPlag. We evaluate five CEMs, namely CodeBLEU, CrystalBLEU, RUBY, Tree Structured Edit Distance (TSED), and CodeBERTScore. The performance is evaluated using threshold-free ranking-based measures to assess overall, per dataset, and per-level plagiarism performance. The results are compared against state-of-the-art (SOTA) Source Code Plagiarism Detection Tools (SCPDTs), JPlag and Dolos.
  Our findings show that without preprocessing, Dolos achieves the highest overall ranking performance, while among the individual metrics, CrystalBLEU, CodeBLEU, and RUBY outperform JPlag. Performance is strongest at L1 and drops from L4 onward, while CrystalBLEU remains competitive on L6. With preprocessing, CrystalBLEU surpasses Dolos overall. Per dataset, Dolos achieved the best ranking on the ConPlag raw dataset, while CrystalBLEU was the best-performing metric on the remaining datasets. At the plagiarism levels, Dolos remains strongest on L4, while Crystal-BLEU leads most of the remaining difficult levels. These results indicate that CEMs are comparable to dedicated tools in terms of ranking metrics.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对比实验评估了5种代码评估指标在源代码抄袭检测中的表现，发现CrystalBLEU等CEMs在预处理后性能可超越专业检测工具，且在复杂修改等级（L6）上仍保持竞争力，证明了CEMs作为抄袭检测工具的可行性。
AI.motivation: 源代码抄袭检测（SCPD）和代码评估指标（CEMs）已被广泛研究，但CEMs在检测不同修改复杂度等级（L1-L6）抄袭方面的可靠性尚未明确。
AI.method: 采用无阈值排序评估方法，在两个开源标注数据集（ConPlag和IRPlag）上评估5种CEMs，与两种SOTA工具进行对比实验，并分析预处理效果。
AI.result: 无预处理时Dolos整体表现最优，CrystalBLEU/CodeBLEU/RUBY优于JPlag；L1性能最强，L4后性能下降，但CrystalBLEU在L6仍具竞争力。预处理后CrystalBLEU超越Dolos；ConPlag raw数据集上Dolos最佳，其余数据集上CrystalBLEU领先。
AI.conclusion: CEMs（CrystalBLEU、CodeBLEU、RUBY等）在排序指标上与专用SCPD工具（JPlag、Dolos）具有可比性，可作为代码相似性检测的有效替代方案。

title: SAFEdit: Does Multi-Agent Decomposition Resolve the Reliability Challenges of Instructed Code Editing?
comment: Accepted to the EQUISA (Evaluation of Qualitative Aspects of Intelligent Software Assistants) workshop at EASE (Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering) 2026
summary: Instructed code editing is a significant challenge for large language models (LLMs). On the EditBench benchmark, 39 of 40 evaluated models obtain a task success rate (TSR) below 60 percent, highlighting a gap between general code generation and the ability to perform instruction-driven editing under executable test constraints. To address this, we propose SAFEdit, a multi-agent framework for instructed code editing that decomposes the editing process into specialized roles to improve reliability and reduce unintended code changes. A Planner Agent produces an explicit, visibility-aware edit plan, an Editor Agent applies minimal, literal code modifications, and a Verifier Agent executes real test runs. When tests fail, SAFEdit uses a Failure Abstraction Layer (FAL) to transform raw test logs into structured diagnostic feedback, which is fed back to the Editor to support iterative refinement. We compare SAFEdit against both prior single-model results reported for EditBench and an implemented ReAct single-agent baseline under the same evaluation conditions. We used EditBench to evaluate SAFEdit on 445 code editing instances in five languages (English, Polish, Spanish, Chinese, and Russian) under varying spatial context variants. SAFEdit achieved 68.6 percent TSR, outperforming the single-model baseline by 3.8 percentage points and the ReAct single-agent baseline by 8.6 percentage points. The iterative refinement loop was found to contribute 17.4 percentage points to SAFEdit's overall success rate. SAFEdit's automated error analysis further indicates a reduction in instruction-level hallucinations compared to single-agent approaches, providing an additional framework component for interpreting failures beyond pass or fail outcomes.

AI.tldr: SAFEdit是一个多智能体框架，通过Planner、Editor和Verifier的协作，以及Failure Abstraction Layer实现的迭代优化，在EditBench上达到68.6%的任务成功率，显著优于单智能体方法，并有效减少了指令级幻觉。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型在指令引导的代码编辑任务上表现不佳，EditBench基准测试中40个模型里有39个任务成功率低于60%，说明通用代码生成与可执行测试约束下的指令驱动编辑之间存在显著差距。
AI.method: SAFEdit框架将代码编辑过程分解为三个专业化角色：(1) Planner Agent生成显式、可见性感知的编辑计划；(2) Editor Agent执行最小化、字面性的代码修改；(3) Verifier Agent执行真实测试。当测试失败时，Failure Abstraction Layer (FAL)将原始测试日志转换为结构化诊断反馈，反馈给Editor进行迭代优化。
AI.result: 在5种语言(英/波/西/中/俄)、445个代码编辑实例上评估，SAFEdit达到68.6%任务成功率，比单模型基线提升3.8个百分点，比ReAct单智能体基线提升8.6个百分点。迭代优化循环贡献了17.4个百分点的成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: SAFEdit有效减少了指令级幻觉，其自动化错误分析能力为理解失败原因提供了超越通过/失败二元结果的解释框架。

title: Contrastive Image-Metadata Pre-Training for Materials Transmission Electron Microscopy
summary: The vast majority of transmission electron microscopy (TEM) data never gets published and ends up on a backup drive until deleted to free up space. These left-over datasets are rich in detail and variation, often paired with automatically saved metadata of instrument state and acquisition parameters. In this work, we introduce a dataset of 7,330 high-angle annular dark-field scanning-TEM (HAADF-STEM) images from a single instrument to learn a joint embedding space between image metadata and HAADF image. These embeddings link image style with acquisition parameters, which allows us to train a generative style transfer network that can convert experimental images into the style they would have had if they were recorded with different instrument parameters. We evaluate the performance of the network and explore the usefulness of the technique for physical denoising.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 7,330 对来自单台 Titan 显微镜的 HAADF-STEM 图像及其七维采集元数据，并提出 CLIP 风格的 Contrastive Image-Metadata Pre-training (CIMP) 联合嵌入模型，在留出集上取得 84.4% 的跨模态 Top-1 检索率；七个物理参数均可从冻结的 128 维视觉嵌入经 Ridge 线性探针反演（平均 R²=0.69）；进一步以该嵌入作为 FiLM 条件训练元数据条件化风格迁移 GAN，将其用于"虚拟提升驻留时间与束流"的物理感知去噪，在 5 位实验显微学家的盲测 486 次评判中以 70.2% 的比例优于当前 SOTA 的 Noise2Void 基线。
AI.motivation: 透射电镜（TEM）的极限已从空间分辨率转向剂量效率：低电子剂量可避免样品损伤，但产生严重噪声，而由于拍摄干净参考图本身会损伤样品，低剂量图像不存在真值。与此同时，材料仪器正走向自主（闭环）实验，要求表征能够"落地"到采集时的显微镜物理状态。作者指出，TEM 实验中超过 90% 的数据因探索性调参而从未发表，最终躺在备份硬盘上被删除；这些数据伴随仪器自动保存的采集元数据，却因数据共享文化缺失而几乎不被利用（既有公开数据集如 Sytwu 等 2023 的 407 张 HRTEM、Atomagined 模拟集、25 万张多切片模拟集等规模小或为合成数据，缺少真实图像与丰富仪器元数据的配对）。因此需要一个连接图像内容与仪器参数的编码器，使表征既支撑低剂量去噪，也支撑自主实验与交互式操作。
AI.method:
**数据集**：7,330 张 HAADF-STEM 图（256×256 至 4096×4096，83% 为 2048×2048），来自某匿名材料研究实验室的 Titan 仪器，覆盖 30+ 材料体系、130+ 样品（以 Pt/CeO2、Pd/ZrO2、Ru/TiO2、In2O3/ZrO2 等异质催化剂为主，含原位反应气）。每图配七维元数据：像素尺寸、驻留时间、束流会聚角、束流电流、探测器增益、探测器偏置、内收集角。像素尺寸/驻留时间/会聚角/束流电流取 log10 后 z-score；其余为量纲连续量。额外采集"评估序列"（同一区域快速连拍、单参数扫描 dwell/gain/offset），仅用于定性对比、不参与训练；数据以 CC-BY-4.0 发布。

**CIMP**：CLIP 式对称 InfoNCE 损失，视觉编码器输出 L2 归一化 128 维嵌入 f_i，元数据编码器（3 层 MLP，宽 256）输出 L2 归一化 128 维嵌入 g_j，相似度为余弦；温度 τ 可学习（初始化 0.1）；1000 epoch 训练。数据增强：16-bit 归一化到 [0,1]、每 epoch 随机 256×256 裁剪、0.5 概率水平翻转、随机 90° 倍数旋转；训练/验证按源图分层划分为 6,597/733，避免同源裁剪跨分割导致记忆。结构搜索覆盖 4 种图像骨干（ResNet-18、从头训练 ViT、ImageNet 预训练 ViT 端到端微调、冻结 ViT）、4 种 batch size（128–1024）、5 种元数据编码器宽度（64–1024）、4 种裁剪尺寸；最终采用从头训练的 ResNet-18（单通道输入）+ 256×256 裁剪 + batch 512 + 3 层宽 256 MLP。

**下游风格迁移 GAN**：U-Net 生成器，通过 FiLM 层在多尺度上用冻结 CIMP 元数据编码器输出的源嵌入 e_id 与目标嵌入 e_tgt 条件化；四项损失为 LSGAN 判别损失 + 循环一致性 LPIPS（λ1=0.3）+ 恒等 LPIPS（λ2=0.1）+ 输出嵌入与 e_tgt 的 L2 嵌入损失（λ3=1.0）。选择 GAN 而非 Palette 扩散/流匹配的原因是：需要单次前向推理（快于采集帧率）、无需配对源-目标数据、小数据集上训练稳定、且可与多任务 LPIPS 目标整合。

**评估**：跨模态检索 Top-1/5/10；冻结视觉嵌入上逐维 Ridge 线性探针（α=1.0）反演元数据（报告 R² 与反解回物理单位后的 SMAPE，2000 次 bootstrap）；风格迁移用验证集元数据打乱后的目标嵌入与输出嵌入余弦相似度；用三组真实评估序列做逐对 SSIM/PSNR/LPIPS 与"未处理基线"对比；KID 分布真实度（含内容间隔下限 0.189 与噪声下限 3e-4）；去噪用无参考指标（梯度相关、边缘能量比、三个频段的 PSD 比值）；并做 5 位实验显微学家的盲测（三元组 raw / Noise2Void / CIMP-GAN）。
AI.result: 1) **检索**：CIMP 在留出验证集上 Top-1 = 84.38%、Top-5 = 96.88%、Top-10 = 98.44%；ImageNet 预训练 ViT 端到端微调（82.8%）不及从头训练的 ResNet-18，说明需要 HAADF-STEM 专属图像先验。2) **元数据可恢复性**：七维全部可从冻结 128 维嵌入线性解码——增益 R²=0.84（SMAPE 5.3%）、偏置 0.80（9.2%）、驻留时间 0.78（28.4%）、像素尺寸 0.72（41.8%）、束流电流 0.65（34.6%）、会聚角 0.53（13.0%）、内收集角 0.49（9.5%），平均 R²=0.69、平均 SMAPE=20.3%；动态范围大的 log 空间维度因重新指数化误差被放大。对比目标从未直接监督任何元数据数值，表明对比式图像-元数据对齐会自发产生物理对齐的因子化表征。3) **风格迁移**：正确配对与错误配对的余弦相似度差达 0.523；在三组真实评估序列上，CIMP GAN 输出与真实参考的 SSIM/PSNR/LPIPS 与"未处理图直接对比"的基线差异极小（SSIM <0.02、PSNR <1.3、LPIPS <0.05），说明模型引入的变化量与真实相邻采集的自然差异相当；KID 相对真实评估集为 -0.016±0.009（分布几乎重合），相对训练集 0.185 与内容间隔下限 0.189 在一个标准误内一致，表明 0.19 的差距源于内容分布偏移而非模型伪影。定性上增益变化预测正确但未建模探测器裁剪的边界条件，dwell 增加会额外导致背景变亮（实验序列中不存在），offset 迁移最弱（训练集中 offset 多样性不足）。4) **去噪**：CIMP GAN 边缘能量比 0.79，优于 Noise2Void 的 0.36 与 Noise2Atom 的 0.58；梯度相关 0.57 略低于 N2V 的 0.69。频域上 N2V 呈纯低通（高频功率抑制约一个数量级），CIMP GAN 在全频段近似均匀温和抑制（低/中/高频 PSD 比 0.18/0.24/0.25），符合"元数据驱动的风格迁移"而非频率截断的机制；Noise2Atom 在中低频反而加功率、抹入原子晶格先验。盲测中 CIMP GAN 在 486 次判断中被选中 70.2%（Wilson 95% CI [66.0, 74.1]，二项 p<10^-3）；评分者间差异明显（4 人 68–86%，1 人 50.7% 与随机无异），有评价者反馈 N2V"更锐利但更不真实"，仅在原始信号本已很强时更适用。Noise2Atom 因在非干净原子晶格输入上出现内容完全坍塌，被排除在用户研究之外。
AI.conclusion: CIMP 从 7,330 对真实图像-元数据中学习出既可用于检索、又与显微镜物理状态对齐的因子化表征，其价值不在于某个单一下游任务，而在于作为"基础层"：可作为感知损失支撑物理感知去噪（已验证），也可支撑对仪器状态鲁棒的分割/分析网络、跨元数据标签语料的检索索引，以及自主高吞吐显微镜所需的闭环决策。局限在于：数据集仅来自单台仪器、规模按计算机视觉标准偏小；训练数据低估了操作者很少记录的边界条件（探测器裁剪、饱和极端值）；去噪尚未在配对数据上与更强基线定量对比；offset 迁移失败提示元数据覆盖度是关键因素。作者计划扩展至多仪器数据集、在配对数据上量化去噪性能、检验 CIMP 嵌入向其他分析任务的迁移，并呼吁电镜社区更广泛地释放这类"元数据丰富但被严重闲置"的数据。

title: What Makes Good Instruction-Tuning Data? An In-Context Learning Perspective
summary: Instruction-tuning datasets often contain substantial redundancy and low-quality samples, necessitating effective data selection methods. We propose an instruction data selection framework based on weighted in-context influence (wICI), which measures how effectively each candidate example reduces instruction-following difficulty for semantically related peers. Through systematic experiments, we address three key questions: what constitutes effective instruction tuning data from an in-context perspective, whether sample difficulty correlates with in-context influence, and how in-context influence translates to instruction tuning effectiveness. Experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing baselines under constrained data budgets, while empirically showing that sample difficulty negatively correlates with in-context influence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于加权上下文影响力（wICI）的指令数据选择框架，通过衡量候选样本对语义相关样本降低指令遵循难度的效果来选择高质量训练数据，在多模型多基准测试中验证了其有效性，并发现样本难度与上下文影响力呈负相关。
AI.motivation: 指令微调数据集存在大量冗余和低质量样本，需要有效的数据选择方法。
AI.method: 通过加权上下文影响力（wICI）框架评估候选样本对语义相关同伴降低指令遵循难度的效果，设计系统性实验探索三个关键问题：有效指令微调数据的构成、样本难度与上下文影响力的关联，以及上下文影响力如何转化为指令微调效果。
AI.result: 实验跨多个模型和基准测试表明，该方法在受限数据预算下始终优于基线方法，且实证发现样本难度与上下文影响力呈负相关。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在有限数据预算下持续优于现有基线，并证实样本难度与上下文影响力呈负相关。

title: ValueAlpha: Agreement-Gated Stress Testing of LLM-Judged Investment Rationales Before Returns Are Observable
comment: 9 pages, Submitted to IEEE Computational Intelligence in Financial Engineering and Economics (CIFEr) 2026, Tokyo, Japan
summary:
Long-horizon investment decisions create a pre-realization evaluation problem: realized returns are the eventual arbiter of investment quality, but they arrive too late and are too noisy to guide many model-development and governance decisions. LLM judges offer a tempting substitute for pre-deployment evaluation of AI-finance systems, but unvalidated judges may reward verbosity, confidence, or rubric mimicry rather than financial judgment. This paper introduces \textbf{ValueAlpha}, a preregistered agreement-gated stress-test protocol for deciding when LLM-judged investment-rationale claims are publishable, qualified, or invalid.
  In a controlled market-state capital-allocation prototype with 1,000 honest decision cycles and 100 preregistered adversarial controls (1,100 trajectories, 5,500 judge calls), ValueAlpha clears the aggregate agreement gate at \(\barκ_w = 0.7168\) but prevents several overclaims. Lower-rank systems collapse into a tie-class, one rubric dimension fails the per-dimension gate (\texttt{constraint\_awareness}, \(\barκ_w = 0.2022\)), single-judge rankings are family-dependent, and terse-correct rationales receive a \(Δ= -2.81\) rubric-point penalty relative to honest rationales. A targeted anchor-specificity probe further shows that financial constructs such as constraint awareness are operationally load-bearing.
  The contribution is therefore not a leaderboard and not a claim to measure true investment skill. ValueAlpha is a pre-calibration metrology layer for AI-finance evaluation: it determines whether a proposed LLM-judge-based investment-rationale claim is stable enough, agreed enough, and uncontaminated enough to be reported at all.

AI.tldr: ValueAlpha是一种用于评估LLM判断投资理由可发表性的预校准协议，通过1,100条轨迹和5,500次判断调用验证了其在AI金融评估中的可行性，发现LLM判断存在奖励冗长、置信度偏见等问题。
AI.motivation: 长期投资决策存在"预实现评估问题"：已实现收益作为最终质量评判标准来得太晚且噪声过大；同时，未经验证的LLM评判者可能奖励冗长、过度自信或规则模仿而非真正的金融判断能力。
AI.method: 提出ValueAlpha——一种注册式协议，通过一致性筛选和压力测试判断LLM评判的投资理由声明是否可发表、合格或无效。使用1,000个诚实决策周期和100个注册对抗性对照（总计1,100条轨迹，5,500次判断调用）进行实验。
AI.result: ValueAlpha整体一致性筛选通过（κ̄_w = 0.7168），但阻止了多项过度声明；低排名系统崩溃为平局类；一个维度（constraint_awareness）未通过维度筛选（κ̄_w = 0.2022）；单评判者排名具有家族依赖性；简洁正确的理由相比诚实理由受到Δ = -2.81的评分惩罚。
AI.conclusion: ValueAlpha不是排行榜，也不声称测量真实投资技能，而是作为AI金融评估的预校准度量层：判断基于LLM评判的投资理由声明是否足够稳定、共识性足够强、且未受污染，从而决定是否值得报告。

title: Action-Aware Generative Sequence Modeling for Short Video Recommendation
summary: With the rapid development of the Internet, users have increasingly higher expectations for the recommendation accuracy of online content consumption platforms. However, short videos often contain diverse segments, and users may not hold the same attitude toward all of them. Traditional binary-classification recommendation models, which treat a video as a single holistic entity, face limitations in accurately capturing such nuanced preferences. Considering that user consumption is a temporal process, this paper demonstrates that the timing of user actions can represent diverse intentions through statistical analysis and examination of action patterns. Based on this insight, we propose a novel modeling paradigm: Action-Aware Generative Sequence Network (A2Gen), which refines user actions along the temporal dimension and chains them into sequences for unified processing and prediction. First, we introduce the Context-aware Attention Module (CAM) to model action sequences enriched with item-specific contextual features. Building upon this, we develop the Hierarchical Sequence Encoder (HSE) to learn temporal action patterns from users' historical actions. Finally, through leveraging CAM, we design a module for action sequence generation: the Action-seq Autoregressive Generator (AAG). Extensive offline experiments on the Kuaishou's dataset and the Tmall public dataset demonstrate the superiority of our proposed model. Furthermore, through large-scale online A/B testing deployed on Kuaishou's platform, our model achieves significant improvements over baseline methods in multi-task prediction by leveraging sequential information. Specifically, it yields increases of 0.34% in user watch time, 8.1% in interaction rate, and 0.162% in overall user retention (LifeTime-7), leading to successful deployment across all traffic, serving over 400 million users every day.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“动作感知生成式序列网络”（A2Gen），用于短视频推荐。作者观察到用户在不同视频片段上的偏好存在差异，且用户消费是一个时序过程，行为发生的时机可反映多元意图；因此不再把视频当作单一实体做二分类，而是沿时间维度细化用户行为、将其串联成序列进行统一建模与预测。模型由三部分构成：上下文感知注意力模块（CAM）建模融合物品上下文特征的行为序列；层次化序列编码器（HSE）从历史行为中学习时序行为模式；以及基于CAM的动作序列自回归生成器（AAG）生成动作序列。在快手数据集与天猫公开数据集上的离线实验显示模型优越性，并通过大规模线上A/B测试在多任务预测中取得显著提升：观看时长+0.34%、互动率+8.1%、7日留存（LifeTime-7）+0.162%，已全流量上线，服务超4亿日活用户。
AI.motivation: 短视频内容通常包含多个语义片段，用户对同一视频不同片段的态度并不一致，而传统二分类推荐模型把视频视为一个整体，难以刻画这种细粒度偏好；同时推荐场景本质上是一个随时间演进的消费过程，用户行为的时序与时机（如点击、观看、互动发生的时刻）蕴含了丰富且异质的意图信号，但既有方法多将行为视为无序集合或仅做粗粒度聚合，忽略了时间维度上的行为粒度与序列生成建模。论文希望通过统计分析与行为模式考察验证“时机反映意图”这一假设，并据此构建一种能联合建模细粒度动作与时间演化的推荐范式。
AI.method: 1) 范式转变：从视频级二分类/隐式反馈建模，转为沿时间轴将用户行为细化为动作序列（action-level序列建模），统一进行序列生成式预测。2) 上下文感知注意力模块（CAM）：对动作序列进行注意力建模，将物品特定的上下文特征注入序列表示，使注意力权重可依据内容语境动态分配。3) 层次化序列编码器（HSE）：在CAM之上分层组织并编码用户历史行为，学习不同时间尺度上的时序行为模式（短期兴趣与长期偏好）。4) 动作序列自回归生成器（AAG）：以CAM为基础，按自回归方式生成后续动作序列，从而将分类式打分替换为序列生成式目标函数，实现端到端训练与预测。整体框架在快手工业数据集与天猫公开数据集上进行离线对比实验验证。
AI.result: 离线实验：在快手数据集和天猫公开数据集上，A2Gen相比各类基线模型在预测准确度上均表现出优势，验证了动作序列建模与时序模式学习对刻画细粒度偏好的有效性。线上A/B测试（快手平台大规模部署）：相较基线方法，借助序列信息实现多任务预测的显著提升——用户观看时长提升0.34%，互动率提升8.1%，整体用户留存LifeTime-7提升0.162%。
AI.conclusion: 时序化的用户动作序列能够有效表达用户的多元意图，取代传统的视频级二分类推荐范式；A2Gen通过CAM、HSE与AAG的协同设计在离线与线上均验证了有效性，已在快手全流量上线并日服务超4亿用户，证明了动作感知生成式序列建模在工业级短视频推荐中的可行性与业务价值，也表明“行为时机作为意图信号”的洞察具有可推广性。

title: Scenario-based System Testing for Distributed Robotics Applications
summary: We present the SCenario Specification Language (SCSL) for automated generation and execution of system-level tests. SCSL targets complex distributed systems (e.g., collaborating autonomous robots) where classical model-based testing becomes impractical because (1) the overall system complexity is too high for a single monolithic model, (2) test behaviour cannot be fully precomputed due to substantial nondeterminism in the distributed system under test (SUT), and (3) the SUT configuration may change dynamically at runtime. Challenge (1) is addressed by scenarios: each scenario specifies test-specific expected SUT behaviour and/or stimuli to be applied during execution. Complex system tests are composed from elementary scenarios using sequential and parallel composition. To address (2), the SCSL tool platform supports online (on-the-fly) testing, selecting and executing test steps during runtime. For (3), SCSL provides a collaboration construct that supports dynamic reconfiguration: removing unavailable components, registering newly joining components, and rewiring interfaces during test execution. We illustrate the syntax and semantics of SCSL using a system-test example in which robots perform a salvage mission, and we use an automatically generated test execution to demonstrate the concepts supported by our prototype tool platform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出场景规范语言 SCSL(SCenario Specification Language),用于分布式机器人等复杂网络化物理系统(CPS)的系统级自动化测试生成与执行。针对单体模型建模不可行、系统行为高度非确定、测试配置运行时动态变化三大挑战,SCSL 以“场景库”替代整体行为模型,用 LTL 声明式规范 + 守卫动作命令式规范混合描述行为,通过可动态重配置的协作(collabration)建模组件增删与接口重连,支持在线(on-the-fly)测试。配套工具平台可将 SCSL 规范自动生成测试用例、运行时监视器、可执行预言机与仿真器,并在基于 Docker/MACVLAN/UDP 组播的云端分布式执行环境中运行。已在三台协作 rover 执行打捞任务原型系统中验证,并通过注入 GPS 故障场景检出系统级缺陷。
AI.motivation: 经典基于模型测试(MBT)需要为被测系统(SUT)建立覆盖所有可接受行为的整体性参考模型,对于分布式协作机器人这类复杂CPS而言面临三个根本困难:(1) 系统整体复杂度过高,难以用单一巨型模型刻画;(2) 各组件的局部自主性带来高度非确定性,预计算的线性测试步骤往往无法达成测试目标,必须在运行时依据当前可观测状态在线决定测试步骤;(3) SUT 配置在运行时可能动态变化(机器人自主离开/加入、因故障不可用、接口被"重连"),而仅能描述静态进程网络的建模形式主义(如 Petri 网)不适用。此外,MBT 要求对系统所有运行情形建模,规格编写成本高;而场景库方式只需为每个相关行为方面各写一个参数化场景,易于编写与复用。作者还希望 SCSL 保持领域无关,可封装领域细节于可复用库中,并兼顾声明式(LTL)与命令式(守卫动作)两种风格——LTL 便于表达所有可接受行为但难以排除多余行为,命令式风格贴近状态机但易排除合法的替代解。同时,CPS 控制器以固定周期循环执行,基于物理连续微分方程的形式主义(如 MLSL)只适合描述理想物理视图,推导被实现系统的测试用例时应体现控制器周期性。
AI.method: 语言设计:一个完整 SCSL 系统测试规格包含六类元素——基本类型(枚举)、复合数据类型(类 Z/VDM 数学数据类型)、全局常量与函数定义、对象类型规格(定义接口与状态结构,并以 cycletime 指定处理周期)、基本场景类型规格、以及系统测试配置。系统测试配置含两部分:协作(collaboration,实例化对象、声明接口映射,可运行时增删对象/创建接口,操作原子化,如同 monitor)与执行调度(schedule,以顺序";"与并行"||"组合基本场景实例)。基本场景类型含:接口/参数规格(对象按引用传递)、前置条件、LTL 行为规范、可选初始动作(initact)设置辅助变量初值、可选条件-动作对(cndact,支持守卫 guard 与变化条件 when)。引入 VDM 风格的 frame 变量:预定义集合变量 frame 隐式包含全部对象参数名,初始动作中置空则场景为纯观察者(observer),非空则允许场景在测试执行中修改所列对象参数以使 LTL 成立。每个场景隐含 active 变量,首次满足前置条件时置 true,置 false 表示场景终止;全局变量 EoT 置 true 时整个系统测试终止。语义形式化见附录 A:以估值函数序列 π=σ0…σq 建模;规定符号集 Vi 随协作增删与场景激活/终止而变化;执行周期语义(输出在 k 步周期内保持不变,输入仅最后一个写有效,接口相当于共享变量,慢速通信需引入较慢周期的辅助对象);调度规则 passive→runnable→active→passive;LTL 有限迹语义采用 De Giacomo & Vardi,并将 Next 算子按最大对象周期 c 放宽为 i+1..i+2c-1 区间;协作变更的交错非确定性语义。工具平台:两层三阶段流水线。第一阶段解析器产出中间表示(基本场景规格、实例规格、调度规则有向无环图、类型化变量定义)。第二阶段将前置条件与行为规范合并为时序逻辑公式 φscsl ≡ precondition ∧ X(∧specification_i),再做命题抽象(复杂表达式与函数调用替换为原子命题),经 ltl3ba 转为 Büchi 自动机,HOA 解析并把转移守卫映射回具体表达式,形成带无量词一阶表达式守卫的符号 Büchi 自动机;实例参数赋值合取注入各转移守卫;实例构成调度图。第三阶段:测试生成器 DFS 遍历调度图所有路径(前提满足才展开),对符号 Büchi 自动机做 DFS,路径约束由 Z3 SMT 求解得到具体输入刺激,序列化为 JSON 测试套件;oracle 与 simulation 由 Jinja2 模板生成 C++ 类(状态私有成员、switch-case 主循环、守卫编译为 if 条件),oracle 纯布尔求值免运行时 SMT,simulation 用 Z3 求取下一转移与期望输出,并保留 Büchi 自动机的非确定性(维护活跃状态集合并行探索,集合清空即判定违例)。执行环境:同构代理模型,SUT/执行器/oracle/simulation 各自为独立 Docker 容器,经 MACVLAN 网络以 UDP 组播 JSON 交换状态,时间同步的共享黑板模型;每代理双线程(接收线程聚合输入状态、执行线程按全局时标取快照确定性求值);协调器统一初始化与同步启动,测试用例经组播下发,日志与判决上传 MinIO/S3 对象存储并复位以支持可复现重跑。示例:三台 rover 打捞 m 个物品的任务,含 Approach/Pickup/Return 观察者场景、ApproachHandler/PickupHandler/ReturnHandler 仿真场景、MishapHandler(进入禁区即 coll.delete)、EmergentPropertyChecker(判据:atDst 前至少 m 台到达、tend 前至少 k 台携物返回);另注入 GPSGlitch 故障场景与参数敏感性分析,并给出两种部署变体(软件 only / 真实世界)。
AI.result: 原型系统验证:三台 rover、三件物品的二维场地打捞任务可完整执行,包含初始化、启动信号、并行调度下的场景推进、GPS 故障注入与任务重新分配(物品 1 从 Rover 3 重排给 Rover 2),Rover 3 因定位异常进入禁区后被判定 DEAD 并从协作中删除;Approach/Pickup/Return 三类 oracle 最终均为 PASS,整体系统测试 75 秒内完成并通过。参数敏感性实验给出明确边界:5 步距离/20s 与 15 步/20s 为 PASS,15 步/10s 与 25 步/20s 均为 FAIL(时间违规),表明 EmergentPropertyChecker 能正确区分物理可行与不可行配置。效率数据:从 SCSL 生成 oracle 与仿真产物耗时均小于 2 秒(Approach oracle 0.946s、Pickup 0.977s、Return 1.622s;Approach sim 0.556s、Pickup 0.677s、Return 1.142s,AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 5850U),C++ 编译与环境搭建快速;Docker+MACVLAN+UDP 组播通信开销极低,基础设施引入延迟低于 2 ms,近实时。方法有效性方面,初步实验发现当禁区仅存在唯一可行绕行路径时 rover 轨迹跟随存在缺陷——表明该方案能暴露非平凡系统级故障。测试用例生成示例显示符号 Büchi 自动机与 Z3 求解可产出具体赋值序列(如 z:=1,x:=17,p0=42)。
AI.conclusion: SCSL 是一种领域无关、场景中心、语法简洁而语义可形式化的系统测试场景规范语言:借用 UML/SysML 与 VDM 的既有机制,用 LTL 扩展出守卫动作与 frame 变量以约束变量修改,支持可复用、参数化的场景库并可组装为领域专用库;相比 OpenSCENARIO/IDM/PT-VISSIM 等领域专用形式主义,SCSL 兼顾领域无关性、表达力与可测试/可代码生成性,相比 SysML V2/Petri 网/CCSL 则具有更简洁表达与更完整的可形式化行为语义。形式语义带来的主要优势是:SCSL 规格可自动转换为测试数据生成器、可执行仿真与可嵌入原始设备测试架(OEH)的测试预言机,从而统一支持"刺激-反应"与"仅观测"两类系统测试。局限与未来工作:目前尚无与经典 MBT 的系统性实证对比(拟以 EULYNX 铁路信号标准做案例，比较建模工作量、复用性、可扩展性、需求覆盖与故障检出能力，并用变异测试评估检出效力);拟用 LTL 专用 GPT 从自然语言自动生成 LTL 公式并以生成见证轨迹等机制校验正确性;并指出除 LTL+条件动作外，亦可采用 RoboSim 等离散时间状态机形式替代行为规约方式。

title: Learning with Embedded Linear Equality Constraints via Variational Bayesian Inference
comment: Part of the OPTIMAL: Optimisation and Post-Bayesian Inference in Machine Learning Workshop at AISTATS 2026
summary: Machine Learning is becoming more prevalent in science and engineering, but many approaches do not provide meaningful uncertainty estimates and predictions may also violate known physical knowledge. We propose a Bayesian framework to embed linear relationships across inputs and outputs into the learning process, whilst characterizing full predictive uncertainty over both the model parameters and the domain knowledge. We evaluated our method on learning the single particle battery model subject to voltage and energy balances, showing its ability to provide reduced credible intervals and constraint violations compared to standard Bayesian neural networks based on variational inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"贝叶斯约束概率神经网络"（BCPNN）：把线性等式约束（质量/能量平衡）作为带噪线性观测，通过高斯条件化闭式地嵌入BNN的变分推断中，并把"约束容差"本身作为随机变量与网络参数联合推断。实验在锂离子电池单粒子模型（SPM）上验证：在保持预测精度（MSE 1.11e-4 vs 1.13e-4）与覆盖率（均0.99）不变的前提下，约束违反从174.82降至8.81e-4，区间宽度更窄（0.059 vs 0.067），并能自动区分不同约束的可靠程度。
AI.motivation: 科学与工程中的预测模型往往必须满足已知的物理约束（多为质量、能量守恒导出的线性等式）。纯数据驱动的神经网络在数据量有限或含噪时会频繁违反这些关系，产生物理不自洽/不可行的预测。虽然贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）能提供不确定性量化，但标准形式并不在预测分布中显式施加约束；而现有约束方法（PINN惩罚法、OptNet等凸优化层、输出投影等硬约束方法）都把约束当作确定性处理，既不保证全局满足，也无法传播"约束满足程度"本身的不确定性。此外，物理约束在真实系统中往往只近似成立（测量噪声、部分可观测），预设严格等式并不现实。因此需要一个同时具备：结构化物理先验、完整不确定性量化（含约束知识的不确定性）、且可微可扩展训练的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 约束建模：m条已知线性等式写为 z = A x + B y - b + ε，ε ~ N(0, diag(r))，B满行秩；r为约束容差方差向量。2) 条件化嵌入：当预测分布为高斯且约束为线性时，"满足约束"等价于对残差 z = 0 的高斯条件化，给出闭式后验预测 N(μ_C, diag(σ²_C))，其中 S = B diag(σ²_P) Bᵀ + R，μ_C = μ_P + K(b - A x - B μ_P)，σ²_C = diag(σ²_P) - diag(K S Kᵀ)，K = diag(σ²_P) Bᵀ S⁻¹。该层完全可微，可作为概率投影算子插入网络；仅保留协方差对角元以减少可学习参数。r→0 恢复硬投影，r→∞ 退化为无约束预测。3) 联合变分推断：对网络参数 θ 与容差 r 采用均值场分解 q(θ,r)=q(θ)q(r)；为保证 r>0 用对数重参数化 r = exp(ρ)，ρ 取高斯先验 N(μ_ρ=[-2,-2]ᵀ, diag([1,1]))；θ 先验 N(0, I)。修正 ELBO = E[-log p(D|θ,r)] + KL(q(θ)||p(θ)) + KL(q(r)||p(r))，用重参数化技巧最小化。4) 不确定性分解：Var(y) = E[σ²_P](偶然) + Var[μ_P](认知) - E[diag(KSKᵀ)](约束削减) + Var[μ_C](容差不确定性) + Cov[μ_P, μ_C-μ_P](约束-认知交互)；因 KSKᵀ 半正定，约束条件化总是降低边缘预测方差。5) 实验：以 PyBaMM 实现SPM为数据生成器，学习3输入（电流I、SOC、环境温度T）→8输出（V, V_OCV, η+, η-, ΔV_IR, Q̇_tot, Q̇_rev, Q̇_irr），电流6档×温度7档×每组合500个SOC点，60/20/20划分，输出加异方差高斯噪声（电压2–5 mV，热30–50 mW m⁻³）。嵌入两条约束：基尔霍夫电压定律 V = V_OCV - η+ - η- - ΔV_IR，与能量平衡 Q̇_tot = Q̇_rev + Q̇_irr。基线为标准VI-BNN（PyTorch实现，RTX 5090）。
AI.result: 1) 精度无退化：MSE 1.13e-4±1.88e-3 (BNN) vs 1.11e-4±2.21e-3 (BCPNN)；可信区间宽度CW 0.067±0.022 vs 0.059±0.022；两者覆盖率均为0.99。2) 不确定性更紧（归一化空间）：偶然不确定 0.0149→0.0140，认知不确定 0.0074→0.0068，符合方差削减理论。3) 约束一致性显著提升：10000次后验采样下平均违反量 174.82±90.78 → 8.81e-4±4.3e-5；电压约束中位违反降低两个数量级以上、热平衡降低四个数量级以上。4) 容差后验具备可解释区分度：基尔霍夫电压定律 μ_ρ=-11.21, σ_ρ=0.23, E[r]=1.36e-5（Std 3.19e-6，近似硬约束）；能量平衡 μ_ρ=-1.99, σ_ρ=1.00, E[r]=1.37e-1（Std 1.36e-1，保留较大松弛且不确定性高），与两约束所涉变量的测量噪声差异一致，说明框架可从数据自动校准"对先验知识的信任度"，无需人工调参。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了将线性等式约束通过高斯条件化嵌入BNN并用变分推断求解的框架（BCPNN），兼具结构化先验、不确定性量化与可微单一训练目标，是"结构化概率建模"与"深度学习"之间的桥接。其优势在于：约束在预测分布层面被概率化满足、容差可从数据学习、约束违反与不确定区间同时改善，且提供约束置信度的可解释诊断。局限与展望：当前仅支持线性等式约束（未来扩展至不等式与非线性关系）；协方差仅取对角以简化（牺牲了更新后协方差的跨相关结构）；未考虑约束残差的相关性/非高斯性；此外可将容差后验接入主动学习或实验设计流程，以数据与约束双重不确定性指导数据采集。

title: Korean aegyo speech shows systematic F1 increase to signal childlike qualities
summary: Korean aegyo is a socially recognized childlike speaking style used predominantly in romantic interactions among adults. This study examined vowel space modification in aegyo by analyzing formant frequencies from twelve Seoul Korean speakers who produced identical scripts in aegyo and non-aegyo styles. Results show that aegyo speech features a significant increase in F1 values across vowels and selective fronting of front vowels, leading to vowel space expansion but mainly a shift to higher F1. These findings suggest that adult speakers stylize childlike speech by imitating the shorter vocal tract of children, mainly through global vowel lowering and partial fronting.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析12名首尔韩语母语者的语料，考察撒娇语（aegyo）中元音空间的声学特征变化。研究发现撒娇语显著增加F1值并伴有部分前元音前移，导致元音空间扩展但主要表现为整体音高上升，表明成年人在使用撒娇语时通过模仿儿童较短的声道来呈现童稚化语音风格。
AI.motivation: 撒娇语（aegyo）是韩国成年人主要在浪漫互动中使用的社会认可的孩子气说话风格。先前研究已确认其音高升高、音量增大等声学特征，但尚不清楚元音空间的具体修饰方式。本研究旨在从声学音系学角度验证撒娇语是否通过模仿儿童声道特征（更短的声道导致F1升高）来实现童稚化效果。
AI.method: 研究纳入12名首尔韩语母语者，要求其使用撒娇语和非撒娇语两种风格录制相同语句。通过Praat软件提取元音的共振峰频率（F1、F2），比较两种风格间的差异。采用线性混合效应模型进行统计分析，以说话者为随机效应。
AI.result: 结果显示撒娇语中F1值在各元音上均显著升高，前元音出现选择性前移（F2值增大）。这导致元音空间整体扩展，但主要表现为向高F1方向的移动。元音降低幅度约为50-100 Hz，同时F2也呈现系统性前移。
AI.conclusion: 成人说话者在使用撒娇语时，通过模仿儿童声道特征（较短声道导致F1升高）来构建童稚化语音形象。研究证实了撒娇语的声学实现机制——即通过全局性元音降低和部分前移来模拟儿童发音特征，这为理解撒娇语的社会文化功能提供了声学证据。

title: AutoResearchBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Complex Scientific Literature Discovery
summary: Autonomous scientific research is significantly advanced thanks to the development of AI agents. One key step in this process is finding the right scientific literature, whether to explore existing knowledge for a research problem, or to acquire evidence for verifying assumptions and supporting claims. To assess AI agents' capability in driving this process, we present AutoResearchBench, a dedicated benchmark for autonomous scientific literature discovery. AutoResearchBench consists of two complementary task types: (1) Deep Research, which requires tracking down a specific target paper through a progressive, multi-step probing process, and (2) Wide Research, which requires comprehensively collecting a set of papers satisfying given conditions. Compared to previous benchmarks on agentic web browsing, AutoResearchBench is distinguished along three dimensions: it is research-oriented, calling for in-depth comprehension of scientific concepts; literature-focused, demanding fine-grained utilization of detailed information; and open-ended, involving an unknown number of qualified papers and thus requiring deliberate reasoning and search throughout. These properties make AutoResearchBench uniquely suited for evaluating autonomous research capabilities, and extraordinarily challenging. Even the most powerful LLMs, despite having largely conquered general agentic web-browsing benchmarks such as BrowseComp, achieve only 9.39% accuracy on Deep Research and 9.31% IoU on Wide Research, while many other strong baselines fall below 5%. We publicly release the dataset and evaluation pipeline to facilitate future research in this direction. We publicly release the dataset, evaluation pipeline, and code at https://github.com/CherYou/AutoResearchBench.

AI.tldr: AutoResearchBench是一个用于评估AI智能体自主科学文献发现能力的基准测试，包含Deep Research（深度研究）和Wide Research（广度研究）两种任务类型。即使是最强大的LLM在该基准上也仅能达到约9%的准确率，表明当前AI在科学文献发现领域仍有很大提升空间。
AI.motivation: 自主科学研究的发展需要AI智能体能够高效地发现相关科学文献，用于探索研究问题和验证假设。然而现有评估基准未能充分测试AI在科研导向、文献密集型、开放-ended场景下的文献发现能力。
AI.method: 提出AutoResearchBench基准，包含两种互补任务：(1) Deep Research通过渐进式多步探测追踪特定目标论文；(2) Wide Research需要全面收集满足条件的论文集。评估指标分别为准确率（Deep Research）和IoU（Wide Research）。
AI.result: 即使在通用智能体网页浏览基准（如BrowseComp）上表现优异的强大LLM，在Deep Research上仅达9.39%准确率，Wide Research上仅达9.31% IoU，多数基线模型低于5%。
AI.conclusion: AutoResearchBench具有研究导向、文献聚焦、开放-ended三大特性，使其成为评估自主研究能力的独特且极具挑战性的基准。该工作公开了数据集、评估流程和代码以推动该领域研究。

title: Generative diffusion models for spatiotemporal influenza forecasting
summary: Forecasting infectious disease incidence can provide important information to guide public health planning, yet is difficult because epidemic dynamics are complex. Current mechanistic and statistical approaches often struggle to capture multimodal uncertainty or emergent trends. Influpaint adapts denoising diffusion probabilistic models to epidemic forecasting. By encoding influenza seasons as spatiotemporal images in which pixel intensity represents incidence, Influpaint learns a rich distribution of disease dynamics from a hybrid dataset of surveillance and simulated trajectories. Forecasting is formulated as a conditional generation (inpainting) task from partial observations. We show that Influpaint generates realistic, diverse epidemic trajectories and achieves forecast accuracy that is competitive with leading ensemble methods in retrospective evaluation. In real-time evaluation during the 2023--2025 U.S. CDC FluSight challenges, performance improved substantially across seasons, with highly accurate but somewhat overconfident projections in 2024--2025. The best performance was achieved with a training dataset containing 30% surveillance and 70% simulated trajectories. These results show that diffusion models can capture important spatiotemporal structure in influenza dynamics and provide a flexible framework for probabilistic infectious disease forecasting.

AI.tldr: Influpaint是一种基于去噪扩散概率模型的流感预测方法，将流感季节数据编码为时空图像，通过条件生成（图像修复）进行预测。在美国CDC FluSight挑战赛（2023-2025）中表现优异，预测精度与主流集成方法相当，最佳训练配比为30%监测数据+70%模拟轨迹。
AI.motivation: 传染病发病率预测对公共卫生规划至关重要，但现有机械方法和统计方法难以捕捉多模态不确定性和突发趋势。流感动力学复杂，现有方法存在明显局限性。
AI.method: Influpaint将去噪扩散概率模型应用于流行病预测。核心创新包括：（1）将流感季节数据编码为时空图像，像素强度代表发病率；（2）使用监测数据与模拟轨迹的混合数据集训练；（3）将预测任务重新定义为部分观测条件下的条件生成（图像修复）任务。
AI.result: 回顾性评估表明Influpaint能生成真实、多样的疫情轨迹，预测精度与领先集成方法相当。实时评估中（2023-2025年CDC FluSight挑战赛），性能随季节推进显著提升，2024-2025年预测高度准确但略显过度自信。最佳性能配置为30%监测数据+70%模拟轨迹的混合训练集。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型能够有效捕捉流感动力学中的重要时空结构，为概率性传染病预测提供灵活框架。该方法结合真实监测数据与模拟数据的训练策略证明了混合数据策略的有效性。

title: FAMA: Failure-Aware Meta-Agentic Framework for Open-Source LLMs in Interactive Tool Use Environments
summary: Large Language Models are being increasingly deployed as the decision-making core of autonomous agents capable of effecting change in external environments. Yet, in conversational benchmarks, which simulate real-world customer-centric issue resolution scenarios, these agents frequently fail due to the cascading effects of incorrect decision-making. These challenges are particularly pronounced for open-source LLMs with smaller parameter sizes, limited context windows, and constrained inference budgets, which contribute to increased error accumulation in agentic settings. To tackle these challenges, we present the Failure-Aware Meta-Agentic (FAMA) framework. FAMA operates in two stages: first, it analyzes failure trajectories from baseline agents to identify the most prevalent errors; second, it employs an orchestration mechanism that activates a minimal subset of specialized agents tailored to address these failures by injecting a targeted context for the tool-use agent before the decision-making step. Experiments across open-source LLMs demonstrate performance gains up to 27% across evaluation modes over standard baselines. These results highlight that targeted curation of context through specialized agents to address common failures is a valuable design principle for building reliable, multi-turn tool-use LLM agents that simulate real-world conversational scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FAMA框架，通过分析失败轨迹识别常见错误，并利用专业智能体注入针对性上下文来解决工具使用LLM智能体在对话场景中的决策失败问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型作为自主智能体的决策核心，在模拟现实客户问题解决场景的对话基准测试中频繁失败，原因在于错误决策的级联效应。这对参数规模较小、上下文窗口有限、推理预算受限的开源LLM尤为突出，导致智能体设置中错误累积加剧。
AI.method: FAMA框架分两阶段运行：第一阶段分析基线智能体的失败轨迹以识别最常见的错误；第二阶段采用编排机制，激活最少的专业智能体子集，通过在决策前向工具使用智能体注入针对性上下文来处理这些失败。
AI.result: 跨开源LLM的实验表明，FAMA在多种评估模式下相比标准基线实现了高达27%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: Targeted curation of context through specialized agents to address common failures is a valuable design principle for building reliable, multi-turn tool-use LLM agents that simulate real-world conversational scenarios.

title: Plausible but Wrong: A case study on Agentic Failures in Astrophysical Workflows
summary: Agentic AI systems are increasingly being integrated into scientific workflows, yet their behavior under realistic conditions remains insufficiently understood. We evaluate CMBAgent across two workflow paradigms and eighteen astrophysical tasks. In the One-Shot setting, access to domain-specific context yields an approximately ~6x performance improvement (0.85 vs. ~0 without context), with the primary failure mode being silent incorrect computation - syntactically valid code that produces plausible but inaccurate results. In the Deep Research setting, the system frequently exhibits silent failures across stress tests, producing physically inconsistent posteriors without self-diagnosis. Overall, performance is strong on well-specified tasks but degrades on problems designed to probe reasoning limits, often without visible error signals. These findings highlight that the most concerning failure mode in agentic scientific workflows is not overt failure, but confident generation of incorrect results. We release our evaluation framework to facilitate systematic reliability analysis of scientific AI agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了 CMBAgent 在天体物理任务中的表现，发现领域特定上下文可带来约6倍性能提升，但主要失败模式是"静默错误计算"——代码语法正确但结果不准确。Deep Research模式下系统频繁产生物理不一致的结果却无法自我诊断。最关键发现是：agentic科学工作流中最危险的失败不是显式报错，而是自信地生成错误结果。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI系统正被广泛集成到科学工作流中，但其真实条件下的行为尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 在两种工作流范式（One-Shot和Deep Research）和18个天体物理任务上评估CMBAgent系统。
AI.result: One-Shot设置中领域特定上下文带来约6倍性能提升（0.85 vs ~0）；Deep Research设置中频繁出现silent failures和物理不一致的后验分布；在推理边界问题上性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 强调silent failure是最危险的失败模式——AI会自信地生成错误结果而非显式报错；发布评估框架以支持科学AI智能体的系统性可靠性分析。

title: Key Developer Roles and Organizational Coupling in Microservices: A Longitudinal Analysis
summary: Microservice-based systems impose significant organizational coordination challenges, yet the role of individual developers in shaping organizational coupling (OC) remains underexplored. Prior work largely focuses on structural architectural aspects, leaving gaps in understanding how developer roles influence coordination dynamics over time. This study investigates how different developer roles contribute to OC in a large-scale microservices system. The analysis focuses on three key roles, namely Jacks, representing broad knowledge holders, Mavens, representing deep specialists, and Connectors, representing organizational bridges. A longitudinal repository mining analysis of GitHub data, including commits and issue and pull request interactions, is conducted to operationalize OC and quantify its evolution over time. The results show that Connectors are consistently associated with higher levels of OC, while the co-occurrence of multiple roles within the same developer further amplifies coupling effects. In contrast, Jacks and Mavens exhibit more localized and role-specific influences. These findings indicate that OC in microservices is primarily a role-driven phenomenon rather than an inevitable structural property, providing a foundation for role-aware organizational design and targeted decoupling strategies.

AI.tldr: This study examines how developer roles (Jacks-broad knowledge holders, Mavens-deep specialists, Connectors-organizational bridges) contribute to organizational coupling in large-scale microservice systems. Through longitudinal GitHub data analysis, researchers found that Connectors drive higher coupling, multi-role developers amplify coupling effects, while Jacks and Mavens have more localized influences. Organizational coupling is thus a role-driven phenomenon, not just a structural property.
AI.motivation: Microservice-based systems impose significant organizational coordination challenges, yet prior work largely focuses on structural architectural aspects. The role of individual developers in shaping organizational coupling remains underexplored, leaving gaps in understanding how developer roles influence coordination dynamics over time.
AI.method: Longitudinal repository mining analysis of GitHub data including commits, issues, and pull request interactions to operationalize organizational coupling and quantify its evolution over time.
AI.result: Connectors are consistently associated with higher levels of organizational coupling. The co-occurrence of multiple roles within the same developer further amplifies coupling effects. In contrast, Jacks and Mavens exhibit more localized and role-specific influences.
AI.conclusion: Organizational coupling in microservices is primarily a role-driven phenomenon rather than an inevitable structural property. The findings support role-aware organizational design and targeted decoupling strategies. Notably, developer co-occurrence of multiple roles amplifies coupling effects.

title: A Unifying Framework for Unsupervised Concept Extraction
summary: Techniques for concept extraction, such as sparse autoencoders and transcoders, aim to extract high-level symbolic concepts from low-level nonsymbolic representations. When these extracted concepts are used for downstream tasks such as model steering and unlearning, it is essential to understand their guarantees, or lack thereof. In this work, we present a unified theoretical framework for unsupervised concept extraction, in which we frame the task of concept extraction as identifying a generative model. We present a general meta-theorem for identifiability, which reduces the problem of establishing identifiability guarantees to the problem of characterizing the intersection of two sets. As we demonstrate on a range of widely-used approaches, this meta-theorem substantially simplifies the task of proving such guarantees, thus paving the way for the development of new, principled approaches for concept extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，将无监督概念提取任务形式化为识别生成模型的问题，并给出了一个通用的元定理（meta-theorem），将 identifiability 保证的证明简化为两个集合交集的刻画。这一框架可应用于多种广泛使用的概念提取方法。
AI.motivation: 概念提取技术（如稀疏自编码器、transcoders）旨在从低层非符号表示中提取高层符号概念。当这些概念被用于下游任务（如模型 steering 和 unlearning）时，必须理解其保证（identifiability guarantees）。然而，现有研究缺乏统一的理论框架来证明这些保证。
AI.method: 将无监督概念提取任务重新形式化为识别生成模型（identifying a generative model）的问题；提出了一个通用元定理，该定理将 identifiability 保证的证明归结为对两个集合交集的刻画。
AI.result: 该元定理大幅简化了为各种概念提取方法建立 identifiability 保证的难度，可适用于多种广泛使用的概念提取方法。
AI.conclusion: 这一框架为概念提取提供了原则性（principled）的新方法开发路径，推动了该领域从经验性方法向理论驱动方法的演进。

title: Frictive Policy Optimization for LLMs: Epistemic Intervention, Risk-Sensitive Control, and Reflective Alignment
comment: Frictive Policy Optimization; epistemic alignment; risk-sensitive control; LLM alignment; clarification and refusal; preference learning; trust regions; dialogue agents
summary: We propose Frictive Policy Optimization (FPO), a framework for learning language model policies that regulate not only what to say, but when and how to intervene in order to manage epistemic and normative risk. Unlike standard alignment methods that optimize surface-level preference or task utility, FPO treats clarification, verification, challenge, redirection, and refusal as explicit control actions whose purpose is to shape the evolution of belief, commitment, and uncertainty over time. We formalize alignment as a risk-sensitive epistemic control problem in which intervention decisions are selected based on their expected effect on downstream epistemic quality rather than on immediate reward alone. We introduce a compact taxonomy of frictive interventions, a structured friction functional that operationalizes multiple alignment failure modes, and a unified family of FPO methods spanning reward shaping, preference pairing, group-relative ranking, and risk-conditioned trust regions. We further propose an evaluation framework that measures epistemic competence directly through clarification behavior, calibration, contradiction repair, refusal proportionality, and information efficiency. Together, these results provide a formal and algorithmic foundation for learning agents that are aligned not only in outcome, but in epistemic conduct.

AI.tldr: FPO提出了一个学习语言模型策略的新框架，将澄清、验证、质疑、重定向和拒绝作为显式的控制动作来管理认知和规范风险。该框架将对齐问题形式化为风险敏感的认知控制问题，并通过风险调节的信任域、奖励塑造、偏好配对和组相对排序等多种方法实现。
AI.motivation: Standard alignment methods focus on surface-level preference or task utility optimization, but fail to address when and how to intervene to manage epistemic and normative risk. The authors argue that alignment should be treated as an epistemic control problem where intervention decisions should be evaluated based on their expected effect on downstream epistemic quality rather than immediate reward alone.
AI.method: The paper introduces a compact taxonomy of frictive interventions, a structured friction functional that operationalizes multiple alignment failure modes, and a unified family of FPO methods spanning reward shaping, preference pairing, group-relative ranking, and risk-conditioned trust regions. An evaluation framework is also proposed to measure epistemic competence through clarification behavior, calibration, contradiction repair, refusal proportionality, and information efficiency.
AI.result: The proposed framework operationalizes alignment failure modes through a structured friction functional and provides multiple algorithmic variants for implementation. The evaluation framework enables direct measurement of epistemic competence through multiple dimensions including clarification behavior, calibration, contradiction repair, refusal proportionality, and information efficiency.
AI.conclusion: FPO provides a formal and algorithmic foundation for learning aligned agents that are responsible not only in outcomes but also in their epistemic conduct, representing a paradigm shift from outcome-based to process-based alignment.

title: Multi-action Tangled Program Graphs for Multi-task Reinforcement Learning with Continuous Control
summary: Over the past few decades, machine learning has been widely used to learn complex tasks. Reinforcement Learning (RL), inspired by human behavior, is a great example, as it involves developing specific behaviours for specific tasks. To further challenge algorithms, Multi-Task RL (MTRL) environments have been introduced, requiring a single model to learn multiple behaviors. The Tangled Program Graph (TPG) algorithm is a Genetic Programming (GP) algorithm designed for discrete MTRL environments. Recently, the MAPLE algorithm has been proposed, as another GP algorithm that achieves high results in single task continuous RL environments. A variation of the TPG is proposed alongside MAPLE, named Multi-Action TPG (MATPG) that aggregates MAPLE agents, and creates a control flow to activate them. Initially tested on single task RL environments only, MATPG achieved similar results to MAPLE. In this work, we present a new benchmark based on the MuJoCo Half Cheetah from Gymnasium. This benchmark features five distinct obstacles that are randomly positioned in front of the agent, each of which demands a unique behavior. This benchmark serves as a use case for MATPG, to prove its ability as a GP solution for continuous MTRL environments. Our experiments demonstrate its superiority in this multi-task use case when combined with lexicase selection. Furthermore, we examine the interpretability of the evolved graph, revealing that the decision flow of the model is fully interpretable.

AI.tldr: The paper extends MATPG, a GP-based algorithm combining MAPLE agents with TPG's control flow structure, to continuous multi-task RL environments by introducing a new MuJoCo Half Cheetah benchmark. Experiments show that lexicase selection improves performance, and the approach offers interpretable decision graphs—a notable advantage over opaque neural approaches.
AI.motivation: Existing GP algorithms like TPG were designed for discrete MTRL environments, while MAPLE excelled in single-task continuous RL. The need arose to extend GP-based approaches to continuous MTRL settings—a gap not adequately addressed by prior algorithms.
AI.method: The authors: (1) created a new MuJoCo Half Cheetah benchmark with five randomly positioned obstacles, each requiring unique behaviors; (2) tested MATPG (which aggregates MAPLE agents with a control flow) on this benchmark; (3) compared performance with and without lexicase selection; (4) analyzed the interpretability of the evolved graph structures.
AI.result: MATPG combined with lexicase selection demonstrated superiority over alternative approaches on the proposed multi-task benchmark. Additionally, the evolved decision flow was shown to be fully interpretable, addressing a common limitation of neural network-based RL methods.
AI.conclusion: The work presents a successful application of MATPG to continuous MTRL environments, with lexicase selection enhancing performance. The evolved graphs maintain full interpretability, addressing the often-cited opacity issue of neural approaches.

title: Does social identity matter in software engineering? Assessing the case of research software engineers
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering. June 9-12, 2026, Glasgow, United Kingdom
summary: Social identity is a concept from psychology that refers to the part of an individual's identity that derives from their group membership(s). In this paper, we explore social identity in members of the professional community of Research Software Engineers (RSEs). Using a mixed-methods approach, our study combined computational linguistic analysis and inferential statistics to examine over 28,000 social media posts, 1,700 blogs, and survey responses from 381 professional RSEs. The findings highlight the emergence of a collective RSE identity and demonstrate its role in shaping professional wellbeing. This study contributes an interdisciplinary perspective by integrating social psychology and software engineering to show how a professional identity evolves and why it matters.

AI.tldr: 本研究以研究软件工程师（RSE）为案例，用混合方法（28,412 条推文 + 1,765 篇博客的计算语言学分析 + 381 份问卷的推断统计与因果中介分析）考察"社会认同"在软件工程中的形成与后果。结果表明：RSE 集体身份在 2012–2022 年间确实形成（第一人称单数代词下降、复数代词上升、集体行动相关情绪下降、主题聚焦社区建设）；对 RSE 身份的认同越强，其专业结果越正向（R²=0.09）、自主性越高（R²=0.05）、韧性越强（R²=0.19），且自主性与韧性在认同与专业结果之间起中介作用（韧性为完全中介，ACME=0.13）。部分假设（语言风格趋同、依恋风格假设 H9）未获支持，暴露了构念效度与自报偏差等局限。
AI.motivation: 尽管软件工程（SE）研究中已有大量关于开发者体验、动机、满意度、生产性与团队效能的实证工作，源自社会心理学的"社会认同"（Tajfel & Turner, 1979）构念在 SE 领域仍鲜有系统考察：仅有 Bäckevik 等 (2019) 的小规模研究涉及群体身份与团队效能的关系，且未清晰刻画身份与效能之间的联系；其他研究（开源社区中的成功感与归属感等）只是触及相近概念。这一缺口在 RSE 群体上尤为突出：RSE 是 2012 年才被命名的新兴职业，长期缺乏清晰的职业身份、晋升通道与工作保障，其身份建构本身就是一场"集体行动"（如 2016 年首届 RSE 大会、2019 年"RSE Worldwide"会议催生多个国际组织），是检验"专业身份如何形成并影响从业者"的理想案例。作者由此提出两个研究问题：RQ1 社会认同如何在软件工程内部随时间凝聚；RQ2 面向社会认同的取向如何影响专业结果。
AI.method:
研究采用预注册（OSF）的混合方法设计，包含两条互补的数据线。

（1）计算语言学部分（RQ1，检验 H1–H4）：语料为 19 个 RSE 相关 Twitter 账号的 28,412 条推文（原始 29,054 条，清洗移除 642 条转发）与 6 个 RSE 相关网站的 1,765 篇博客，跨度 2012-01-01 至 2022-09-08，涵盖 RSE 身份从诞生到成熟的整个过程；账号与网站通过关键词检索、已识别组织互查与业内推荐确定。数据用 Twitter API v2（Python）与 webscraper.io 采集，R 脚本配合 textclean 清洗并转化为适配 LIWC-22 的词形。用 LIWC-22 提取社会认同（第一人称单数/复数、第三人称复数）、集体行动（负面情绪、愤怒、过去焦点、差异性 discrepancy、区分性 differentiation）与语言风格（z 分数绝对值求和后计算与群体均值的偏离；另做仅功能词的 Language Style Matching 补充分析）变量；主题建模采用 MEM（1–3 gram 词项、≥5% 阈值）生成 DTM 后做 varimax 旋转 PCA。按 RSE 大会里程碑划分三个时间期（2012-01-01–2016-09-13；2016-09-15–2019-09-15；2019-09-17–2022-09-08），用线性回归检验时间是否预测各变量。

（2）问卷部分（RQ2，检验 H5–H9）：通过 Twitter、LinkedIn、SSI Fellows 列表、SSI 博客/推文、UK RSE Slack、code4lib、Samvera 等渠道招募 381 名在职研究软件工程师（平均年龄 37.58，SD=9.21；134 女、190 男、5 非二元、2 未披露；附 £4.50 亚马逊券），取得知情同意后在线作答，量表涵盖 RSE 工作参与度、社会认同（单题 RSE 认同 + 自我投入/自我定义）、Breaugh 三类自主性、Hollnagel 四项韧性能力（个体/团队/项目三层）、四类专业结果（成功、满意度、意义感、团队沟通）以及依恋风格（安全/焦虑/回避）与行动—状态取向，采用 1–7 点 Likert。分析在 R 中进行：描述统计、单因素 ANOVA（Tukey HSD）、线性回归（并对性别、年龄、收入、教育、经验作协变量调整），以及用 mediation 包的 mediate() 函数进行 10 次因果中介分析（自变量为 RSE 社会认同，中介为总体自主性与总体韧性，因变量为四类专业结果及均值）。
AI.result:
RQ1（认同形成）：H1a/H1b 在两个语料中均成立——第一人称单数代词随时间显著下降（推文 b=-0.01；博客 b=-0.17），第一人称复数显著上升（推文 b=0.40；博客 b=0.09）；H1c 仅在全量推文中成立（第三人称复数上升，b=0.11），博客中无显著变化，说明外群体区分并非该身份的核心。集体行动变量呈"混合"结果：推文中负面情绪、愤怒、discrepancy 下降（支持 H2a/H2b/H2d），但过去焦点与区分性反而上升（H2c/H2e 未获支持）；博客中负面情绪、愤怒、过去焦点、区分性均下降（H2a–H2c、H2e 成立），discrepancy 无变化（H2d 未成立）。H3 未获支持：全 LIWC 与仅功能词两种口径下，帖子与群体平均语言风格的相似度均随时间下降（推文 b=-6.11 / -0.50；博客 b=-2.75 / -0.17），提示各账号表达风格趋于多样化。H4 获支持：推文主题为 News、Discussion and Support、Projects（RSE 子集为 News、Projects、Community）；博客主题为 Contact/Staying in Touch、Shop Talk、Community Progress。

RQ2（认同取向的后果）：76.90% 的受访者认领 RSE 身份，仅 1.05% 只认同 RSE 而无学科身份；其余多重身份中计算机科学 35.17%、心理学 18.64%、人文 15.22%。RSE 身份认同水平与其他专业身份认同无显著差异。回归结果支持 H5–H7：认同正向预测专业结果（b=0.16, R²=0.09, F(1,331)=33.05, p<.0001）、自主性（b=0.13, R²=0.05, p<.0001）与韧性（b=0.23, R²=0.19, F(1,328)=78.82, p<.0001）。中介分析支持 H8：自主性起部分中介（ACME=0.07, p<.0001），韧性起完全中介（ACME=0.13, p<.0001）。H9 全部不成立：认同越高，焦虑型依恋越强（R²=0.10, p<.0001），安全型依恋与认同呈负相关（r=-0.25, p<.0001），对回避型依恋与状态/行动取向均无显著效应；进一步分析显示焦虑型依恋正向预测韧性（b=0.27）与标准自主性/方法自主性，状态取向正向预测方法自主性，回避型依恋负向预测标准自主性与学习能力，安全型依恋负向预测韧性。描述统计上，自主权总体较高（M=5.60/7），专业结果总体 5.36，但满意度最低（4.88，显著低于成功 5.30 与意义感 5.48）；韧性中"预见"能力最弱（5.17，显著低于监测与学习）。
AI.conclusion:
研究结论是：RSE 社会认同确实在公开话语中形成并巩固（代词结构、情绪轨迹与主题演化三重证据），而个体对 RSE 认同的取向越强，其自主性、韧性与专业结果越好，且二者是认同通向正向专业结果的关键通道——韧性完全中介、自主性部分中介，说明"身份认同"影响从业者的机制主要经由"更能掌控工作、更能应对与学习挫折"来实现。作者据此主张，在 AI 工具重塑 SE 角色与任务的背景下，理解软件工程群体的社会认同是可行且有价值的补充视角，可用于工程师福祉与团队管理（如 Hoda 等关于自组织团队自主性的研究、"敢于发声"的开发者与韧性绩效）；该混合方法与量化—自报结合的设计也可迁移到企业开发者社区与开源项目等情境。

局限与未来工作：外部效度受限于仅分析愿意以英语公开发声的 RSE，且样本以欧洲尤其英国为主；构念效度方面，基于词与 n-gram 的分析难以完全刻画社区话语丰富性并可能误判非母语者，且显著结果效应量为小到中等，预测变量只是"重要但非主导"因素；内部效度方面，推文/博客作者与问卷受访者可能不重叠，因而无法做个体层面的纵向推断。后续需用更大规模与更多语言数据集重检"过去焦点/discrepancy/分化"等矛盾结果、探究语言风格趋同的情境条件、检验"焦虑型依恋带来更高韧性"是否源于自报与社会赞许偏差（亦可能反映"天真型安全依恋"），并关注"Research Technical Professional"等新称谓是否构成新的社会认同群体。

title: Rethinking Layer Redundancy in Large Language Models: Calibration Objectives and Search for Depth Pruning
summary: Depth pruning improves the inference efficiency of large language models by removing Transformer blocks. Prior work has focused on importance criteria and search algorithms, often treating layer redundancy as an inherent structural property of pretrained networks. In contrast, we adopt a \emph{functional perspective}, where redundancy is jointly influenced by the model and the evaluation objective, suggesting that a universal ranking may not be sufficient. Through an empirical study across three LLM families, two calibration objectives, and seven search algorithms, we observe that different objectives yield qualitatively different redundant layers, and that perplexity and downstream accuracy rankings do not consistently align. Under a fixed objective, however, search algorithms tend to produce similar solutions. Overall, our results suggest that the calibration objective may play a more influential role than the choice of search algorithm, indicating that further attention to objective design could be beneficial.

AI.tldr: The paper challenges the assumption that layer redundancy is an inherent structural property of pretrained LLMs, instead proposing a functional perspective where redundancy depends on both model and evaluation objective. Through extensive experiments, they find that calibration objective has greater impact on pruning results than choice of search algorithm.
AI.motivation: Prior work treats layer redundancy as an inherent structural property, but the paper argues redundancy is jointly influenced by model and evaluation objective, questioning the sufficiency of universal rankings.
AI.method: Empirical study across 3 LLM families, 2 calibration objectives, and 7 search algorithms
AI.result: Different objectives yield qualitatively different redundant layers; perplexity and downstream accuracy rankings do not consistently align; under a fixed objective, search algorithms tend to produce similar solutions.
AI.conclusion: Calibration objective may play a more influential role than search algorithm in depth pruning, suggesting future work should focus more on objective design.

title: CroSearch-R1: Better Leveraging Cross-lingual Knowledge for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: A multilingual collection may contain useful knowledge in other languages to supplement and correct the facts in the original language for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, the vanilla approach that simply concatenates multiple pieces of knowledge from different languages into the context may fail to improve effectiveness due to the potential disparities across languages. To better leverage multilingual knowledge, we propose CroSearch-R1, a search-augmented reinforcement learning framework to integrate multilingual knowledge into the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) process. In particular, the approach adopts a multi-turn retrieval strategy with cross-lingual knowledge integration to dynamically align the knowledge from other languages as supplementary evidence into a unified representation space. Furthermore, we introduce a multilingual rollout mechanism to optimize reasoning transferability across languages. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework effectively leverages cross-lingual complementarity and improves the effectiveness of RAG with multilingual collections.

AI.tldr: CroSearch-R1是一种将多语言知识整合到检索增强生成(RAG)中的搜索增强强化学习框架,通过跨语言知识集成和统一表示空间解决简单拼接多语言知识效果不佳的问题。
AI.motivation: 多语言语料库可能包含补充和纠正原始语言事实的有用知识,但简单拼接不同语言的知识可能因语言间差异而无法提升效果。
AI.method: 采用多轮检索策略结合跨语言知识集成,将其他语言的知识动态对齐为补充证据并映射到统一表示空间;引入多语言rollout机制优化跨语言推理迁移性;使用群组相对策略优化(GRPO)进行强化学习训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该框架能有效利用跨语言互补性,提升多语言语料库下RAG系统的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CroSearch-R1为多语言知识增强RAG提供了一种有效的搜索增强强化学习范式。

title: JURY-RL: Votes Propose, Proofs Dispose for Label-Free RLVR
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enhances the reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but standard RLVR often depends on human-annotated answers or carefully curated reward specifications. In machine-checkable domains, label-free alternatives such as majority voting or LLM-as-a-judge remove annotation cost but can introduce false positives that destabilize training. We introduce JURY-RL, a label-free RLVR framework that decouples answer proposal from reward disposal: votes from model rollouts propose a candidate answer, and a formal verifier determines whether that candidate can receive positive reward. Concretely, only rollouts matching the plurality-voted answer are rewarded when that answer is successfully verified in Lean. When verification is inconclusive, we invoke ResZero (Residual-Zero), a fallback reward that discards the unverified plurality proposal and redistributes a zero-mean, variance-preserving signal over the residual answers. This design maintains a stable optimization gradient without reinforcing unverifiable consensus. Across three backbone models trained on mathematical data, JURY-RL consistently outperforms other label-free baselines on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and transfers competitively to code generation and general benchmarks. It attains pass@1 performance comparable to supervised ground-truth training, with superior generalization demonstrated by higher pass@k and response diversity.

AI.tldr: JURY-RL 是一个面向可机器校验领域的无标注 RLVR 框架：先用 rollout 多数投票"提名"候选答案，再用 Lean 形式化验证器"裁决"奖励（"Votes Propose, Proofs Dispose"）。验证成功时只奖励与已证答案一致的轨迹；验证不确定时启用 ResZero 残余奖励——丢弃未验证的多数答案，把零均值、保方差的信号重新分配给残差答案。三个骨干模型上的结果显示其全面优于其他无标注基线，pass@1 追平甚至超过有监督 GT-Reward，且 pass@k 与解多样性显著更好。
AI.motivation: 标准 RLVR 依赖人工标注答案或精心设计的奖励规格，成本高且覆盖有限；无标注替代方案（多数投票、自确定性、熵最小化、LLM-as-a-Judge、LLM-KD）虽降低标注成本，却把"一致性/置信度"误当作"正确性"，易产生假阳性、奖励黑客与熵崩塌/训练坍缩。作者进一步指出真实鲁棒的奖励信号需同时满足三性质：(i) 可扩展（无需人工监督）；(ii) 真值对齐（奖励可验证的正确性）；(iii) 优化稳定（验证不确定时学习仍能推进）。多数投票满足可扩展但牺牲真值对齐；LLM-as-a-Judge 真值对齐差（假阳性高）且不稳定。已有 generate-then-verify 流水线在验证失败时往往不给任何学习信号，导致停滞。
AI.method:
1) 提出-裁决解耦：每题采样 G 条 rollout，用确定性抽取器 ans(·) 解析答案 a_i，多数（plurality）投票得到候选 â；对 â 仅调用一次 Lean 验证器得二元 proof-gate δ=verify(x,â)。
2) 奖励公式：r_i = δ·I[a_i=â] + (1−δ)·r_i^ResZero（Eq.5）。
3) ResZero 奖励（Eq.6）：设 M 为支持多数的集合、R 为残差集、α=|M|/G；对 i∈R 用留一法计算残差群体内相对支持度 z_i=u^{(-i)}(a_i)，ḡ=1/|R|Σz_j；奖励 r_i = α·I[i∈R]·(z_i−ḡ) − c·α·I[i∈M] + γ，其中 γ=cα² 为全局再中心化项，c=0.01；理论上保证 Σ_i r_i=0（附录 A.2 给出完整证明与平票、无残差、单一异议者等边界情形），且当残差不全同时组方差非零。
4) 理论分析：MV 奖励在 GRPO 下使支持者优势→0、异议者惩罚→−∞（熵崩塌）；零奖励使优势全为 0（梯度消失）；ResZero 给出"纠正性+探索性"的构造性更新，且随多数占比 α 自适应放大惩罚（模型"自信地错"时压力最大）。
5) Lean 验证器流水线（三级级联）：Autoformalizer（Goedel-Formalizer-V2-32B，最多 8 个候选形式化）→ Consistency-Checker（QwQ-32B 做自然语言↔Lean 双向语义一致性校验）→ Prover（Goedel-Prover-V2-32B，pass@16 采样证明，命中即早停）；结果缓存以摊薄开销。
6) 训练设置：VeRL + GRPO，G=8，batch 128，lr 3e-6，KL β=0.005，训练 6 epoch，MATH 训练集 7500 题，8×A100；评测覆盖 AIME24/25、MATH500、GSM8K、AMC、LiveCodeBench、CRUX、IFEval、MMLU-Pro（avg@k，报告 95% 置信区间）。
AI.result:
1) 主结果（Table 1/2/10）：JURY-RL 在三个骨干上均为最佳无标注方法，平均分超过 MV、Self-Certainty、Entropy、CoReward、LLM-as-a-Judge；数学 avg@k 平均 35.40/31.85/43.90，与 GT-Reward（35.56/31.53/43.90）相当甚至反超。pass@1 相对 GT 提升 +1.53~+2.32 pp，相对 LLM-as-a-Judge +3.45~+4.00 pp；pass@k 相对 GT 提升 +1.56~+4.05 pp，相对 LLM-as-a-Judge 最高 +10.05 pp。Qwen2.5-7B 域外（代码/指令/多任务）平均 40.14%，超 GT +1.88 pp。
2) 消融（Table 3/11）：ResZero 平均分最优，优于 Zero +1.3、Random +5.4、Proof-Gate+MV +6.1，与 GT 差距在 0.1 pp 内；且 Proof-Gate+MV 反而低于纯 MV 基线，验证"验证失败后奖励未证多数"会加速模式坍缩。Pass@k 下 ResZero 在三个模型上全面超过 GT-Reward。
3) 稳定性与多样性：Entropy/Self-Certainty 训练中出现坍缩，LLM-as-a-Judge/LLM-KD/MV 收敛噪声大；JURY-RL 呈稳定单调提升；单位问题唯一答案数全程维持高位，而 MV 迅速坍缩为单一答案。
4) 验证器质量（Table 4）：Lean 精确率 84.5%（vs judge 75.9%），召回 88.0%（vs 96.1%），F1 86.2%（vs 84.8%）；Autoformalizer 在 MATH500 成功率 95.4%，一致性检查器 F1 91.1%，外部集 miniF2F 97.1%/ProofNet 71.5%/Putnam 74.2%/AIME25 66.7%，失败为保守错误（落到 ResZero 而非假阳性）。
5) 分支动态：P(δ=1) 从 53.0% 升至 70.7%，多数正确率 50.9%→67.9%，少数派正确被漏率由 7.6% 降至 5.4%（且 78–85% 的失败组中根本无正确 rollout，故 top-2/top-3 验证无额外收益）。
6) 成本：Lean 验证冷启动约 +200 s/step（judge 约 +80 s/step，总步时 300 s vs 180 s），缓存后逐步收敛至 GT 基线；Prover@16 在 MATH500 上 ACC 87.6、324 s，与 72B 的 LLM-judge（87.2、290 s）相当但信号更可靠。
7) TTRL 扩展：Qwen2.5-7B 上 MV-TTRL 先升后降，JURY-RL 持续稳定提升；Qwen2.5-14B 上 avg pass@1 +3.53 pp、pass@k +5.16 pp（AIME24/25 pass@1 各 +6.67，AMC pass@k +10.84）。
8) 超参敏感性：c=0 退化为零奖励并导致多样性下降；c=0.1 惩罚过强略损精度；c=0.01 为较优折中。
AI.conclusion: JURY-RL 证明：在可机器校验域中，用"投票提名、证明裁决"的方式可以在完全无人工标签的前提下获得与有监督 GT 训练相当的 pass@1，并在 pass@k、答案多样性、训练稳定性与域外泛化上更优。三条设计原则（可扩展、真值对齐、优化稳定）通过 proof-gated 正奖励与保守的 ResZero 残余回退同时满足。局限与未来方向：仅验证 top-1 候选会漏掉少数派正确答案（约 5–9%）；自动形式化与一致性检查在竞赛级难题上覆盖下降（如 AIME25 66.7%），使最难域的监督密度降低；Lean 验证冷启动开销约为 LLM-judge 的 2.5 倍；更强的提名模型与更可靠的上游形式化是进一步提升的关键。

title: RESTestBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Effectiveness of LLM-Generated REST API Test Cases from NL Requirements
summary: Existing REST API testing tools are typically evaluated using code coverage and crash-based fault metrics. However, recent LLM-based approaches increasingly generate tests from NL requirements to validate functional behaviour, making traditional metrics weak proxies for whether generated tests validate intended behaviour. To address this gap, we present RESTestBench, a benchmark comprising three REST services paired with manually verified NL requirements in both precise and vague variants, enabling controlled and reproducible evaluation of requirement-based test generation. RESTestBench further introduces a requirements-based mutation testing metric that measures the fault-detection effectiveness of a generated test case with respect to a specific requirement, extending the property-based approach of Bartocci et al. . Using RESTestBench, we evaluate two approaches across multiple state-of-the-art LLMs: (i) non-refinement-based generation, and (ii) refinement-based generation guided by interaction with the running SUT. In the refinement experiments, RESTestBench assesses how exposure to the actual implementation, valid or mutated, affects test effectiveness. Our results show that test effectiveness drops considerably when the generator interacts with faulty or mutated code, especially for vague requirements, sometimes negating the benefit of refinement and indicating that incorporating actual SUT behaviour is unnecessary when requirement detail is high.

AI.tldr: RESTestBench是一个用于评估REST API NL需求测试生成的基准，引入了需求驱动变异测试度量。研究发现当生成器与错误/变异代码交互时测试效果显著下降，尤其对于模糊需求，说明需求详细程度比SUT反馈更具价值。
AI.motivation: Traditional metrics (code coverage, crash-based fault detection) are inadequate proxies for validating functional behavior when LLMs generate tests from NL requirements, necessitating requirement-based evaluation approaches.
AI.method: Built RESTestBench benchmark with 3 REST services and NL requirements in precise/vague variants; introduced requirements-based mutation testing metric; conducted comparative evaluation of non-refinement vs refinement-based test generation across multiple LLMs.
AI.result: Test effectiveness significantly degrades when generators interact with faulty/mutated code, particularly for vague requirements—sometimes negating refinement benefits. SUT interaction is unnecessary when requirement detail is high.
AI.conclusion: For LLM-based test generation from NL requirements, detailed requirements are more valuable than SUT interaction for ensuring test effectiveness, rendering SUT feedback unnecessary when requirement precision is high.

title: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: Efficient and Open Multimodal Intelligence
summary: We introduce Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, the latest model in the Nemotron multimodal series and the first to natively support audio inputs alongside text, images, and video. Nemotron 3 Nano Omni delivers consistent accuracy improvements over its predecessor, Nemotron Nano V2 VL, across all modalities, enabled by advances in architecture, training data and recipes. In particular, Nemotron 3 delivers leading results in real-world document understanding, long audio-video comprehension, and agentic computer use. Built on the highly efficient Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B backbone, Nemotron 3 Nano Omni further incorporates innovative multimodal token-reduction techniques to deliver substantially lower inference latency and higher throughput than other models of similar size. We are releasing model checkpoints in BF16, FP8, and FP4 formats, along with portions of the training data and codebase to facilitate further research and development.

AI.tldr: NVIDIA 发布 Nemotron 3 Nano Omni：一个基于 Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B 混合 MoE 骨干、首次原生支持音频的多模态（文本/图像/视频/音频）高效模型，配套动态分辨率、Conv3D 时序压缩与 Efficient Video Sampling 等 token 削减技术，显著降低推理延迟、提高吞吐，并开源 BF16/FP8/FP4 权重、部分训练数据与代码。
AI.motivation: 现有开源全模态模型（如 Qwen3-Omni）在原生音频支持、长文档理解、长音视频理解与智能体 GUI 操作等真实多模态场景上仍有不足，且推理延迟高、吞吐低、成本效率差。同时，训练全模态 MoE 模型面临模态对齐、训练稳定性、异构数据配比等挑战，易损害基座 LLM 的文本推理能力并引发灾难性遗忘。此外，多模态长序列带来的巨大 token 开销（512 帧视频约 141k 输入 token）严重制约长视频与多文档场景的部署效率。因此需要一个在精度、延迟与吞吐上兼顾的高效开放全模态模型。
AI.method: 架构：encoder–projector–decoder 设计。LLM 为 Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B（MoE 混合骨干，含 Mamba），视觉编码器 C-RADIOv4-H，音频编码器 Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v2 FastConformer，经 MLP projector 连接。关键设计：(1) 骨干由 12B 稠密模型换成 30B-A3B MoE；(2) 原生音频输入（16kHz 单声道、10ms hop log-mel、三层 stride-2 卷积约 8× 时间下采样，约 12.5 token/秒，30 秒切片约 375 token，训练覆盖 0.5 秒–20 分钟）；(3) 动态图像分辨率替代分块（16×16 patch，视觉 token 限制在 1024–13312，pixel shuffle 4× 下采样）；(4) Conv3D 将每 2 帧融合为一个 tubelet，时序 token 减半；(5) 上下文从 128K 扩展到 256K；(6) 视觉/音频 token 按时间顺序交错排列以支持跨模态时序推理。训练：7 阶段 SFT 课程（Stage 0 视觉 projector 预热 9.35M/15.5B；Stage 1 视觉 SFT 86.3M/214.8B；Stage 2 音频 projector 预热 59.2M/11.4B；Stage 3 音频编码器+projector 242M/100.5B；Stage 4 联合 omni SFT 16k 30.5M/57.3B；Stage 5 48k 6.08M/33.5B；Stage 6 256k 超长文档 623K/34.0B；合计约 434.1M 样本/466.9B token），配合 Megatron+TransformerEngine+Energon，TP=2/EP=32，H100 32–128 节点，选择性激活重计算与上下文并行。RL：MPO（DPO+BCO）→ 文本 RL 阶段 1 → 图像 RL（规则验证器 string-match/mathruler/multiple-choice/gui-coordinate，8 次 rollout pass-rate<0.8 过滤）→ Omni RL（120K prompts、113 子数据集、pass-rate 0.1–0.9 过滤、含 ASR 1-WER 奖励）→ 文本 RL 阶段 2，基于 NeMo-RL + Ray、GSPO 算法。推理优化：EVS 在 ViT 后按 tubelet 余弦差异度做空间 token 剪枝（q=0.5~0.95 可调）；量化采用混合精度——MoE 路由专家 NVFP4（FP4 E2M1+分组 FP8 scale+per-tensor FP32 scale），Mamba in/out_proj、共享专家、attention o_proj 走 FP8，其余 BF16，KV cache FP8、SSM state FP32。
AI.result: 视觉：全面超越 Nemotron Nano V2 VL，MMMU 70.8、MathVista-Mini 82.8、MMLongBench-Doc 57.5、OCRBench-V2 67.0/52.7、CharXiv 63.6/88.9、ScreenSpot-v2 92.8、ScreenSpot-Pro 57.8、OSWorld 47.4、VideoMME 72.2，多项领先 Qwen3-Omni。音频：OpenASR 平均 WER 5.95（优于 Qwen3-Omni 6.55）、TED-LIUM-Longform WER 3.11、MMAU 74.6、VoiceBench 89.4（优于 Qwen3-Omni 88.8 与 Qwen3.5-Omni 87.8）。音视频：DailyOmni 74.5、WorldSense 55.2，优于 Qwen3-Omni。文本：基本保持基座水平（MMLU-Pro 77.3 vs 78.3、GPQA 72.2、AIME25 82.1、LiveCodeBench 63.2）。效率：B200 上单流 >500 output tok/s（约 2.4–2.9× 于 Qwen3-Omni、2× 于 V2 VL）；NVFP4 吞吐最高达 18200 tok/s（7.5× BF16）；同交互性下吞吐为 Qwen3-Omni 的 9×（长视频）/7.5×（多文档），为 V2 VL 的 3×；MediaPerf 上成本效率最高的开源视频理解模型。Conv3D+EVS 使 512 帧视频输入 token 从 ~141k 降至 ~42k（-70%），TTFT 从 7969ms 降至 5313ms（-33%，NVFP4 下 6885→5083ms），平均精度仅损失约 0.5 个点；EVS 在 q≤0.7 精度基本持平。量化：FP8/NVFP4 相对 BF16 的中位精度下降 <1%（11 项非 ASR 均值降 0.37/0.40），权重体积 61.5GB→32.8GB→20.9GB（16→8.5→4.98 bpw）。推理预算控制（13K 思考预算）可在多个基准带来 1–3 点增益且不损害其余任务。
AI.conclusion: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 通过 MoE 混合骨干升级、原生音频编码、动态分辨率、Conv3D 时序压缩与 256K 长上下文，结合渐进式多阶段 SFT 与多轮多模态 RL，在文档理解、智能体 GUI 操作、长音视频理解与语音交互等任务上取得领先或竞争性成绩，同时保持基座 LLM 的文本推理能力；配合 token 削减与混合精度量化，实现了显著更低的延迟和数倍于同规模模型的吞吐。团队以 BF16/FP8/NVFP4 三种权重、约 690 万样本训练集（Nemotron-Image-Training-v3）、数据生成流水线、Megatron-Bridge 训练代码与 NeMo-RL 指南形式开源，旨在推动社区在高效全模态建模方向上的研究。

title: BARRED: Synthetic Training of Custom Policy Guardrails via Asymmetric Debate
summary: Deploying guardrails for custom policies remains challenging, as generic safety models fail to capture task-specific requirements, while prompting LLMs suffers from inconsistent boundary-case performance and high inference costs. Training custom classifiers achieves both accuracy and efficiency, yet demands substantial labeled data that is costly to obtain. We present BARRED (Boundary Alignment Refinement through REflection and Debate), a framework for generating faithful and diverse synthetic training data using only a task description and a small set of unlabeled examples. Our approach decomposes the domain space into dimensions to ensure comprehensive coverage, and employs multi-agent debate to verify label correctness, yielding a high-fidelity training corpus. Experiments across diverse custom policies demonstrate that small language models finetuned on our synthetic data consistently outperform state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs (including reasoning models) and dedicated guardrail models. Ablation studies confirm that both dimension decomposition and debate-based verification are critical for ensuring the diversity and label fidelity required for effective fine-tuning. The BARRED framework eliminates the reliance on extensive human annotation, offering a scalable solution for accurate custom guardrails.

AI.tldr: BARRED通过维度分解和多智能体辩论机制，仅使用任务描述和少量无标签样本即可生成高质量合成训练数据，用于微调小型语言模型实现自定义内容安全防护。该方法在多个自定义策略任务上超越了GPT-4等大型专有模型和专用防护模型。
AI.motivation: 现有内容安全方案存在三重困境：(1) 通用安全模型无法捕捉任务特定需求；(2) 提示LLM方法在边界案例上表现不稳定且推理成本高；(3) 训练自定义分类器虽能兼顾准确性和效率，但需要大量昂贵的人工标注数据。
AI.method: BARRED框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 维度分解：将领域空间分解为多个维度以确保数据覆盖的全面性；(2) 多智能体辩论：利用多智能体辩论验证标签正确性，确保生成数据的高保真度。输入仅需任务描述和小规模无标注样本。
AI.result: 在多种自定义策略上的实验表明，使用BARRED合成数据微调的小型语言模型一致性地超越了先进的专有LLM（包括推理模型）和专用防护模型，且保持了更低的推理成本。
AI.conclusion: BARRED消除了对大量人工标注的依赖，为精准自定义内容安全防护提供了一条可扩展的技术路径。

title: PI-TTA: Physics-Informed Source-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Robust Human Activity Recognition on Mobile Devices
summary: Source-free test-time adaptation (TTA) is appealing for mobile and wearable sensing because it enables on-device personalization from unlabeled test streams without centralizing private data. However, sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) poses challenges that are less pronounced in standard vision benchmarks: behavioral inertial streams are temporally correlated and often exhibit within-session shifts caused by sensor rotation, placement change, and sampling-rate drift. Under this streaming non-i.i.d. setting, widely used vision-style TTA objectives can become unstable, leading to overconfident errors, representation collapse, and catastrophic forgetting. We propose PI-TTA, a lightweight source-free adaptation framework that stabilizes online updates through three physics-consistent constraints: gravity consistency, short-horizon temporal continuity, and spectral stability. PI-TTA updates the same small parameter subset as strong source-free baselines and incurs only modest overhead, making it suitable for on-device deployment. Experiments on USCHAD, PAMAP2, and mHealth under long-sequence stress tests and factorized shift protocols show that PI-TTA mitigates the severe degradation observed in confidence-driven baselines and preserves stable adaptation under sustained streaming conditions. It improves long-sequence accuracy by up to 9.13% and reduces physical-violation rates by 27.5%, 24.1%, and 45.4% on USCHAD, PAMAP2, and mHealth, respectively. These results demonstrate that physics-informed adaptation can improve accuracy, stability, and deployment reliability for real-world mobile sensing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对移动/可穿戴传感器的人类活动识别任务，提出名为PI-TTA的无源测试时适应框架。该框架通过引入重力一致性、时间连续性和频谱稳定性三个物理约束来解决传统视觉风格TTA目标在流式非i.i.d.环境下的不稳定性问题。实验表明该方法在多个数据集上显著提升准确率并减少物理违规现象，适合设备端部署。
AI.motivation: 现有无源测试时适应方法在传感器人类活动识别场景中存在不稳定问题：行为惯性数据具有时间相关性，且常出现传感器旋转、位置变化、采样率漂移导致的会话内分布偏移。传统视觉域TTA目标函数在此流式非独立同分布环境下容易产生过度自信错误、表征崩溃和灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出PI-TTA框架，通过三种物理一致性约束实现稳定在线更新：(1)重力一致性；(2)短时域时间连续性；(3)频谱稳定性。该方法仅更新与强基线相同的少量参数子集，计算开销小。
AI.result: 在USCHAD、PAMAP2、mHealth三个数据集上，长序列精度提升最高达9.13%；物理违规率分别降低27.5%、24.1%、45.4%。PI-TTA有效缓解了置信度驱动基线的严重性能退化，在持续流式条件下保持稳定适应能力。
AI.conclusion: PI-TTA通过物理信息约束显著提升了移动传感系统的准确率、稳定性和部署可靠性，为实时设备端个性化学习提供了可行方案。

title: From Threads to Trajectories: A Multi-LLM Pipeline for Community Knowledge Extraction from GitHub Issue Discussions
summary: Resolution of complex post-production issues in large-scale open-source software (OSS) projects requires significant cognitive effort, as developers need to go through long, unstructured and fragmented issue discussion threads before that. In this paper, we present SWE-MIMIC-Bench, an issue trajectory dataset generated from raw GitHub discussions using an automated multi-LLM pipeline. Unlike simple summarization, this pipeline utilizes a group of closed-source LLMs to perform granular tasks: analyzing individual comments with awareness of externally-linked resources, classifying comment analyses into label-specific fields (e.g., root cause, solution plan, implementation progress), and synthesizing label-aware trajectories which capture a structured and coherent narrative of the entire discussion thread. Our pipeline uses five closed-source LLM configurations for distinct purposes: label classification, inline code block and external link summarization, comment analysis, label-specific field classification and trajectory synthesis. By generating concise and reliable trajectories from complex conversation threads, this system can assist developers and researchers of broader software engineering community to understand the experience-driven collaborative approach for issue diagnosis. Furthermore, the generated trajectories can be used to train modern LLM agents to think and act like an expert developer. We evaluated our system on 800 real-world GitHub issues drawn from the SWE-Bench-Pro, SWE-Bench-Multilingual and SWE-Bench-Verified dataset, achieving a 91.7% success rate in extracting 734 high-fidelity reasoning trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SWE-MIMIC-Bench，一个基于多LLM自动化流水线从GitHub讨论中生成的问题轨迹数据集，用于帮助理解和解决大型开源软件项目中的复杂issue。
AI.motivation: 大型开源软件项目的问题解决过程需要开发者投入大量认知努力，因为需要梳理冗长、非结构化且碎片化的issue讨论线程，这严重阻碍了问题诊断效率。
AI.method: 开发了一个多LLM流水线，利用五个闭源LLM配置执行细粒度任务：标签分类、内联代码块和外部链接摘要、评论分析、标签特定字段分类以及轨迹合成。流水线分析评论时具有外部链接资源意识，将评论分类到标签特定字段（如根因、解决方案、实施进度），并合成标签感知轨迹以捕捉整个讨论的结构化叙事。
AI.result: 在800个来自SWE-Bench-Pro、SWE-Bench-Multilingual和SWE-Bench-Verified的真实GitHub issues上评估，成功率达到91.7%，提取出734条高保真推理轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该系统可辅助开发者社区理解经验驱动的协作式问题诊断方法，生成的轨迹还可用于训练现代LLM智能体，使其具备像专家开发者一样思考和行动的能力。

title: Compute Aligned Training: Optimizing for Test Time Inference
summary: Scaling test-time compute has emerged as a powerful mechanism for enhancing Large Language Model (LLM) performance. However, standard post-training paradigms, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), optimize the likelihood of individual samples under a base policy, creating a misalignment with test time procedures that rely on aggregated or filtered outputs. In this work, we propose Compute Aligned Training, which aligns training objectives with test-time strategies. By conceptualizing inference strategies as operators on the base policy, we derive new loss functions that maximize performance when said strategies are applied. We instantiate such loss functions for SFT and RL across common test time strategies. Finally, we provide empirical evidence that this training method substantially improves test time scaling over standard training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"计算对齐训练"(Compute Aligned Training, CAT)，解决传统后训练方法(SFT/RL)与测试时推理策略之间的对齐问题。通过将推理策略建模为基策略上的算子，推导出与常见测试时策略相匹配的损失函数，实现训练目标与推理过程的协同优化。实验表明该方法显著提升测试时计算 scaling 效果。
AI.motivation: 当前后训练范式(SFT和RL)基于单样本似然优化，与测试时依赖聚合/过滤输出的推理策略存在根本性错配。随着测试时计算 scaling 成为提升LLM性能的重要途径，这种训练-推理不一致性问题日益突出。
AI.method: 核心创新在于将推理策略形式化为基策略上的算子，在此框架下推导出新的损失函数。具体为SFT和RL分别设计对应的对齐损失，并覆盖常见的测试时策略(如best-of-N、过滤等)。
AI.result: 实验证明CAT在测试时计算 scaling 方面相较于标准训练方法有实质性改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过使训练目标与测试时策略对齐，CAT有效弥合了训练与推理之间的鸿沟，为释放测试时计算 scaling 的潜力提供了可行的训练范式。

title: Below-Chance Blindness: Prompted Underperformance in Small LLMs Produces Positional Bias Rather than Answer Avoidance
summary: Detecting sandbagging--the deliberate underperformance on capability evaluations--is an open problem in AI safety. We tested whether symptom validity testing (SVT) logic from clinical malingering detection could identify sandbagging through below-chance performance (BCB) on forced-choice items. In a pre-registered pilot at the 7-9 billion parameter instruction-tuned scale (3 models, 4 MMLU-Pro domains, 4 conditions, 500 items per cell, 24,000 total trials), the plausibility gate failed. Zero of 12 model-domain cells showed significant below-chance performance under sandbagging instruction. Exploratory analyses revealed three qualitatively distinct failure modes. Qwen-2.5-7B and Phi-3.5-mini largely ignored the sandbagging instruction, with 62-88% response identity with the honest baseline. Llama-3-8B complied substantially but implemented underperformance as a positional heuristic, collapsing its response distribution onto middle-alphabet options (E at 31.8%, F at 26.1%) regardless of where the correct answer fell. This produced accuracy boosts of up to 33 percentage points when the correct answer coincidentally occupied the model's preferred position. An explicit anti-task instruction ("pick the least likely answer") drove two of three models below chance, with accuracy as low as 0.024. The capability for answer-aware avoidance therefore exists but is not activated by "deliberately underperform." BCB did not fail as a logical marker of answer-aware avoidance. It was not observed in this regime because the model showing the largest behavioural shift exhibited behaviour consistent with a position-dominant response policy rather than content-aware answer avoidance. We propose that positional-distribution shift may be a more effective behavioural signature than below-chance accuracy for detecting prompted underperformance at this model scale.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索使用临床心理学的症状有效性测试(SVT)逻辑检测AI模型在评估中的"放水"(sandbagging)行为。预注册实验(7-9B参数规模,3个模型,4个MMLU-Pro领域)发现零个模型-领域组合表现出显著低于随机水平的性能。文章识别出三种不同的失败模式,并提出位置分布偏移可能比低于随机准确率更适合作为检测该规模下故意表现不佳的行为特征。
AI.motivation: AI安全领域存在一个开放问题:如何检测AI在能力评估中的故意表现不佳(sandbagging)。临床心理学中的症状有效性测试(SVT)方法可能提供解决方案。
AI.method: 预注册先导实验,7-9B参数规模指令微调模型(3个模型),4个MMLU-Pro领域,4种条件,每单元500题,共24000次试验。测试低于随机水平表现(BCP)作为检测放水的指标。
AI.result: 零个模型-领域组合在放水指令下显示显著低于随机的表现。发现三种失败模式:(1)Qwen-2.5-7B和Phi-3.5-mini基本忽略放水指令;(2)Llama-3-8B执行了但采用位置启发式策略,偏好中间字母选项;(3)明确的反任务指令("选择最不可能的答案")使两个模型低于随机水平,准确率低至0.024。
AI.conclusion: 低于随机表现作为逻辑指标本身没有问题,但需激活模型的内容感知回避能力。位置分布偏移可能比低于随机准确率更能有效检测该模型规模下的提示性表现不佳。

title: SciEval: A Benchmark for Automatic Evaluation of K-12 Science Instructional Materials
summary: The need to evaluate instructional materials for K-12 science education has become increasingly important, as more educators use generative AI to create instructional materials. However, the review of instructional materials is time-consuming, expertise-intensive, and difficult to scale, motivating interest in automated evaluation approaches. While large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on general evaluation tasks, their performance and reliability on instructional materials remain unclear. To address this gap, we formulate Automatic Instructional Materials Evaluation (AIME) as a generative AI task that predicts scores and evidence using the rubric designed by the educator. We create a benchmark dataset and develop baseline models for AIME. First, we curate the first AIME dataset, SciEval, consisting of instructional materials annotated with pedagogy-aligned evaluation scores and evidence-based rationales. Expert annotations achieve high inter-rater reliability, resulting in a dataset of 273 lesson-level instructional materials evaluated across 13 criteria (N=3549) using the EQuIP rubric. Second, we test mainstream LLMs (GPT, Gemini, Llama, and Qwen) on SciEval and find that none achieve strong performance. Then we fine-tune Qwen3 on SciEval. Results on a held-out test set show that domain-aligned fine-tuning can achieve up to 11 percent performance gains, highlighting the importance of domain-specific fine-tuning for AIME and facilitating the use of LLMs in other educational tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了自动教学材料评估任务（AIME），构建了首个K-12科学教育材料评估基准数据集SciEval，测试了主流大语言模型并通过领域微调实现了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在K-12科学教育中的广泛应用，教学材料的评估需求日益增长，但人工审查耗时、依赖专业知识且难以规模化，这推动了对自动化评估方法的研究兴趣。
AI.method: 构建了首个AIME基准数据集SciEval，包含273份教学材料，3549条标注数据，涵盖13项评估标准；使用EQuIP评价量规进行评分；测试了GPT、Gemini、Llama、Qwen等主流LLM；基于SciEval对Qwen3进行微调。
AI.result: 主流LLM均未取得良好性能；Qwen3经过领域微调后在测试集上获得最高11%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 领域对齐的微调对AIME任务至关重要，证明了特定领域微调的重要性，为LLM在其他教育任务中的应用奠定了基础。

title: Carbon-Taxed Transformers: A Green Compression Pipeline for Overgrown Language Models
summary: The accelerating adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in software engineering (SE) has brought with it a silent crisis: unsustainable computational cost. While these models demonstrate remarkable capabilities in different SE tasks, they are unmanageably large, slow to deploy, memory-intensive, and carbon-heavy. This reality threatens not only the scalability and accessibility of AI-powered SE, but also its long-term environmental sustainability.
