The research challenge is clear: we must go beyond accuracy and address efficiency and environmental cost as first-class design constraints. To meet this challenge, we introduce Carbon-Taxed Transformers (CTT), a systematic multi-architectural compression principled pipeline ordering inspired by economic carbon taxation principles. Drawing from the economic concept of carbon pricing, CTT operationalizes a computational carbon tax that penalizes architectural inefficiencies and rewards deployment-ready compression. We evaluate CTT across three core SE tasks: code clone detection, code summarization, and code generation, with models spanning encoder-only, encoder-decoder, and decoder-only architecture. Our results show that CTT delivers on inference: (1) up to 49x memory reduction, (2) time reduction up to 8-10x for clone detection, up to 3x for summarization, and 4-7x for generation, (3) up to 81% reduction in CO2 emissions and (4) CTT retains around 98% accuracy on clone detection, around 89% on summarization, and up to 91% (textual metrics) and 68% (pass@1) for generation. Two ablation studies show that pipeline ordering and individual component contributions are both essential, providing empirical justification for CTT's design and effectiveness. This work establishes a viable path toward responsible AI in SE through aggressive yet performance-preserving compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Carbon-Taxed Transformers (CTT)，一种受碳税经济原理启发的多架构压缩流程，通过对计算资源征税来惩罚架构低效、奖励压缩优化。在代码克隆检测、代码摘要和代码生成三个任务上，CTT实现了高达49倍的内存压缩、8-10倍的时间加速、81%的碳排放降低，同时保持约98%的克隆检测准确率、89%的摘要准确率和91%的生成质量。
AI.motivation: LLM在软件工程中的广泛应用带来了隐性危机：不可持续的计算成本。这些模型虽性能出色，但规模过大、部署缓慢、内存密集、碳排放高。这不仅威胁AI驱动SE的可扩展性和可访问性，更影响长期环境可持续性。传统方法仅关注准确性，忽视了效率和环保成本，需要将效率与环保作为核心设计约束。
AI.method: 本文提出Carbon-Taxed Transformers (CTT)——一种受经济碳税原则启发的系统性多架构压缩流程。CTT将计算碳税概念操作化，对架构低效施加惩罚，对部署就绪的压缩给予奖励。方法在三种模型架构（纯编码器、编码器-解码器、解码器）上评估。
AI.result: CTT在三个核心SE任务上取得显著成果：(1)内存压缩高达49倍；(2)时间加速：克隆检测8-10倍、摘要3倍、生成4-7倍；(3)碳排放降低达81%；(4)精度保持：克隆检测约98%、摘要约89%、生成文本指标91%、pass@1达68%。消融实验验证了流程排序和组件贡献的必要性。
AI.conclusion: CTT为负责任AI在软件工程中的应用提供了可行路径，通过激进但保留性能的压缩策略，在效率和环保之间取得平衡。这项工作将效率和环境成本确立为模型设计的一等公民，为绿色AI在SE领域的可持续发展奠定基础。

title: CoreFlow: Low-Rank Matrix Generative Models
summary: Learning matrix-valued distributions from high-dimensional and possibly incomplete training data is challenging: ambient-space generative modeling is computationally expensive and statistically fragile when the matrix dimension is large but the sample size is limited. We propose CoreFlow, a geometry-preserving low-rank flow model that learns shared row/column subspaces across the matrix distribution, and then trains a continuous normalizing flow only on the induced low-dimensional core. CoreFlow is designed for settings where shared low-rank matrix geometry is present, especially in high-dimensional limited-sample regimes. This separates shared matrix geometry from sample-specific variation, preserves matrix structure, and substantially improves training efficiency. The same framework also handles incomplete training matrices through masked Riemannian updates and iterative completion. Across real and synthetic benchmarks, CoreFlow substantially improves spectral and moment-level generation quality in few-sample regimes while remaining competitive in data-rich settings, even under compression to 9% of the ambient dimension and with up to 40% missing training entries.

AI.tldr: CoreFlow 是一种"先学共享低秩几何、再在低维核心空间做流匹配"的两阶段矩阵生成模型：Stage I 用 Stiefel 流形上的梯度下降（QR 回缩）学习跨样本共享的行/列子空间 U、V；Stage II 只在此诱导出的 R×R 核心 S=UᵀMV 上训练连续归一化流（条件流匹配）。缺失数据通过掩码重建损失与交替补全处理。理论上把环境空间生成误差分解为子空间恢复误差 + 核心生成误差 + 不可约噪声项。实验显示其在高维小样本（200×200、300 样本）、极端压缩（1.44%/9% 维度）与 40% 缺失下显著优于环境空间（MissDiff/MissFlow）与几何无关（CSDM/SMG-Core）基线。
AI.motivation: 科学数据常以矩阵形式出现（时空场、传感器网格、医学影像），环境维度可达数万，但训练样本极少（如 Solar Flare 为 200×200=40,000 维、仅 300 个样本）。在环境空间直接训练扩散/流模型不仅计算昂贵，而且在高维少样本下统计上严重欠定。同时许多矩阵分布集中在近似低秩集合附近：跨两模态的依赖导致共享行/列子空间，样本差异主要体现在小得多的核心空间中，即 M_i ≈ U S_i Vᵀ（U、V 共享，S_i 为样本特有）。此外真实矩阵常因传感器掉线或不规则采样而缺失，使得共享几何恢复更困难。此外该问题本质是"无条件生成"而非"条件补全/插补"，这与矩阵补全、SMG 等工作定位不同。
AI.method: 模型化 M = U S Vᵀ，U∈St(m₁,R)、V∈St(m₂,R)、S∈ℝ^{R×R}。Stage I（共享几何）：完全观测时最小化重建损失 L_rec = (1/N)Σ‖M_i − UUᵀM_iVVᵀ‖_F²，用 Tucker 谱初始化（Ĉ_L = (1/N)ΣM_iM_iᵀ 的前 R 个特征向量），在 Stiefel 切空间做投影梯度（G^R = G − W·Sym(WᵀG)）并用 QR 回缩保持正交性；缺失情形引入隐式填充矩阵 M̃_i，在观测掩码上优化 L_miss = (1/N)Σ‖P_Ω(M_i^obs − UUᵀM̃_i VVᵀ)‖²，并与"保持观测、缺失项用当前低秩重建补全"的更新交替进行。Stage II（核心空间流）：固定 (U*,V*)，将每个矩阵映到核心 S = U*ᵀMV*、向量 s = vec(S)∈ℝ^d（d = R²），用条件流匹配（线性插值路径 φ(s,z;t) = (1−t)s + tz，目标速度 z−s）训练时间条件 U-Net 参数化的速度场 v_θ；采样时从 N(0,I_d) 反向积分 Neural ODE（RK4，101 步）得 ŝ，再解码 M̂ = U*·mat(ŝ)·V*ᵀ。可选 patchification（把局部块向量化堆叠为行）以降低有效秩。理论部分：假设 M = U₀S₀V₀ᵀ + E，证明 Stage I 总体最优解可精确恢复真子空间（至多正交旋转）；Tucker 初始化在经验二阶矩准确时主角误差受控；由 Xu et al. 的流匹配 χ² 控制得核心空间 χ²(p_s*‖p̂_s) ≤ C_F ε；最终 W₂(p̂_M, p_M) ≤ √R·C_S(sinΘ(U*,U₀)+sinΘ(V*,V₀)) + e^{L_v}√(2C_F ε) + √min(m₁,m₂)·τ。
AI.result: 真实数据（Solar/Solar 2: 200×200, N=300；LSPF: 80×80, N=8760）与合成数据（Blobs/Bands/Waves/Crosshatch: 200×200, R=24, N=1000），缺失率 p_miss∈{0,20,40}%。(1) Solar 平均奇异值偏差（×10⁻²）：CoreFlow 1.27/1.57/2.76，MissDiff 9.57/48.2/89.3，MissFlow 7.63/37.3/75.7——全空间基线随缺失率急剧劣化，CoreFlow 轻微劣化。(2) 合成数据在 1.44% 极端压缩下 CoreFlow 为 0.43~9.09，而同维度 CSDM 高达 89~559、SMG-Core 18.9~254。(3) 同压缩率（9%）对比中 CoreFlow 显著优于 CSDM 与 SMG-Core，说明增益不仅来自降维，还来自矩阵结构感知的 USVᵀ 表示。(4) 主角诊断显示即使 40% 缺失，核心子空间恢复仍准确（平均角多在 1° 内）。(5) 训练成本：Solar 上 9% 维度总时 8.47~12.90 min（Stage I 3.17~8.85 + Stage II 4.05），对比环境空间基线 37.70 min；LSPF 上 49% 维度 41.56~52.93 min vs 83.20 min。PCA-Flow 消融显示：完整数据下低维流建模本身有效（但谱指标略逊），但扁平 PCA 无法处理缺失数据，且整体弱于 USVᵀ 表示。
AI.conclusion: CoreFlow 通过"共享低秩几何 + 核心空间连续流"的两阶段设计，把高维矩阵生成转化为低维生成，既保留了矩阵结构（USVᵀ）又大幅降低训练维度，从而在高维少样本、极端压缩与大量缺失三种困难条件下同时提升生成质量与效率，且在数据充足时仍保持竞争力。理论上给出了几何误差与生成误差的显式分离与端到端 W₂ 界。主要局限：仅在存在共享低秩几何时最有效（依赖 patchification 缓解但未根治）；理论仅覆盖完全观测下的总体模型，缺失情形下的统计恢复理论留待后续；Stage I 为独立两阶段且采用交替补全，误差会传递到 Stage II。

title: Learning from Medical Entity Trees: An Entity-Centric Medical Data Engineering Framework for MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown transformative potential in medical applications, yet their performance is hindered by conventional data curation strategies that rely on coarse-grained partitioning by modality or department. Such fragmented approaches fail to capture the hierarchical and interconnected nature of clinical medical knowledge, limiting the models' ability to perform fine-grained recognition and complex reasoning. In this paper, we propose a novel Entity-Centric Medical Data Engineering framework. We automatically extract entities from authoritative medical literature to construct a Medical Entity Tree (MET), a hierarchical structure that systematically encodes diseases, anatomical structures, modalities, and symptoms into a unified knowledge repository. Building upon the MET, we propose an advanced data engine that includes: (1) node-guided retrieval to anchor raw data to specific medical concepts, (2) a two-stage hybrid filtering and alignment pipeline to ensure precise visual-semantic correspondence, and (3) knowledge-aware data synthesis to generate enriched captions and targeted reasoning VQA pairs, leveraging structural constraints. Extensive evaluations across six medical benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances the medical capabilities of general-purpose MLLMs, improving their ability to handle complex clinical queries and achieve state-of-the-art performance in diverse medical contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以实体为中心的医学数据工程框架，通过构建医学实体树（MET）来组织医学知识，并在此基础上开发了节点引导检索、混合过滤对齐和知识感知数据合成等数据引擎，显著提升了多模态大语言模型在医学领域的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有医学多模态大语言模型受限于传统的粗粒度数据管理策略（如按模态或科室划分），无法捕捉临床医学知识的层次性和关联性，导致模型在细粒度识别和复杂推理任务上表现不佳。
AI.method: 1) 从权威医学文献中自动提取实体构建医学实体树(MET)，系统编码疾病、解剖结构、模态和症状；2) 基于MET开发节点引导检索锚定原始数据；3) 两阶段混合过滤对齐管道确保视觉-语义精确对应；4) 知识感知数据合成生成丰富描述和目标推理VQA对
AI.result: 在六个医学基准数据集上的广泛评估表明，该方法显著增强了通用MLLMs的医学能力，提升了处理复杂临床查询的能力，在多种医学场景下达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过实体中心的知识组织方式和知识驱动的数据工程，医学多模态大语言模型能够更好地理解和处理复杂的医学信息，为构建更专业的医疗AI系统提供了新的范式。

title: Improving Zero-Shot Offline RL via Behavioral Task Sampling
summary: Offline zero-shot reinforcement learning (RL) aims to learn agents that optimize unseen reward functions without additional environment interaction. The standard approach to this problem trains task-conditioned policies by sampling task vectors that define linear reward functions over learned state representations. In most existing algorithms, these task vectors are randomly sampled, implicitly assuming this adequately captures the structure of the task space. We argue that doing so leads to suboptimal zero-shot generalization. To address this limitation, we propose extracting task vectors directly from the offline dataset and using them to define the task distribution used for policy training. We introduce a simple and general reward function extraction procedure that integrates into existing offline zero-shot RL algorithms. Across multiple benchmark environments and baselines, our approach improves zero-shot performance by an average of 20%, highlighting the importance of principled task sampling in offline zero-shot RL.

AI.tldr: 本文针对离线零样本强化学习中任务向量随机采样的问题，提出从离线数据集中直接提取任务向量的方法，通过更合理地定义任务分布提升策略的零样本泛化能力，实验验证该方法可带来约20%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有离线零样本强化学习算法中，任务向量通常采用随机采样策略，这未能充分捕捉任务空间的结构，导致零样本泛化性能次优。
AI.method: 从离线数据集中提取任务向量，并以此定义策略训练的任务分布。该方法作为即插即用模块，可集成到现有离线零样本RL算法中。
AI.result: 在多个基准环境和基线算法上，平均提升零样本性能约20%。
AI.conclusion: 通过从离线数据集中直接提取任务向量来定义任务分布，有效解决了随机采样任务向量导致的分布偏移问题。该方法作为即插即用的模块，可与现有离线零样本RL算法无缝集成，实验表明该方法具有较强的通用性和有效性。

title: Odysseys: Benchmarking Web Agents on Realistic Long Horizon Tasks
summary: Existing web agent benchmarks have largely converged on short, single-site tasks that frontier models are approaching saturation on. However, real world web use consists of long-horizon, multi-site workflows. Common web navigation tasks, such as comparing products across different domains, planning trips across multiple services, or summarizing information from multiple search queries, require sustained context and cross-site reasoning over potentially hours of browsing. To capture and evaluate such behaviors, we introduce Odysseys: a benchmark of 200 long-horizon web tasks derived from real world browsing sessions evaluated on the live Internet. We find that binary pass/fail evaluation is inadequate for long-horizon settings and introduce a rubric-based evaluation, annotating each Odysseys task with an average of 6.1 graded rubrics. We demonstrate that this yields higher agreement with humans and provides a more fine-grained signal than commonly used trajectory-level LLM-as-a-judge evaluation metrics. We tested several leading frontier models and find that the strongest models achieve a success rate of 44.5%, which leaves substantial room for future improvements. Beyond task success, we argue that efficiency is a first-class concern for long-horizon agents. We introduce a Trajectory Efficiency metric (rubric score per step) and find that even frontier agents achieve only 1.15%, marking an evident need for agents that can succeed efficiently and not simply eventually. Odysseys isolates the critical evaluation of long-horizon proficiency in open-web environments, providing a realistic benchmark to measure progress towards computer-use agents that can potentially productively operate for hours. We release our tasks, evaluation scripts, and other results at https://odysseys-website.pages.dev

AI.tldr: Odysseys 是卡内基梅隆大学（CMU）Jang、Koh、Fried、Salakhutdinov 等人提出的长程网页智能体基准，包含 200 个基于真实用户浏览历史（Prolific 招募 248 名美英参与者，标注 2,380 条 Chrome journey）构造的多站点长任务，在真实互联网（OSWorld 虚拟 Ubuntu + Chrome）上评测。采用基于 rubric 的分级评估（平均每任务 6.1 条、共 1,225 条 rubric），与人类标注一致性显著高于轨迹级 LLM-as-a-judge（Cohen's κ 0.788/0.849 vs 0.508）。最强模型 Opus 4.6 完美成功率仅 44.5%（200 步预算下可达 76.5%），轨迹效率指标（rubric 分/步）最高仅 1.15%，表明长程网页操作仍远未解决。
AI.motivation: 现有网页/计算机使用智能体基准（如 WebArena、VisualWebArena、Online-Mind2Web、WebVoyager、Mind2Web 等）已收敛到短时、单站点、二元 pass/fail 的任务，前沿模型正在逼近饱和；而真实世界的网页使用本质上是长程（可达数小时）、跨多个站点的工作流，例如跨电商比价、跨旅行与政府服务规划行程、多轮搜索后汇总信息。这类任务要求智能体维持长期上下文、跨异构网站推理、将开放式目标分解为子问题，并判断何时停止探索并产出交付物。同时，轨迹级 LLM-as-a-judge 的单一二元打分在长轨迹上噪声大、不可靠，且为每个任务手写执行式奖励难以扩展。此外，长程任务中"最终成功但耗数十/上百步"的用户体验极差（如 100 步约需 30 分钟墙钟时间），效率需被当作一等公民指标。故本文提出 Odysseys：真实浏览行为驱动、基于 rubric 的细粒度评估，并同时度量效率。
AI.method:
**数据构建**：招募 248 名美英参与者，通过桌面应用读取 Chrome 历史，用 Chrome Journey 算法切分为任务与 URL，参与者在界面中完成四步标注（关键成功 URL、自动化偏好、任务标签、可行性），得 2,380 条 journey；经 LLM 四维筛查（标签准确性/可行性/是否需登录/总体质量，发现 71.8% 原始标签与 URL 不符）+ 作者人工复核后保留 696 条（29.2%）。

**任务合成**：对 journey 标签用 text-embedding-3-small 嵌入、UMAP 降维至 15 维、HDBSCAN 聚类，构建 theme graph（连接质心余弦相似度适中的簇），随机选种子簇做 1–2 跳 BFS 取 3–6 个簇、每簇抽 3–4 条形成 12–24 条候选，用 GPT-5.4 排序串联成多步工作流，并一次性生成自然语言 prompt、步骤计划、带验证流程的 rubric 与自评连贯性分数（要求：至少 2 个网站、≥30% 步骤依赖前序输出、地理一致、真实人语气）。单个 journey 最多复用 3 次；作者人工检查每条链式 Odyssey 并去重；剔除跨站不足 2、rubric 不完整、连贯性 <2/5 者。另由作者手工撰写 30 条任务，并用 LLM 管线（GPT-5.4 以人类任务为 in-context 示例重写 2,380 条 journey，产出 567 个候选，经 GPT-5.4 裁判过滤 + 人工 QA）补充 80 条 hard 任务，共 200 条。

**难度划分**：按步数与域跨度——easy（≤5 步且 ≤3 域，45 条）、medium（6–8 步或 4+ 域，46 条）、hard（两者皆超，109 条）。

**CUAfied 改写与 QA**：将抽象的信息搜集式描述改写为自然对话式第一人称请求，注入具体站点与参数（邮编、价格区间、筛选条件）、浏览器可见证据要求（保留标签页、加入购物车、并排比较），并同步重生成 rubric/步骤/依赖/交付物；随后两轮审查（人工核查连贯性、溯源至源 journey、rubric 可判定性、清除 PII；LLM+网络搜索核查站点可达性与步骤可行性， flagged 项人工裁定）。

**Rubric 评估**：每个 rubric 含 requirement（单一可验证检查点）与 verification（判定方法），3–12 条/任务，平均 6.1；judge（gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview）针对每条 rubric 独立判定，输入任务上下文、完整动作历史与全部时序截图，输出 success/failure 二值；报告 averaged 与 perfect（全部满足才为 1）两种分数。

**Trajectory Efficiency**：Traj. Eff. = (1/N) Σ s_i/n_i，s_i 为任务 i 的平均 rubric 分，n_i 为步数（LLM 调用次数）。因无 oracle 最优步数，无法像 VLN 的 SPL 那样归一化。

**实验**：OSWorld runner + Chrome，最多 100 步（Opus 100 步约 30 分钟、约 $2.5/任务），最高推理强度；评测 API 模型（Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4、Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4-mini）与开源权重模型（Qwen-3.5-9B/4B/35B-A3B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B）。人工一致性研究：标注 120 条 Opus 4.6 轨迹的 rubric 满足情况，对比 Online-Mind2W 轨迹级 judge，并做 200 步扩展实验。
AI.result:
**主结果**：Opus 4.6 最强，averaged rubric 68.9%、perfect 44.5%、81.3 步、Traj. Eff. 1.06%；GPT-5.4 55.4%/33.5%、仅 33.5 步、Traj. Eff. 1.15%（步数更少，Pareto 更优）；Sonnet 4.6 49.8%/31.0%、80.4 步；GPT-5.4-mini 38.4%/10.5%。开源模型显著落后：Qwen-3.5-9B 42.6%/13.5%、4B 42.9%/10.7%、35B-A3B 28.5%/6.5%、UI-TARS-1.5-7B 10.0%/1.0%。

**评估有效性**：rubrics(averaged) κ=0.788、F1=0.949、准确率 0.923；rubrics(perfect) κ=0.849、F1=0.934；Online-M2W 轨迹级 judge 仅 κ=0.508、F1=0.762、准确率 0.752。rubric 可给出弱模型部分得分，为 RL 提供密集奖励信号。

**难度与步数扩展**：hard 任务上 Opus 平均 rubric 53.2、perfect 仅 11.0%（GPT-5.4 为 33.8/3.7%）。所有模型呈 S 型扩展曲线，前 ~15 步近零，20–70 步上升，~80 步后趋平。Opus 提到 200 步时 perfect 从 44.5%→76.5%（86/200→153/200），仍有 14.5% 触顶，乐观上界 86.0%，Traj. Eff. 1.08% 基本不变；同任务集上 Qwen-3.5-9B 从 100→200 步零增长（1/76→1/76，乐观上界 11.8%），说明差距源于能力而非步数预算。

**失败模式**：Opus 以"过度研究"失败（6/12 零分运行为只收集信息不产出交付物，39% 任务触顶 100 步；部分得分运行平均 97.4 步）；GPT-5.4 以"该做不做"失败（4/7 零分运行为制定详细正确计划后输出空动作终止）；两者共有的"高扇出"失败（需访问 10–30 个场所的任务全部零分，卡在第一阶段）；200 步下额外出现"放弃 UI 改用脚本捷径失败"。

**意外能力**：GPT-5.4 将表格编码为 base64 嵌入 Python 动作、运行时解码经剪贴板批量粘贴入表格（8 次运行）；页面 JS 渲染失败时用 view-source: + ctrl+f 从 JSON-LD 提取变体/库存元数据（23 次）。Opus 在 403 时回退 Wayback Machine 取存档页；重度使用中键后台标签（131 次 vs GPT-5.4 的 7 次）；用 ctrl+f 的"零匹配"作为页面无关的判据来证伪假设。

**伦理与局限**：任务为只读/低影响交互（浏览、搜索、比较），不含真实下单或提交表单；已识别 view-source 元数据提取、Wayback 绕过访问限制等可能被滥用的涌现行为，需遵守服务条款与 robots.txt；仅发布去标识化任务与 rubric，不发布原始浏览历史。
AI.conclusion: Odysseys 证明现有短时单站点基准与轨迹级 LLM-as-a-judge 评估无法覆盖真实长程网页使用：基于真实浏览数据的 200 个多站点长任务配上 rubric 级细粒度评估（κ 最高 0.849，显著优于轨迹 judge 的 0.508），为长程能力提供了可扩展、与人类判断更一致的度量，并可提供 RL 所需的密集奖励。当前长程网页操作仍未解决：最强模型 100 步下完美成功率仅 44.5%，hard 任务骤降至 11.0%，即便 200 步预算也仅 76.5%；轨迹效率最高 1.15%，说明"最终完成"与"高效完成"之间存在巨大差距。核心瓶颈是长上下文规划、跨站连贯性维持、高扇出任务的努力分配（子智能体/多智能体是有前景方向）以及"信息收集→交付物产出"的落地能力；测试时算力扩展只对强能力模型有效，无法弥补能力差距。未来方向包括以 rubric 奖励做强化学习、推理时搜索、以及多动作批处理等效率导向技术（GPT-5.4 平均每次调用 2.03 个动作、轮次数为 Opus 的一半，提示多动作批处理是实用的效率路径）。

title: LegalMidm: Use-Case-Driven Legal Domain Specialization for Korean Large Language Model
summary: In recent years, the rapid proliferation of open-source large language models (LLMs) has spurred efforts to turn general-purpose models into domain specialists. However, many domain-specialized LLMs are developed using datasets and training protocols that are not aligned with the nuanced requirements of real-world applications. In the legal domain, where precision and reliability are essential, this lack of consideration limits practical utility. In this study, we propose a systematic training framework grounded in the practical needs of the legal domain, with a focus on Korean law. We introduce LegalMidm, a Korean legal-domain LLM, and present a methodology for constructing high-quality, use-case-driven legal datasets and optimized training pipelines. Our approach emphasizes collaboration with legal professionals and rigorous data curation to ensure relevance and factual accuracy, and demonstrates effectiveness in key legal tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LegalMidm，一个面向韩国的法律领域大语言模型，通过与法律专业人士协作、严格数据筛选，构建高质量法律数据集和优化训练流程，解决通用LLM在法律领域应用中的精度和可靠性问题。
AI.motivation: 当前开源LLM转向专业领域时，往往缺乏对实际应用场景的细致考量。在法律领域，精确性和可靠性至关重要，现有领域专用模型的不适配性限制了其实用价值。
AI.method: 提出系统性训练框架，强调与法律专业人士合作，通过严格的数据筛选构建高质量、面向用例的法律数据集，并设计优化的训练流程。
AI.result: 成功开发LegalMidm韩国法律领域LLM，在关键法律任务上展现有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架和方法论能够有效支撑法律领域LLM的开发，为法律AI应用提供了实践参考。

title: PHISHREV: A Hybrid Machine Learning and Post-Hoc Non-monotonic Reasoning Framework for Context-Aware Phishing Website Classification
summary: Phishing detection systems are predominantly rely on statistical machine learning models, which often lack contextual reasoning and are vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates machine learning classifiers with non-monotonic reasoning using Answer Set Programming (ASP) to enable context-aware decision refinement. The proposed post-hoc reasoning layer incorporates expert knowledge to revise classifier predictions through formal belief revisions. Experimental results indicate that the reasoning module modifies 5.08\% of classifier outputs, leading to improved decision consistency. A key advantage is that new domain knowledge can be incorporated into the reasoning layer in $\mathcal{O}(n)$ time, eliminating the need for model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两阶段混合框架（PHISHREV / CoGReV）：先用 SVM、KNN、决策树、随机森林等统计分类器生成初始预测与钓鱼类概率，再用 Answer Set Programming (Clingo) 实现一个"置信度门控（confidence-gated）的可废止（defeasible）规则"作为事后（post-hoc）推理层，仅当"预测为钓鱼 + 页面存在 meta 标签 + 分类器置信度低（0.5 < P ≤ 0.5+τ）"三条件同时满足时，才将预测由"钓鱼"翻转为"合法"。τ=0.12 仅在训练集上通过 5 折交叉验证按"最差分类器召回率下降 < 0.5pp"的约束选出并冻结。核心贡献不是提升分类准确率，而是证明新的领域知识可以在不重训模型的前提下以 O(n) 复杂度注入推理层，从而降低误报、缓解分析员告警疲劳。
AI.motivation: 钓鱼检测中，机器学习分类器是自动化第一道防线，但会产生大量误报（false positive），而误报在运维安全场景中代价极高：过多警报导致分析员"告警疲劳"，进而忽视真实威胁，削弱人机协同的可信度。与此同时，攻击者可使用混淆、错拼（typosquatting）、伪造 meta 字段等手段规避静态特征模型，任何新型攻击模式都要求重新训练模型，训练成本高且知识更新滞后。传统缓解手段（代价敏感学习、全局阈值调整）作用在模型本身而非模型输出，无法事后、显式地引入上下文证据。非单调推理（NMR）与信念修正（belief revision）恰能提供"当新证据或矛盾证据出现时撤回/修正结论"的能力：它不同于纯统计相关性学习，可将领域知识以符号规则形式注入，在信息不完整或演化的真实环境中给出可解释、可审计的决策修正。论文的核心动机因此是"事后可修正性"与"人机协同中的功能分配"：把不确定的样本交由推理层处理，把确定的样本留给分类器，从而在不牺牲检测率的前提下降低人工审查负担。
AI.method:
方法为两阶段串联的混合框架。
（1）第一阶段（统计学习与初始信念生成）：数据集共 11430 条 URL（80:20 划分，训练 9144 / 测试 2286），87 维特征用 StandardScaler 归一化；模型为 SVM、KNN、决策树 (DT)、随机森林 (RF)，超参数经训练集 5 折交叉验证网格搜索选定（SVM: C∈{0.1,1,10}、linear/rbf 核；KNN: N∈{3,5,7,9}、uniform/distance、euclidean/manhattan；DT: gini/entropy、深度 {3,5,10,None}、min_samples {2,5,10}；RF: 估计器 {100,200}、深度 {5,10,None}）。每个实例产生初始信念 B0(CL, u_i)（标签 C∈{0,1}）与钓鱼类概率 P(CL, ID)，SVM 用 Platt 缩放分数近似概率。
（2）第二阶段（ASP 事后推理层）：以实例级（而非聚合统计）知识库编码事实：pred(CL,ID,C)、meta(ID,M)（M∈{yes,no}），并由置信度门控生成 conf_low(CL,ID)：当 0.5 < P(CL,ID) ≤ 0.5+τ 时置真。用 Clingo 实现可废止规则（式1）：当 C=phishing ∧ M=yes ∧ conf_low 时结论翻转为 benign，否则保留原预测。
（3）置信度门控与 τ 的选择：元数据是弱且可伪造的证据，若允许其推翻所有钓鱼预测必然不安全；门控仅让低置信（贴近决策边界）的预测下沉到推理层，高置信预测不被干预，这本质上是一种"函数分配"机制，与带拒绝选项的选择性预测（selective prediction）不同之处在于此处不是弃权而是转交符号推理层处理。τ 仅在训练集上用 5 折 out-of-fold 预测做网格搜索，以召回率保持约束选最大可行值：τ* = max{τ : ΔRecall_train(τ) ≤ 0.5pp}，得 τ=0.12（训练召回下降 0.44pp，τ=0.14 时为 0.61pp 超限），随后冻结用于测试集。
（4）新增上下文特征 meta_info_present：作者自行解析抓取网页，记录 description/keyword/author 等 meta 字段是否存在。统计显示合法类 meta 存在率约 50.5%（2887/5715），钓鱼类仅 9.95%（569/5715）。
（5）复杂度分析：第一阶段 RF 训练 O(T·n·f·log n)；第二阶段生成事实与 Clingo 求交均为 O(n)，新增领域知识无需重训。
AI.result:
第一阶段基线（测试集）：SVM 准确率 96.32%（F1 0.96）、RF 95.89%、KNN 95.18%、DT 93.83%。
第二阶段：τ=0.12 门控下四个分类器共修订 25 条预测（占 9144 次分类器级决策的约 0.27%），其中 RF 18、KNN 5、SVM 1、DT 1——修订集中在靠近决策边界的分类器上，校准良好的 SVM 几乎不被改写。
误报/漏报：四分类器合计 FP 由 206 降至 191（减少 15 次误报），FN 由 223 升至 233（新增 10 个漏报）；各分类器召回率均保持在基线 0.7 个百分点以内（如 RF 0.9536→0.9606），精度普遍提升（RF 0.9573→0.9655，KNN 0.9583→0.9617，DT 0.9395→0.9403，SVM 0.9641→0.9640）。
消融（Fig. 2，τ 对数轴扫描）：无门控极限 τ=0.5 时修订 465 条，FP 降至 147，但 FN 由 223 飙至 629（召回下降约 9 个百分点）；τ*=0.12 仅引入 10 个 FN，消除了约 98% 的漏报代价，同时保留了相当比例的误报削减。SOTA 对比表：先前工作（Hannousse、Adane、Shafin 等）均为单调学习且无事后 ASP 推理，PHISHREV 首次引入非单调事后推理，NMR 开销 O(n)、无需重训，但 RF 准确率 95.89% 略低于对手的 96.50%–96.76%。
需注意的不一致：给定摘要称"推理模块修改了 5.08% 的分类器输出"，而正文（表 III、Table V 附近）为 25/9144 ≈ 0.27%；摘要标题为 PHISHREV，而 arXiv 全文标题为 CoGReV（Confidence-Gated Post-Hoc Non-Monotonic Belief Revision）。摘要中的 5.08% 与正文结果无法对应，可能来自早期版本或另一设定。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出并验证了一个"机器学习分类器 + ASP 非单调推理层"的混合钓鱼检测框架，其关键设计是置信度门控的可废止信念修正规则：把不确定决策交由推理层、把确定决策留给分类器，在仅修订约 0.27% 决策的前提下将总误报从 206 降至 191、漏报仅从 223 增至 233，从而在不牺牲钓鱼召回的前提下减少分析员告警疲劳，并支持以 O(n) 时间将新的领域知识（如新型规避策略、合法性更新信号）注入推理层而无需重训模型。作者也明确了局限：框架目前仅依赖单一的元数据规则，攻击者若在低置信钓鱼页面中注入可信元数据，仍可能造成错误修订；未来工作方向是引入多规则推理策略以整合更多上下文证据。此外，公开钓鱼数据集中大量 URL 报告后即失效，限制了 meta 标签的提取规模。整体而言，该工作的价值在于证明"事后符号推理可作为轻量、可解释、可热更新的补丁层叠加在既有分类器之上"，而非刷新分类准确率指标。

title: Faithfulness-QA: A Counterfactual Entity Substitution Dataset for Training Context-Faithful RAG Models
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models frequently produce answers grounded in parametric memory rather than the retrieved context, undermining the core promise of retrieval augmentation. A fundamental obstacle to fixing this unfaithfulness is the lack of training data that explicitly requires models to prefer context over internal knowledge. We introduce Faithfulness-QA, a large-scale dataset of 99,094 samples constructed through counterfactual entity substitution. Starting from two established extractive QA benchmarks--SQuAD and TriviaQA--we automatically identify answer-bearing named entities in each context, replace them with type-consistent alternatives drawn from a curated bank of 76,953 entities, and thereby manufacture controlled knowledge conflicts between context and parametric memory. Rigorous quality filtering ensures 100% pass rates across four automated checks on random 200-sample audits. We release the full dataset, the construction pipeline, and a typed entity bank covering eight named entity categories. Faithfulness-QA is designed as a training resource for attention-based faithfulness objectives and as an evaluation benchmark for measuring context-grounding behavior in RAG systems. Data and code are available at https://github.com/qzhangFDU/faithfulness-qa-dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Faithfulness-QA 数据集，通过反事实实体替换方法构造知识冲突场景，用于训练和评估 RAG 模型是否优先依赖检索上下文而非内部参数记忆。数据集包含99,094样本，基于SQuAD和TriviaQA构建，使用76,953个实体的精选词库替换命名实体，并通过严格质量过滤确保100%通过率。
AI.motivation: RAG模型普遍存在"不忠实性"问题——倾向于依赖内部参数记忆而非检索到的上下文，违背了检索增强的核心目标。根本原因是缺乏明确要求模型"优先选择上下文而非内部知识"的训练数据。
AI.method: 1. 基于SQuAD和TriviaQA两个抽取式QA基准数据集；2. 自动识别上下文中的答案承载命名实体；3. 从包含76,953个实体的精选词库中提取类型一致的替代实体；4. 通过实体替换制造受控的知识冲突；5. 四项自动化检查 + 200样本随机审计进行质量过滤。
AI.result: 构建了包含99,094样本的大规模数据集，覆盖八种命名实体类别，达到100%检查通过率。发布内容：完整数据集、构建流水线代码、八类命名实体的类型化实体库。
AI.conclusion: Faithfulness-QA 可作为注意力机制的忠实性训练目标和RAG系统上下文依赖行为的评估基准。该数据集通过自动化流水线实现了大规模高质量知识冲突样本的批量生产，为解决RAG不忠实性问题提供了数据基础设施。

title: Automated Adversarial Collaboration for Advancing Theory Building in the Cognitive Sciences
summary: Cognitive science often evaluates theories through narrow paradigms and local model comparisons, limiting the integration of evidence across tasks and realizations. We introduce an automated adversarial collaboration framework for adjudicating among competing theories even when the candidate models and experiments must be discovered during the adjudication process. The system combines LLM-based theory agents, program synthesis, and information-theoretic experimental design in a closed loop. In a simulation study spanning three classic categorization theories, the framework recovered the ground-truth theory across noise settings with weaker reliability in the hardest settings. Together, the framework and findings provide a concrete proof of concept for closed-loop, in-silico theory adjudication in cognitive science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"自动化对抗性协作"框架，用大语言模型（LLM）代理分别扮演相互竞争的认知理论，通过程序合成（GeCCo）实例化候选模型，并借助基于期望信息增益（EIG）的实验设计在闭环中迭代地"辩论"与判别理论，从而在候选模型和实验都需在判别过程中被发现的条件下实现理论裁决。模拟研究以三种经典分类理论（GCM、RULEX、SUSTAIN）为真值，在不同噪声（lapse rate 0–0.4）下测试回收率：GCM 全噪声水平完全回收，SUSTAIN 除最高噪声外均高度可回收，RULEX 在 ε>0.1 后不可回收。
AI.motivation: 认知科学的理论构建长期受限于狭窄的实验范式与局部模型比较，难以跨任务、跨实现方式整合证据，形成更广义、可泛化的理论（Marr & Vaina 1982; van Rooij & Baggio 2021）。以往"科学规模化"工作多聚焦单个环节（行为数据采集、计算建模、最优实验设计），而 Jagadish et al. (2026) 提出的"in-silico 心之科学"愿景虽涵盖实验设计、合成数据、模型合成与批判式迭代，却未解决理论裁决（theory adjudication）问题——即如何把相互竞争的理論主张映射为可执行的模型候选，并通过合适的实验迭代加以区分。作者因此把社会科学/心理学中的"对抗性协作"（adversarial collaboration, Latham et al. 1988; Gilovich et al. 1998; Mellers et al. 2001）迁移到 in-silico 情境，作为迈向自动化理论裁决的第一步。
AI.method: 每次运行首先注册多个 LLM 理论代理（使用 Anthropic Sonnet-4 实例化 GeCCo），每个代理绑定一条理论主张及一个或多个候选模型；候选模型由程序合成系统 GeCCo 自动生成（亦可替换为其他程序合成方法或手工模型）。随后进入对抗性辩论循环：每轮先对各模型预测做差异分析，形成"分歧图（divergence map）"摘要；代理基于该摘要提出新实验提案，通过结构性有效性校验的提案进入实验池；系统用期望信息增益（EIG, Cavagnaro et al. 2010; Myung et al. 2013）从池中选择最具信息量的下一个实验执行。实验结果在本模拟中由已知真值认知模型生成（原则上可来自认知基础模型或真实被试）。观测到预测与结果后更新各理论的后验信念，循环返回 LLM 阶段：代理解释结果、批判竞争理论，并可修订模型参数与辅助主张。最终周期结束后，系统汇总实验结果与辩论轨迹，判断哪些理论主张与模型实例获得证据支持；所得证据记录可回灌 GeCCo 生成新候选模型进入下一轮，从而形成开放的模型与实验设计空间闭环。评估设置：三个理论家族（GCM、RULEX、SUSTAIN）分别为真值，在四档噪声（lapse 概率 ε 从 0 到 0.4，以 ε 概率随机作答）下生成合成项目级行为数据；指标为正确理论家族的回收比例，以及两个主要竞争模型之间的带符号胜出边际（signed winning margin）。
AI.result: 无噪声条件下框架能完美回收三种真值理论对应的模型；含噪声条件下回收率因理论类型而异。GCM 在所有噪声设定下均被完美回收；SUSTAIN 保持高度可回收，仅在最高噪声水平失效；RULEX 的可回收性迅速衰减，在 ε>0.1 时已无法回收。带符号胜出边际呈现类似模式：GCM 与 SUSTAIN 在大部分噪声范围内相对竞争模型保持正向分离，而 RULEX 的边际快速收缩并转为负值。作者据此指出 GeCCo 在生成 GCM/SUSTAIN 风格模型时存在偏好偏差，但只要底层信号足够强，系统仍能克服这种偏差找到真值理论。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了认知科学中首个 in-silico、闭环式理论裁决系统的概念验证：在模型与实验设计空间均开放的条件下，系统能够对多个理论家族做出正确判别，但不同模型类别的回收表现不均衡，对 RULEX 存在持续脆弱性，说明成败既取决于裁决循环本身，也取决于合成候选模型本身的可回收性。因此这并非自动化理论构建的完整方案，而是把模型合成与实验设计紧密联结的一步。后续计划以更强的人类行为模拟器（如 Binz et al. 2025）替代手工认知模型，并最终接入真实人类行为数据。

title: Laplace-Bridged Randomized Smoothing for Fast Certified Robustness
summary: Randomized Smoothing (RS) offers formal $\ell_2$ guarantees for arbitrary base classifiers but faces two key practical bottlenecks: (i) it often relies on noise-augmented training to achieve nontrivial certificates, which increases training cost, can reduce clean accuracy, and weakens RS as a genuinely post-hoc defense; and (ii) certification is computationally expensive, typically requiring tens of thousands of noisy forward passes per input, which hinders deployment, especially on resource-constrained edge devices. To address both limitations, we propose Laplace-Bridged Smoothing (LBS), an analytic reformulation of RS that replaces high-dimensional input-space Monte Carlo (MC) sampling with efficient computations in a low-dimensional probability space. LBS preserves formal robustness guarantees without requiring noise-augmented training while substantially reducing certification burden. On CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, LBS attains stronger certified robustness than RS and reduces per-sample certification cost by nearly an order of magnitude. Notably, on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano and Raspberry Pi 4, LBS achieves speedups of up to $494\times$, enabling practical certified deployment on real-world edge devices. Finally, we provide theoretical justification for the analytic formulation and certificate validity of LBS.

AI.tldr: LBS（阿普拉斯桥接随机平滑）把随机平滑（RS）的认证过程从高维输入空间的蒙特卡洛采样，解析重构为低维概率单纯形（Dirichlet）空间中的采样：仅需一次前向传播即可通过 Laplace 近似 + Laplace Bridge 得到 logit 的高斯近似与 Dirichlet 代理分布，再用单侧 Beta 分位数给出认证下界。在 CIFAR-10 / ImageNet 上取得高于标准 RS 的认证精度，认证开销降低近一个数量级，并在 Jetson Orin Nano / Raspberry Pi 4 上实现最高 494× 的加速。
AI.motivation: 随机平滑（RS, Cohen et al. 2019）可为任意基分类器提供可证 ℓ2 鲁棒性，但存在两大实际瓶颈：(1) 依赖噪声增强训练（noise-augmented training）才能获得非平凡证书，抬高训练成本、损害干净精度，并削弱 RS 作为“事后（post-hoc）防御”的定位；(2) 认证需在输入空间做上万次带噪前向传播（n∈[10^4,10^5]），在算力/内存受限的边缘设备上无法有效批处理与并行化，阻碍实时认证部署。已有加速方法（ISS、ADRE、Betting CS、AS、UCAN 等）仍或依赖大量采样、或需额外训练代理模型，缺乏形式化保证且依旧绑定噪声增强训练。
AI.method: 1) 建模：将最后一层权重 W 的后验用 Laplace 近似为高斯 N(vec(W_MAP), Σ_W)，对特征提取器 φ 做一阶 Taylor 展开 φ(x+ε)≈φ(x)+J_φ(x)ε，且令 ε 与 W 独立，则 logit Z=W·φ(x+ε) 近似为高斯 N(μ_z, Σ_z)，其中 μ_z=W_MAP φ(x)，Σ_z 由 Kronecker 积形式的权重后验协方差项 + 噪声一阶传播项 + 块迹项 Tr_D 组成（Proposition 4.1）。2) Laplace Bridge：对角化高斯参数通过 F_{G→D}^† 逆映射（式(7)）闭式给出 Dirichlet 参数 α_k，从而 softmax(Z) 的 logistic-normal 分布被 Dirichlet 分布代理；预测类取 argmax_k α_k。3) 认证：在 K 维 Dirichlet 分布中抽 N 个样本，统计 top 类占比 n_A，用 Clopper–Pearson 型单侧下界 p̄_A=Beta^{-1}(η/2; n_A, N−n_A+1)，代入 Cohen 等的半径公式 R=σΦ^{-1}(p̄_A)；若 p̄_A≤0.5 则弃权（abstain）。4) 理论：证明 Dirichlet 代理的前两阶矩与 logistic-normal 匹配到 O(‖Σ_z‖_F) 与 O(‖Σ_z‖_F^{3/2})，并借助二阶 Taylor/LAN 展开给出 KL(P_π‖P_π̃) ≤ C(μ_z)‖Σ_z‖_F + O(‖Σ_z‖_F^{3/2}) 的上界（Theorem 4.2）。5) 复杂度：LBS 为 O(K+N)，RS 为 O(n·C_f+N)。
AI.result: CIFAR-10（ResNet-110，无噪声增强，σ=0.5，N=1e5，η=0.001）：LBS 在 ℓ2 半径 0/0.12/0.25/0.5/1.0 上分别达 85.4/84.4/83.4/81.1/75.2%，全面优于 RS（无噪声增强 8.4/6.2/4.8/0.8/0，噪声增强 63.4/58.4/51.8/41.4/21.8）以及 UCAN、AS、Ensemble 等基线；单样本认证 0.7 s（RS 9.8 s，ADRE 9.6 s，ISS 6.6 s，UCAN 9.4 s，AS 0.4 s 但需 4200 s 代理训练与 180–190 小时目标生成）。ImageNet（ViT-B/16）：LBS 达 67.0/64.9/62.5/58.2/46.5%，优于 RS 与 UCAN，认证时间 10.8 s vs RS 123.5 s。ℓ1 认证（CIFAR-10/ImageNet，Uniform 噪声）LBS 同样全面领先（86.1→81.0%、71.6→49.9%），而所有基线在无噪声增强时崩塌至 <15%（CIFAR-10）与 <7%（ImageNet）。边缘设备（Jetson Orin Nano / 树莓派 4，N=1e5）：ResNet110 91.8→2.8 s（33×）、SqueezeNet 33.3→1.2 s（28×）、SqueezeNet 690.9→1.4 s（494×）、ShuffleNet 240.2→0.9 s（267×）。附录显示 LBS 在 DenseNet-161、EfficientNet-B0 上表现稳定（保持模型无关性），在 ℓ∞ 威胁模型下亦稳定；在启用噪声增强训练时 LBS 认证精度反而略有下降（因 logit 分布偏离局部高斯集中区，Dirichlet 代理更保守）。
AI.conclusion: LBS 通过把 RS 的随机估计从高维输入空间迁移到低维 Dirichlet 概率空间，在保留形式化 ℓ2 认证接口（p̄_A→R=σΦ^{-1}(p̄_A)）的同时，摆脱了对噪声增强训练的依赖并大幅降低认证成本，在服务器级 GPU 与边缘设备上均实现更快、更准的认证，具备部署就绪性。作者指出当前理论分析仅在各向同性高斯噪声下成立（直接支持 ℓ2），ℓ1/ℓ∞ 借用 Yang et al. (2020) 的映射做经验评估；将理论推广到更一般噪声分布是未来工作方向。

title: The Structured Output Benchmark: A Multi-Source Benchmark for Evaluating Structured Output Quality in Large Language Models
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables, submitted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly being deployed to extract structured data from unstructured and semi-structured sources: parsing invoices, medical records, and converting PDF documents to database entries. Yet existing benchmarks for structured output generation either focus on schema compliance alone, or evaluate value correctness within a single source domain. We introduce SOB (The Structured Output Benchmark), a multi-source benchmark spanning three source modalities: native text, images, and audio conversations. All models receive a text-normalized representation of their context regardless of source modality; this deliberate design isolates structured-output capability from raw vision or speech-processing quality, ensuring a fair, source-agnostic comparison. Our benchmark comprises 5,000 text evaluation records derived from multi-hop QA drawn from a 25,091-record full corpus, 209 image records from OCR-processed PDFs across seven document types including multi-column layouts, dense tables, scanned historical documents, small-print text, and mathematical typesetting, and 115 audio records from the AMI corpus. Each record pairs a natural-language question with a JSON schema that the model must follow and a ground-truth answer verified against the source context. We evaluate 21 frontier and open-weight models across three source domains and seven metrics. Our results reveal a consistent pattern: models achieve near-perfect schema compliance, yet the best Value Accuracy, measured by exact leaf-value match, reaches only 83.0% on text, 67.2% on images, and 23.7% on audio, where longer context makes extraction substantially harder. We release the dataset, evaluation pipeline, and all related code.

AI.tldr: SOB（The Structured Output Benchmark）是一个多源结构化输出评测基准，统一考察大模型在「文本／图像／音频」三种来源下按 JSON Schema 抽取「取值正确且有据可依」的能力。作者在文本归一化的前提下，对 21 个前沿与开源权重模型用 7 项指标（主指标为叶子级精确匹配的 Value Accuracy）进行评测，结果显示：模型几乎都能输出合规 JSON（JSON Pass 普遍 >95%），但最佳 Value Accuracy 在文本仅 83.0%、图像 67.2%、音频 23.7%，且模型规模并不能预测结构化输出质量、跨模态排名显著错位。数据集、评测流水线与模型输出均已开源。
AI.motivation: 大模型已被大量用于从非结构化/半结构化来源（发票、病历、PDF）抽取结构化数据，但现有基准（JSONSchemaBench、StructEval、DeepJSONEval、LLMStructBench、ExtractBench）要么只测 schema 合规与格式遵循，要么仅在单一来源域内测值正确性，缺乏一个能在多模态下同时评估「schema 合规 + 逐字段取值接地」的统一基准。其后果被作者用一个典型例子刻画：模型输出 "occupations": ["American country music artist","composer"] 而原文仅支持 ["country music artist","composer"]，JSON 合法、类型正确，但数据是错的，且这类错误会静默地污染下游系统。同时，schema-only 评测无法反映长上下文（OCR 噪声、多说话人转写）带来的抽取难度差异，因此需要一个能区分「能生成合法 JSON」与「能生成正确 JSON」的、可复现的多源评测框架。
AI.method:
基准构建：三类来源统一映射为 record = {input:{context, question, schema}, output:{ground_truth, validated_output}}。文本源取自 HotpotQA（多跳 QA），全量语料 25,091 条，取 5,000 条作为评测集；图像源取自 olmOCR-bench（1,403 PDF → 质量过滤选 500 候选 → 保留 209 条），覆盖页眉页脚、多栏、密集表格、老旧扫描件、小字号、ArXiv 数学、扫描数学等 7 类；音频源取自 AMI 会议语料（带说话人标签与时间戳的转写），115 条。会议为 3–5 人、平均约 800 句 utterance。schema 与 ground truth 由人工撰写，Gemini 2.5 Flash 逐条交叉核查（缺失字段/类型不符/无据取值），Gemini 2.5 Pro 打分（准确性、接地性、schema 质量 0–100，任一维 <60 丢弃），并经 JSON Schema 与 Pydantic 双重校验；文本源用 5 次独立 100 条抽样估计约 3% 残余错误率，图像/音频逐条人工复核。schema 复杂度分 medium/hard（数组含对象或深度 ≥3），加权（easy 1.0 / medium 2.0 / hard 3.0）。

关键设计：所有模型一律接收文本化上下文（图像=olmOCR markdown 转写，音频=AMI 金标转写），刻意剥离视觉与 ASR 前端能力，只测结构化抽取能力；端到端原生模态评测留作未来工作。

评测：七项指标——JSON Pass Rate（解析+结构化根+jsonschema 校验的硬门控）、Value Accuracy（主指标，叶子路径精确匹配，数组索引进入路径故对顺序敏感）、Faithfulness（token 级 F1 软匹配）、Path Recall、Structure Coverage（路径集 F1）、Type Safety、Perfect Response（全对象精确匹配）。语义指标乘以 hardening 因子 h（解析、根类型、schema 合规），再乘覆盖率门：文本硬门（路径集 F1 ≥0.95 否则归零），图像/音频软门 min(1,(F1/0.9)^2)。另设 JSON Parse Success 辅助子检查，并将指标归入五个类别（长上下文抽取、复杂 schema 处理、多上下文链接、输出契约可靠性、严格精度）。推理配置：temperature 0.0，最大输出 2048 token，vLLM 部署开源模型，尽可能关闭 reasoning（GPT-5/GPT-5-Mini 与 DS-R1-Distill-32B 除外，取最低推理档）。聚合时按来源权重 W=(13054, 602, 343) 做复杂度加权平均，Overall(Raw) 为各指标均值，再乘覆盖率因子得 Overall(Adj.)。
AI.result:
1) 统一排行榜前三为 GPT-5.4（Overall 0.870，Val.Acc. 0.798）、GLM-4.7（0.861/0.804）、Qwen3.5-35B（0.861/0.801），Interfaze-Beta 0.855、Claude-Sonnet-4.6 0.854。
2) 「合法 JSON ≠ 正确 JSON」：所有 21 模型 JSON Pass 均 ≥84%（多数 >95%），但 Value Accuracy 最高仅 80.4%，两者差距稳定在 15–25 个百分点；GPT-5.4 JSON Pass 99.97% 而 Perfect Response 仅 0.486。
3) 模态梯度明显：文本最佳 Val.Acc. 0.830（GLM-4.7）、图像 0.672（Gemma-4-31B，仅为文本上限 81%）、音频 0.237（Gemini-2.5-Flash，不到三分之一）；Perfect Response 为 0.526 / 0.130 / ≤0.9%。
4) 排名跨模态不稳定：GPT-5.4 文本第 3、图像第 9；Schematron-8B 文本第 19、图像第 10；Gemma-4-31B 文本第 11、图像第 1，说明单一来源榜单会掩盖能力差异。
5) 规模不预测质量：Phi-4(14B) 文本 0.798 高于 GPT-5(0.795) 与 GPT-5-Mini(0.779)；Schematron-8B(0.754) 优于 GPT-OSS-20B(0.693)；GPT-5.4 相对 GPT-4.1/GPT-5 的 Val.Acc. 提升仅约 0.02/0.029，说明堆算力未闭合取值差距，结构化能力与传统推理/聊天基准能力基本正交。
6) 受约束解码消融（音频，3 模型）：Value Accuracy 变化仅 −0.007~+0.033，主要收益在 JSON Pass（Gemini-2.5-Flash 0.860→0.956；Gemini-3-Flash 0.773→0.869；GPT-5.4 反而 0.869→0.808），不改变核心结论。
7) 错误分类：解析失败（GPT-OSS-20B 文本 13.2%，其余多 <2%）、schema 违规（中位数 97.5%）、值错误（占比最高，17–31% 叶子值错误）、缺失路径（Path Recall 0.853–0.996）、类型不匹配（Type Safety 0.858–0.9997）。
8) 结构化幻觉更难被发现：如 audio 记录 ground truth "15 to 35 years" 被改为 "25 to 35"，或 "around 30 minutes" 被改写为 "A bit more than real time"，格式与类型均合法但数值失真。
9) 严格精确匹配会同时惩罚真实错误与忠实改写（如 "ISBN: 978-..." vs "978-..."、"December 1st" vs "First of December"），作者将其区分为（a）真实值错误与（b）格式/改写不匹配两类。
10) 评测局限：LLM 评审阈值 60/100 与硬/软覆盖率门未做敏感性分析；文本源残余约 3% 标注错误；schema 反映团队设计惯例（未来应引入 FHIR、UBL 等生产标准）；音频为金标转写故为端到端上限（Whisper 级 ASR 6–10% WER 会进一步拉低）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化输出质量无法用 schema 合规率衡量：几乎所有前沿模型都能产出合法 JSON，但 JSON 内部的字段取值正确性要困难得多，且随来源从文本（83.0%）到图像（67.2%）到音频（23.7%）急剧下降，模型的跨模态排名也随之重排。作者主张把评测重心从「格式是否合规」转向「值是否正确且有据可依」，并通过统一 schema、统一评测脚本、七项细粒度指标、复杂度加权与 hardening/coverage 门控，为社区提供可复现的多源基准，用于衡量真实生产管线所关心的东西——取值是否正确。作者同时承认自身设计取舍的代价：文本归一化剥离了视觉/ASR 能力，精确匹配惩罚语义等价与数组重排，覆盖率门与 LLM 评审阈值未消融，后续将扩展原生图像/音频端到端评测、语义感知比较（STED）、约束解码基线（Outlines、XGrammar）、视频与代码模态及动态排行榜。

title: Sample-efficient Neuro-symbolic Proximal Policy Optimization
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithms often require a large amount of data and struggle in sparse-reward domains with long planning horizons and multiple sub-goals. In this paper, we propose a neuro-symbolic extension of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) that transfers partial logical policy specifications learned in easier instances to guide learning in more challenging settings. We introduce two integrations of symbolic guidance: (i) H-PPO-Product, which biases the action distribution at sampling time, and (ii) H-PPO-SymLoss, which augments the PPO loss with a symbolic regularization term. We evaluate our methods on three benchmarks (OfficeWorld, WaterWorld, and DoorKey), showing consistently faster learning and higher return at convergence than PPO and a Reward Machine baseline, also under imperfect symbolic knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经符号扩展的PPO算法（H-PPO），通过迁移逻辑策略规格解决稀疏奖励、长时域和多子目标问题，包含两种集成方式：采样时偏置动作分布的H-PPO-Product和添加符号正则化损失的H-PPO-SymLoss。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习在稀疏奖励、长规划视界和多子目标领域面临数据需求大、学习困难的问题，需要将从简单任务中学到的知识迁移到复杂场景。
AI.method: 提出H-PPO-Product和H-PPO-SymLoss两种神经符号集成方法，分别通过采样偏置和损失增强将符号引导融入PPO框架。
AI.result: 在OfficeWorld、WaterWorld和DoorKey三个基准环境中，H-PPO方法相比标准PPO和Reward Machine基线实现了更快的学习速度和更高的收敛回报。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号引导能有效增强PPO在稀疏奖励环境中的性能，且在符号知识不完美时仍具鲁棒性。

title: Why Search When You Can Transfer? Amortized Agentic Workflow Design from Structural Priors
summary: Automated agentic workflow design currently relies on per-task iterative search, which is computationally prohibitive and fails to reuse structural knowledge across tasks. We observe that optimized workflows converge to a small family of domain-specific topologies, suggesting that this combinatorial search is largely redundant. Building on this insight, we propose SWIFT (Synthesizing Workflows via Few-shot Transfer), a framework that amortizes workflow design into reusable structural priors. SWIFT first distills compositional heuristics and output-interface contracts from contrastive analysis of prior search trajectories across source tasks. At inference time, it conditions a single LLM generation pass on these priors together with cross-task workflow demonstrations to synthesize a complete, executable workflow for an unseen target task, bypassing iterative search entirely. On five benchmarks, SWIFT outperforms the state-of-the-art search-based method while reducing marginal per-task optimization cost by three orders of magnitude. It further generalizes to four additional unseen benchmarks and transfers successfully from GPT-4o-mini to three additional foundation models (Grok, Qwen, Gemma). Controlled ablations reveal that workflow demonstrations primarily transfer topological structure rather than surface semantics: replacing all operator names with random strings still retains over 93% of the full system's average performance.

AI.tldr: SWIFT是一个通过Few-shot迁移合成工作流的框架，将工作流设计成本 amortize 到可复用的结构先验中。该方法从跨任务搜索轨迹中提取组合启发式和接口契约，推理时结合结构先验与跨任务演示通过单次LLM生成完成工作流合成。在5个基准上超越最先进搜索方法，效率提升1000倍，并成功泛化到4个新基准和3个基础模型。关键发现是工作流演示传递的是拓扑结构而非表面语义。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化智能体工作流设计依赖逐任务的迭代搜索，计算成本过高，且未能复用跨任务的结构知识。通过观察发现优化后的工作流趋向于收敛到少量领域特定的拓扑结构，表明大量搜索工作是冗余的。
AI.method: 首先从跨任务搜索轨迹的对比分析中提取组合启发式知识和输出接口契约；然后在推理时将这些结构先验与跨任务工作流演示结合，通过单次LLM生成直接合成完整可执行工作流，完全绕过迭代搜索。
AI.result: 在5个基准测试上超越最先进的基于搜索的方法，同时将每任务边际优化成本降低三个数量级；成功泛化到4个额外未见基准测试；从GPT-4o-mini向Grok、Qwen、Gemma三个基础模型成功迁移。控制实验表明工作流演示主要传递拓扑结构而非表面语义，将所有算子名称替换为随机字符串仍保留超过93%的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: SWIFT成功将工作流设计从逐任务迭代搜索转变为基于结构先验的快速合成范式，实现了三个数量级的效率提升，同时保持了优异性能，并展现出从GPT-4o-mini到其他基础模型的成功迁移能力。

title: Language corpora for the Dutch medical domain
summary: \textbf{Background:} Dutch medical corpora are scarce, limiting NLP development. \\ \textbf{Methods:} We translated English datasets, identified medical text in generic corpora, and extracted open Dutch medical resources. \\ \textbf{Results:} The resulting corpus comprises $\pm$ 35 billion tokens across the medical domain in about 100 million documents, freely available on Hugging Face. \\ \textbf{Conclusion:} This work establishes the first large-scale Dutch medical language corpus for pre-training and downstream NLP tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文创建了首个大规模荷兰语医学语料库，通过翻译英文数据集、识别通用语料库中的医学文本和提取开放荷兰语医学资源，最终构建了包含约350亿token、约1亿文档的医学领域语料库，并在Hugging Face上公开可用。
AI.motivation: 荷兰语医学语料库资源匮乏，限制了自然语言处理（NLP）在该领域的发展。
AI.method: 三种方法相结合：1）翻译英文数据集；2）在通用语料库中识别医学文本；3）提取开放的荷兰语医学资源。
AI.result: 构建了包含约350亿token、约1亿文档的荷兰语医学语料库，已在Hugging Face平台公开发布。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了首个大规模荷兰语医学语言语料库，可用于预训练和下游NLP任务。

title: DualFact+: A Multimodal Fact Verification Framework for Procedural Video Understanding
summary: We introduce DualFact, a dual-layer, multimodal factuality evaluation framework for procedural video captioning. DualFact separates factual correctness into conceptual facts, capturing abstract semantic roles (e.g., Action, Ingredient, Tool, Location), and contextual facts, capturing their grounded predicate-argument realizations in video. To support complete and role-consistent evaluation, DualFact incorporates implicit argument augmentation (VIA) and contrastive fact sets. We instantiate DualFact in two modes: DualFact-T, which verifies facts against textual evidence, and DualFact-V, which verifies facts against video-grounded visual evidence. Experiments on YouCook3-Fact and CraftBench-Fact show that state-of-the-art multimodal language models produce fluent but often factually incomplete captions, with systematic omissions and role-level inconsistencies. DualFact correlates more strongly with human factuality judgments than standard metrics, particularly for contextual facts, and reveals that caption-only evaluation overestimates hallucinations compared to video-grounded verification. Overall, DualFact offers an interpretable and human-aligned evaluation protocol that highlights persistent challenges in multimodal factual grounding, extending beyond surface-level fluency.

AI.tldr: DualFact是一个用于程序性视频描述的事实性评估框架，采用双层结构（概念事实+上下文事实）分离评估，支持文本验证和视频验证两种模式，在YouCook3-Fact和CraftBench-Fact上验证了其与人类判断的高相关性。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型生成的视频描述虽然流畅，但普遍存在事实不完整、隐性参数遗漏和角色级别不一致的问题，现有评估指标无法有效捕捉这些深层事实性缺陷。
AI.method: DualFact采用双层评估架构：(1) 概念事实层捕获抽象语义角色（动作、食材、工具、地点等）；(2) 上下文事实层捕获视频中具体实现的谓词-论元结构。通过隐式参数增强（VIA）和对比事实集实现完整且角色一致的评估。框架包含DualFact-T（文本验证）和DualFact-V（视频验证）两种模式。
AI.result: SOTA多模态语言模型生成的描述流畅但事实不完整；DualFact与人类事实性判断的相关性显著高于标准指标（尤其在上下文事实评估上）；发现纯文本评估会高估幻觉率，视频验证更准确。
AI.conclusion: DualFact提供了一个可解释且与人类判断对齐的评估协议，有效揭示了多模态事实 grounding 领域的持久挑战，证明事实性评估需超越表面流畅度，关注深层语义一致性。

title: DiRe-RAPIDS: Topology-faithful dimensionality reduction at scale
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures; GitHub repositories (https://github.com/sashakolpakov/dire-rapids) (https://github.com/igorrivin/dire-rapids-arxiv); HuggingFace dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/igriv/dire-arxiv-bge-small-embeddings)
summary: Dimensionality reduction methods such as UMAP and t-SNE are central tools for visualising high-dimensional data, but their local-neighborhood objectives can preserve sampling noise while distorting global topology. We show that standard local metrics reward this noise memorisation: top-performing embeddings invent cycles and disconnected islands absent from the data. We introduce a topology-faithfulness benchmark based on noisy manifolds with known homology, tune DiRe against it, and find Pareto-optimal configurations that match or beat GPU-accelerated UMAP on classification while recovering exact first Betti numbers on stress tests. On 723K arXiv paper embeddings, DiRe preserves 3-4 times more topological structure than UMAP at comparable wall-clock.

AI.tldr: 本文针对UMAP和t-SNE等降维方法在可视化高维数据时的局限性——局部邻域目标导致采样噪声被保留，同时扭曲全局拓扑结构。研究引入DiRe方法，在已知同调性的噪声流形上建立拓扑保真度基准测试，在保持竞争力的分类性能的同时，能准确恢复拓扑不变量（Betti数），在72.3万篇arXiv论文嵌入上，比UMAP保留3-4倍更多的拓扑结构。
AI.motivation: UMAP和t-SNE等主流降维方法虽然能揭示数据的局部结构，但存在根本性缺陷：其局部邻域优化目标会放大采样噪声，生成数据中不存在的环和断开岛屿，同时扭曲全局拓扑。这限制了它们在需要保持数据真实拓扑结构的应用中的可靠性。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于带噪声流形（已知同调性）的拓扑保真度基准测试；2) 训练DiRe方法在该基准上优化拓扑保持；3) 在大规模真实数据集（72.3万篇arXiv论文嵌入）上对比DiRe与GPU加速版UMAP的拓扑保持能力。
AI.result: DiRe在噪声流形压力测试中能精确恢复第一Betti数；在arXiv论文嵌入数据集上，以相当的运行时间保持3-4倍于UMAP的拓扑结构完整性；在分类任务上可与GPU加速UMAP相媲美或更优。
AI.conclusion: DiRe通过拓扑感知优化实现了局部邻域方法与全局拓扑保持的帕累托最优平衡，为高维数据可视化提供了拓扑更可靠的降维替代方案。

title: Dynamic Regret for Online Regression in RKHS via Discounted VAW and Subspace Approximation
summary:
We study online regression with the square loss in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space under a dynamic regret criterion. The learner is compared with a time-varying comparator sequence, and the bounds depend on its path length in the RKHS norm. The proposed method transfers the finite-dimensional discounted Vovk--Azoury--Warmuth approach of Jacobsen \& Cutkosky (2024) to the RKHS setting by means of finite-dimensional subspace approximations. For a fixed subspace, we run a VAW-based ensemble of discounted VAW forecasters over a geometric grid of discount factors. The additional approximation error is controlled by the uniform projection error of kernel sections.
  We then introduce a general orthogonal truncation method: starting from a feature expansion of the kernel, we construct the associated RKHS by introducing an inner product that makes the feature functions orthonormal, and then use the spans of the first basis functions as finite-dimensional approximation spaces. The resulting subspace reduction is applied to several approximation schemes. Explicit feature expansions yield fast-regime bounds for Gaussian and analytic dot-product kernels. Mercer truncations provide a spectral approximation method and lead to dynamic regret bounds in fast and slow regimes, depending on the eigenvalue decay. Finally, we study subspaces spanned by kernel sections and apply this construction to Matérn kernels.

AI.tldr: 研究在RKHS中基于平方损失的在线回归问题，通过有限维子空间近似和折扣VAW预测器集成方法，获得了与时变比较器路径长度相关的动态 regret 界。
AI.motivation: 在线学习中动态 regret 准则需要与时变比较器进行比较，但现有方法难以直接应用于无限维RKHS设置，需要构建可计算的近似方法。
AI.method: 采用有限维子空间近似将VAW方法从有限维空间转移到RKHS；构建折扣VAW预测器集成在几何网格上；提出基于特征展开的正交截断方法构造标准正交基。
AI.result: 针对不同核函数（高斯核、解析点积核、Matérn核）获得了依赖于RKHS路径长度的动态 regret 界；根据特征值衰减率区分快、慢 regimes；有限维子空间近似误差由核截面的一致投影误差控制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将有限维VAW预测器成功推广到无限维RKHS设置，通过正交截断和子空间近似方法，为核方法的在线学习提供了可计算的动态 regret 保证。

title: Wiki Dumps to Training Corpora: South Slavic Case
summary: This paper presents a methodology for transforming raw Wikimedia dumps into quality textual corpora for seven South Slavic languages. The work is divided into two major phases. The first involves extracting and cleaning text from raw dumps of Wikipedia, Wikisource, Wikibooks, Wikinews, and Wikiquote, where available. This step requires careful handling of raw wiki markup to isolate, first of all, textual articles, and then usable natural language text within them. The second phase addresses the challenge of suspicious or low-quality articles, which are often generated from databases or structured knowledge bases. These articles are characterised by repetitive patterns, generic phrasing, and minimal to no original content. To mitigate their impact, a n-gram-based filtering strategy was employed to detect high levels of textual redundancy between articles and then remove such articles from the corpora entirely. The resulting datasets aim to provide linguistically rich texts suitable for training language models or conducting comparative research across South Slavic languages. By combining systematic extraction with quality control, this work contributes to the creation of reliable, high-information corpora that reflect authentic language use and cultural context. While focused on the South Slavic case in the paper, the approach is mostly language-agnostic and can be generalised to other languages and language families.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种将维基媒体原始数据转换为高质量语料库的方法论，涵盖七个南斯拉夫语族语言。方法包括两个阶段：从维基百科、维基文库等来源提取和清洗文本，以及使用n-gram过滤策略移除低质量文章。最终产出是适合语言模型训练和跨语言比较研究的高质量语言资源，且该方法具有语言无关性，可推广至其他语言。
AI.motivation: 构建南斯拉夫语族语言的高质量文本语料库，以支持语言模型训练和跨语言比较研究。当前缺乏针对该语族的清洁、标准化语料资源。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：第一阶段从维基百科、维基文库、维基教科书、维基新闻和维基语录中提取文本，通过解析wiki标记获取可用的自然语言文本；第二阶段采用基于n-gram的过滤策略检测文章间的高文本冗余度，识别并移除低质量/可疑文章（如从数据库生成的内容）。
AI.result: 生成了七个南斯拉夫语族语言的高质量语料库，这些语料库具有丰富的语言特征，适合语言模型训练和 authentic 语言使用及文化背景的反映。
AI.conclusion: 该方法虽然以东南亚夫语族为重点，但本质上是语言无关的，可推广至其他语言和语系。贡献在于创建了可靠、高信息量的语料库，为NLP研究提供了重要的语言资源基础。

title: OxyGent: Making Multi-Agent Systems Modular, Observable, and Evolvable via Oxy Abstraction
comment: 10 pages, 10 figures, ACL 2026 System Demonstration track
summary: Deploying production-ready multi-agent systems (MAS) in complex industrial environments remains challenging due to limitations in scalability, observability, and autonomous evolution. We present OxyGent, an open-source framework that enables modular, observable, and evolvable MAS via a unified Oxy abstraction, in which agents, tools, LLMs, and reasoning flows are encapsulated as pluggable atomic components. This Lego-like assembly paradigm supports scalable system composition and non-intrusive monitoring. To enhance observability, OxyGent introduces permission-driven dynamic planning that replaces rigid workflows with execution graphs generated at runtime, which provide adaptive visualizations. To support continuous evolution, the framework integrates OxyBank, an AI asset management platform that supports automated data backflow, annotation, and joint evolution. Empirical evaluations and real-world case studies show that OxyGent provides a robust and scalable foundation for MAS. OxyGent is publicly available at https://oxygent.jd.com/.

AI.tldr: OxyGent是一个开源的多智能体系统框架，通过统一的Oxy抽象实现模块化、可观测和可演化的MAS，支持 Lego式组件组装、运行时动态规划和AI资产管理平台OxyBank。
AI.motivation: 在复杂工业环境中部署生产级多智能体系统(MAS)仍面临可扩展性、可观测性和自主演化能力的挑战。
AI.method: 提出OxyGent框架，基于统一Oxy抽象将智能体、工具、LLM和推理流程封装为可插拔的原子组件，实现Lego式组装范式；引入权限驱动的动态规划机制，以运行时生成的执行图替代刚性工作流；集成OxyBank AI资产管理平台支持自动化数据回流、标注和联合演化。
AI.result: 实证评估和真实案例研究表明OxyGent为多智能体系统提供了稳健且可扩展的基础。
AI.conclusion: OxyGent已公开发布(https://oxygent.jd.com/)，标志着生产级MAS框架的重要进展。

title: Null Measurability at the Symmetrization Interface in VC Learning
summary: Recent work revisiting measurability in the fundamental theorem of statistical learning imposes Borel measurability of ghost-gap suprema. We show that, at the one-sided ghost-gap interface actually used by the standard symmetrization proof, this requirement is stronger than necessary. For any Borel-parameterized concept class on a Polish domain, the bad event "there exists a hypothesis whose ghost empirical error exceeds its training empirical error by at least ε/2" is analytic. By Choquet capacitability, it is therefore measurable in the completion of every finite Borel measure. We then construct a concept class whose bad event is null-measurable but not Borel, giving a strict separation from the Borel supremum condition. Finally, we prove closure under patching, fixed and countable interpolation, and fiber-product amalgamation, showing that the weaker regularity level is stable under natural concept-class constructors. In the realizable setting, where targets belong to the class and are measurable, these results weaken the measurability hypothesis needed by the symmetrization route from finite VC dimension to PAC learnability. The main results and the descriptive-set-theoretic infrastructure used by them are formalized in Lean 4.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了统计学习中基本定理的可测性条件，证明在单侧 ghost-gap 界面下，Borel 可测性要求过强。对于 Polish 空间上的任意 Borel 参数化概念类，"存在假设的 ghost 经验误差超过训练经验误差 ε/2" 的坏事件是解析集（analytic set），因此在任意有限 Borel 测度的完备化下可测。进一步构造了一个概念类，其坏事件是零测的但非 Borel，从而严格分离了 Borel 上确界条件。最后证明了该较弱正则性条件在修补、有限/可数插值和纤维积合并下封闭，从而削弱了从 VC 维有限到 PAC 可学习性所需的可测性假设。所有结果已在 Lean 4 中形式化。
AI.motivation: 经典统计学习基本定理的 symmetrization 证明路径要求 ghost-gap 上确界的 Borel 可测性，但这一要求是否必要尚不清楚。本文旨在探究在单侧 ghost-gap 界面下该条件的必要性程度，并寻找更弱的可测性假设。
AI.method: 1. 利用 Choquet 可容性定理证明坏事件的解析性；2. 构造非 Borel 零测坏事件的反例概念类；3. 证明正则性条件在概念类构造函数下封闭；4. 所有结果在 Lean 4 中形式化验证。
AI.result: 1. 单侧 ghost-gap 界面下坏事件是解析集，在任意有限 Borel 测度完备化下可测；2. 构造了一个坏事件零测但非 Borel 的概念类，实现了对 Borel 条件的严格分离；3. 较弱正则性条件在修补、有限/可数插值和纤维积合并操作下封闭；4. 在 realizable 设定下，从 VC 维有限到 PAC 可学习性的 symmetrization 路径所需的可测性假设被削弱。
AI.conclusion: 单侧 ghost-gap 界面下的可测性要求可从 Borel 弱化至解析集（准 Borel）水平，且该弱条件在自然概念类构造下稳定。这为统计学习基本定理提供了更精细的可测性层级理解。

title: Benchmarking PyCaret AutoML Against IndoBERT Fine-Tuning for Sentiment Analysis on Indonesian IKN Twitter Data
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Presented as a benchmarking study on Indonesian sentiment analysis using PyCaret and IndoBERT
summary: This paper benchmarks a classical machine learning approach based on PyCaret AutoML against a deep learning approach based on IndoBERT fine-tuning for binary sentiment analysis of Indonesian-language Twitter comments related to Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN). The dataset contains 1,472 manually labeled samples, consisting of 780 negative and 692 positive comments. In the machine learning setting, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Machine were evaluated using 10-fold cross-validation, with Logistic Regression achieving the best performance among the classical models at 77.57% accuracy and 77.17% F1-score. In the deep learning setting, the indobenchmark/indobert-base-p1 model was fine-tuned for five epochs and achieved 89.59% test accuracy and 89.37% F1-score. The results show that IndoBERT substantially outperforms the machine learning baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of Transformer-based contextual representations for informal Indonesian social media text.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了PyCaret AutoML传统机器学习方法和IndoBERT深度学习方法在印尼语推特情感分析上的表现，1,472条样本数据集结果显示IndoBERT以89.59%准确率大幅超越逻辑回归的77.57%，证明了Transformer上下文表示对印尼社交媒体文本的有效性。
AI.motivation: 针对印尼语推特评论的情感分析任务，比较传统机器学习方法和基于Transformer的深度学习方法在处理非正式社交媒体文本上的性能表现。
AI.method: 传统机器学习使用PyCaret AutoML框架，对逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯、支持向量机进行10折交叉验证评估；深度学习使用indobenchmark/indobert-base-p1模型进行5个epoch的微调训练。
AI.result: 逻辑回归在传统机器学习方法中表现最佳，测试准确率77.57%，F1分数77.17%；IndoBERT模型达到测试准确率89.59%，F1分数89.37%，显著优于传统机器学习方法。
AI.conclusion: IndoBERT微调模型在印尼社交媒体文本情感分析任务上显著优于传统机器学习方法，准确率达到89.59%，F1分数达89.37%，展示了Transformer架构对非正式印尼语文本的有效性。

title: The Nonverbal Syntax Framework: An Evidence-Based Tiered System for Inferring Learner States from Observable Behavioral Cues
summary: Understanding learners' cognitive and affective states underpins adaptive educational systems and effective teaching. Although research links nonverbal cues to internal states, no framework calibrates them to evidence. We present the Nonverbal Syntax Framework, drawn from a systematic review of 908 studies and 17,043 cue-state mappings (Turaev et al., 2026). The framework addresses three challenges: terminological fragmentation (behaviors described inconsistently), evidence heterogeneity (single observations to replicated findings), and state ambiguity (similar patterns indicating multiple states). Normalization consolidated 5,537 state labels into 2,010 canonical states (63.7%) and 11,521 cues into 6,434 normalized cues (44.2%) across nine behavioral channels. Dual-evidence assessment separately evaluates Component Evidence (coverage of cues and states) and Relationship Evidence (independent studies per cue-state link). 52% of "Very High" relationships rest on one paper, so separation enables calibrated rather than overconfident inference from preliminary findings. The framework's four levels comprise a Cue Vocabulary of 6,434 indicators classified as observable/instrumental; State Clusters linking 2,010 states to indicative cues; State Profiles with multimodal behavioral signatures and actionable specifications; and Discriminative Analysis distinguishing 1,215 confusable state pairs. We identify 480 actionable R1-R4 relationships (three or more independent papers), the replicated core of six decades of research, covering 35.5% of mappings across 47 key learning states and 111 distinct indicators. The remaining 91.5% (9,653 single-paper findings) form exploratory hypotheses for replication. The framework gives researchers an empirical foundation for identifying gaps, practitioners evidence-based tools for state inference, and technologists validated features for multimodal detection.

AI.tldr: 非言语句法框架(Nonverbal Syntax Framework)是一项基于908项研究、17,043个线索-状态映射的系统综述，旨在将学习者的非言语线索与其认知/情感状态进行标准化校准，为适应性教育系统提供实证基础。
AI.motivation: 当前非言语线索与内部状态关联研究面临三大挑战：(1)术语碎片化——行为描述不一致；(2)证据异质性——从单一观察到重复验证的差异；(3)状态模糊性——相似模式对应多种状态。
AI.method: 系统性综述908项研究；将5,537个状态标签归一化为2,010个规范状态(63.7%)，11,521个线索归一化为6,434个标准化线索(44.2%)；双证据评估分别评价组分证据(线索和状态覆盖度)和关系证据(每个线索-状态链接的独立研究数)；框架四层结构：线索词汇表→状态簇→状态画像→判别分析。
AI.result: 识别480个可操作的R1-R4级关系(≥3篇独立研究)，覆盖47个关键学习状态和111个指标，占总映射的35.5%；91.5%(9,653个)为单篇发现待复制的探索性假设；52%"非常高"关系仅基于一篇论文。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为研究者提供识别研究空白的方法论基础，为实践者提供状态推断的循证工具，为技术开发者提供多模态检测的验证特征。

title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
summary: Harnesses have become a central determinant of coding-agent performance, shaping how models interact with repositories, tools, and execution environments. Yet automating harness engineering is hard: a heterogeneous action space, sparse and noisy evaluation signal, multi-million-token trajectories, and edits whose effect is hard to attribute to the next round's outcomes. We introduce Agentic Harness Engineering (AHE), a framework that automates harness-level evolution by instrumenting the three stages of any engineering loop (component editing, trajectory inspection, and decision making) with matched observability pillars: (1) component observability gives every editable harness component a file-level representation so the action space is explicit and revertible; (2) experience observability distills millions of raw trajectory tokens into a layered, drill-down evidence corpus that an evolving agent can actually consume; and (3) decision observability pairs every edit with a self-declared prediction, later verified against the next round's task-level outcomes. Together, these pillars turn every edit into a falsifiable contract, so harness evolution proceeds autonomously without collapsing into trial-and-error. Empirically, ten AHE iterations lift pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2 from 69.7% to 77.0%, surpassing the human-designed harness Codex-CLI (71.9%) and the self-evolving baselines ACE and TF-GRPO. The frozen harness transfers without re-evolution: on SWE-bench-verified it tops aggregate success at 12% fewer tokens than the seed, and on Terminal-Bench 2 it yields +5.1 to +10.1pp cross-family gains across three alternate model families, indicating the evolved components encode general engineering experience rather than benchmark-specific tuning. These results position observability-driven evolution as a practical pathway to keep coding-agent harnesses continually improving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AHE框架，通过组件、经验和决策三层可观测性设计，将每次编辑转化为可证伪的契约，实现测试工具的自动化演进。实验表明该方法能显著提升编码智能体性能，且具有良好的跨任务和跨模型迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 测试工具（harness）是决定编码智能体性能的核心因素，但自动化测试工具工程面临重大挑战：异构动作空间、稀疏且噪声化的评估信号、数百万token级别的轨迹、以及难以将编辑效果归因于下一轮结果的困难。这些挑战使得测试工具的自动化演进容易退化为试错法。
AI.method: 提出 Agentic Harness Engineering (AHE) 框架，通过三个可观测性支柱实现自动化：1) 组件可观测性——为每个可编辑组件提供文件级表示，使动作空间明确且可回滚；2) 经验可观测性——将数百万原始轨迹token提炼为分层可钻取的证据语料库；3) 决策可观测性——将每次编辑与自声明预测配对，后续根据任务级结果验证。
AI.result: 经过10次AHE迭代，Terminal-Bench 2的pass@1从69.7%提升至77.0%，超越人类设计的Codex-CLI（71.9%）及自演进基线ACE和TF-GRPO。冻结的测试工具可迁移：在SWE-bench-verified上以减少12% token达到更优聚合成功率；在Terminal-Bench 2上跨三个模型家族获得+5.1至+10.1pp的跨家族提升，表明演化后的组件编码了通用工程经验而非基准特定调优。
AI.conclusion: 可观测性驱动的演进（observability-driven evolution）是一种实用的方法，可持续改进编码智能体的测试工具（harness），无需人工干预即可实现自动化优化。

title: Scaling Probabilistic Transformer via Efficient Cross-Scale Hyperparameter Transfer
summary: Probabilistic Transformer (PT), a white-box probabilistic model for contextual word representation, has demonstrated substantial similarity to standard Transformers in both computational structure and downstream task performance on small models and small to medium sized datasets. However, PT is less robust to hyperparameter choices than standard Transformers, making it harder to scale efficiently. In this work, we follow Maximal Update Parametrization (muP) to rescale PT's parameters, so that hyperparameters optimized on small models can be transferred to larger models without additional tuning. With this approach, we successfully scale PT to models with up to 0.4B parameters. Experiments show that PT consistently outperforms standard transformer under the same parameter budget on Masked Language Modeling (MLM) tasks. We hope this work will contribute to the practical deployment of probabilistic models at substantially larger scales in the future.

AI.tldr: 本文将Maximal Update Parametrization (muP)方法应用于Probabilistic Transformer (PT)，成功将其扩展至4亿参数规模。实验表明，在相同参数预算下，PT在遮蔽语言建模(MLM)任务上始终优于标准Transformer。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer在扩展时存在超参数敏感性问题，难以高效扩展；而Probabilistic Transformer虽然与标准Transformer结构相似且性能相当，但在小模型上超参数选择更脆弱，限制了其规模化应用。
AI.method: 采用Maximal Update Parametrization (muP)方法对PT的参数进行重新缩放，使得在小模型上优化的超参数能够直接迁移到更大规模的模型，无需额外调参。
AI.result: 成功将PT扩展至0.4B参数规模。实验结果显示，在Masked Language Modeling (MLM)任务上，PT在相同参数预算下始终优于标准Transformer。
AI.conclusion: 通过muP方法解决了PT的超参数迁移问题，为概率模型在更大规模上的实际部署奠定了基础。

title: HotComment: A Benchmark for Evaluating Popularity of Online Comments
summary: Online comments play a crucial role in shaping public sentiment and opinion dynamics on social media. However, evaluating their popularity remains challenging, not only because it depends on linguistic quality, originality, and emotional resonance, but also because stylistic preferences vary widely across platforms and user groups, causing the same comment to resonate differently in different communities. In this work, we present HotComment, a multimodal benchmark integrating video and text modalities that comprehensively quantifies popularity from three enhanced aspects: (1) Content Quality, which evaluates semantic similarity with ground-truth human comments and extends quality assessment through four interpretable dimensions; (2) Popularity Prediction, based on trends from models trained on real-world interaction data; and (3) User Behavior Simulation, which models the distribution of platform users and approximates \textbf{engagement scores} through an agent-based framework. Furthermore, we propose StyleCmt, inspired by social ripple effects, where multiple stylistic dimensions align to amplify socially resonant expressions and suppress incongruent ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 HotComment，一个整合视频和文本模态的多模态基准测试，从内容质量、Popularity 预测和用户行为模拟三个维度全面量化在线评论 popularity，并提出 StyleCmt 模型利用社交涟漪效应进行多维度风格对齐。
AI.motivation: 在线评论的 popularity 评估面临挑战，原因包括：1) 依赖语言质量、原创性和情感共鸣；2) 风格偏好因平台和用户群体而异，导致同一评论在不同社区产生不同效果。
AI.method: 提出 StyleCmt 模型，灵感来源于社交涟漪效应，通过对齐多个风格维度来放大社交共鸣表达、抑制不协调表达。该方法在 HotComment 基准测试上验证了其有效性。
AI.result: 建立了 HotComment 多模态基准测试，从内容质量、Popularity 预测和用户行为模拟三个维度全面量化评论 popularity，并通过 StyleCmt 实现了有效的风格对齐与共鸣表达放大。
AI.conclusion: 该基准测试为评论 popularity 评估提供了全面的评估框架，并通过 StyleCmt 模型展示了如何利用社交涟漪效应进行多维度风格对齐，为跨平台评论质量评估奠定了基础。

title: Feasible-First Exploration for Constrained ML Deployment Optimization in Crash-Prone Hierarchical Search Spaces
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Chrislysen/Constrained-ML-Deployment
summary: Deploying machine learning models under production constraints requires joint optimization over model family, quantization scheme, runtime backend, and serving configuration. This induces a hierarchical mixed-variable search space in which many configurations are invalid: evaluations may crash, exceed memory limits, or violate latency constraints. Standard black-box optimizers such as Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE) and constrained Bayesian optimization are effective when valid configurations are common, but they can spend a large fraction of a small evaluation budget on invalid or uninformative trials in hostile deployment spaces. This paper studies that regime and asks whether optimization should be decomposed into an explicit exploration stage followed by model-guided exploitation. We propose Thermal Budget Annealing (TBA), a feasible-first exploration procedure that maps valid and feasible regions before warm-starting TPE. The method includes two robustness mechanisms for hostile hardware: trial timeouts that abort clearly infeasible evaluations early, and subspace blacklisting that temporarily suppresses categorical subspaces after repeated failures. We also introduce DeployBench, a benchmark suite for deployment optimization with hierarchical structure, hidden crash zones, hard constraints, and unequal evaluation costs. On synthetic benchmarks and real GPU deployment with five pre-trained vision models across five GPU targets (NVIDIA H100, A100, RTX 5080, L4, and T4), the proposed hybrid improves model-family discovery under tight constraints while reducing wasted budget relative to cold-start TPE.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器学习模型在生产环境部署时的联合优化问题，针对层次化混合变量搜索空间中大量配置无效的挑战，提出Thermal Budget Annealing (TBA)方法——一种可行优先的探索策略，在冷启动TPE前先显式探索有效区域，同时包含超时机制和子空间黑名单两种鲁棒性设计，并引入DeployBench基准测试套件进行验证。
AI.motivation: 当前黑盒优化器（如TPE和受限贝叶斯优化）在部署约束优化中面临挑战：当搜索空间中无效配置占比高时，优化器会在无效尝试上浪费大量评估预算，导致样本效率低下。
AI.method: 1) Thermal Budget Annealing (TBA)：可行优先的两阶段方法，先探索有效/可行区域，再warm-start TPE进行利用；2) 两种鲁棒性机制：试验超时（提前中止明显不可行的评估）和子空间黑名单（重复失败后暂时抑制某些分类子空间）；3) DeployBench基准测试套件：具有层次化结构、隐藏崩溃区、硬约束和不均衡评估成本。
AI.result: 在合成基准测试和真实GPU部署场景（5个预训练视觉模型×5种GPU目标）上，混合方法在严格约束下提升了模型族发现能力，同时减少了相对于冷启动TPE的资源浪费。
AI.conclusion: 分解为显式探索阶段与模型引导利用阶段的混合优化策略，能有效应对层次化部署优化中的 hostil 搜索空间，提升样本效率并避免在无效配置上浪费预算。

title: Do LLMs Capture Embodied Cognition and Cultural Variation? Cross-Linguistic Evidence from Demonstratives
summary: Do large language models (LLMs) truly acquire embodied cognition and cultural conventions from text? We introduce demonstratives, fundamental spatial expressions like "this/that" in English and "zhè/nà" in Chinese, as a novel probe for grounded knowledge. Using 6,400 responses from 320 native speakers, we establish a human baseline: English speakers reliably distinguish proximal-distal referents but struggle with perspective-taking, while Chinese speakers switch perspectives fluently but tolerate distal ambiguity. In contrast, five state-of-the-art LLMs fail to inherently understand the proximal-distal contrast and show no cultural differences, defaulting to English-centric reasoning. Our study contributes (i) a new task, based on demonstratives, as a new lens for evaluating embodied cognition and cultural conventions; (ii) empirical evidence of cross-cultural asymmetries in human interpretation; (iii) a new perspective on the egocentric-sociocentric debate, showing both orientations coexist but vary across languages; and (iv) a call to address individual variation in future model design.

AI.tldr: 本文以指示词（英语 this/that、中文 这/那）为"具身认知探针"，通过 320 名母语者（6,400 份回答）建立人类基线：英语使用者能稳定区分近指/远指但难以转换视角，中文使用者能流畅切换视角但容忍远指歧义。对 GPT-5.1、Claude 4.5 Sonnet、Gemini 2.5 Pro、DeepSeek V3.1、Qwen3-Max 五款 SOTA 模型的评测表明：模型并不真正理解近指—远指的互斥性（大量选择"All of the above"等逻辑矛盾选项），且中英文作答分布几乎一致，呈现"英语中心"的推理风格，未习得语言特定的文化-语用模式。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在各类文本任务上表现出色，但它们是否真正从文本中习得了语言背后的具身认知（身体经验、空间视角）与文化-交际惯例仍存争议。现有评测多依赖叙事性基准或准确率指标，难以触及"具身"与"文化"维度。指示词（demonstratives）作为跨语言普遍存在、编码"可及性"（accessibility）的基本空间表达，其解释同时受距离、视角与文化规约影响，且可及性在纯文本语料中极少被显式标注，因此是检验模型"接地知识"理想的小切口。同时，指示词系统究竟是"自我中心"（egocentric，基于说话者身体与个人空间）还是"社会中心"（sociocentric，基于受话者位置与共同空间）的争论长期未有定论，需要跨语言实证。本研究希望：1）验证 LLM 是否具备与人类一致的地形化（grounded）语义能力；2）考察模型是否存在语言/文化特定的发散推理模式；3）为"具身—文化"评测提供可复用的新范式。
AI.method: 任务设计：双语（英/中）四选一多项选择题，每题描述两人相对站立场景、给出说话者身份与一条日常指令（目标物以花括号标出），提问"完成后还剩下哪些物品"以迫使被试先做指称消解再判断剩余项；四个选项为：1=近指物、2=远指物、3=中间项（中性干扰）、4="All of the above"（控制项，用于探测近指/远指互斥性是否被识别）。采用 pair-to-pair 设计：同一场景系统组合近/远 × 自我/他人视角形成四题一组；5 个日常情境（eat/hide/take 等动词）考察情境与动词语义影响。指称线索分四种条件：仅指示词（基线）、仅人称代词、指示词+一致强化代词（this…of mine）、指示词+冲突代词（this…of yours）。数据规模：每语言 80 题，共 160 题（规模刻意偏小以保持受控）。人类实验：按指称线索条件拆为 4 份独立问卷（每份 20 题、随机排序），中文用 Credamo、英文用 Prolific，每份 40 人（性别均衡），共 320 名母语者、6,400 份回答，2025 年 11 月进行。分析工具：Symmetry Index（SI，Robinson et al., 1987；阈值 0.1）衡量条件对的对称性；因人类答案高度分散，不设"唯一正确答案"，改以响应分布刻画行为；对照实验验证代词的确指性作用。模型评测：5 个模型（3 闭源+2 开源），零样本+指令精修提示（"Please reply [The answer is: 1,2,3,4], and give a brief reason"），每题 10 次重复共 4,800 次推理，运行间标准差 0.02–0.08；用 Rao–Scott 校正卡方检验比较人–模分布差异，用 Jensen–Shannon 散度衡量效应量。附录另对 5 种提示策略（zero-shot、CoT、few-shot、role-play、提示精修）做 3,000 次预实验，发现提示策略无系统性优势，故采用零样本精修版以贴近人类无示例的自然作答方式。
AI.result: 人类基线：英中两语言受试者均稳健理解近—远指对立，主导作答模式为（1,3）或（2,3），二者合计占全部答案 97.13%，几乎无人（平均约 0.5%）选 4 或（1,2）这类逻辑矛盾组合。SI 揭示互补的跨语言不对称：英语母语者 Self-P vs Self-D = 0.0309、Other-P vs Other-D = 0.0254（低于阈值，近远指区分可靠），而 Self-P vs Other-P = 0.1731、Self-D vs Other-D = 0.1646（高于阈值，视角切换困难，约 2/3 采用对方视角、1/3 维持自我视角）；中文母语者 Self-P vs Other-P = 0.0131、Self-D vs Other-D = 0.0077（视角切换流畅），而 Self-P vs Self-D = 0.3472、Other-P vs Other-D = 0.3541（远指"那"解释近/远各半，容忍远指歧义）。对照实验证实代词占主导：仅代词时作答高度一致；指示词+强化代词提升指称稳定性；指示词+冲突代词时受试者一律优先服从代词，强化与冲突两条件分布近乎相反；加入代词后中文使用者可克服远指歧义并跨视角稳定，英语使用者仍是自我视角可靠、他人视角多变。模型结果：五个模型均显著偏离人类分布（Rao–Scott 卡方多数 p<.05，JS 散度均值 0.30–0.66），仅"自我视角近指"条件与人类较接近且 p 值偏高、JS 偏低。具体表现为模型不承认近指与远指互斥，Gemini-2.5-pro 在英语下选 4 的比例为 36–56%、中文达 60%，DeepSeek-V3.1 高达 44–68%，且倾向于选择（1,2）等逻辑不一致组合；这被解释为模型未把握任务针对指示词对比，转而模仿通用"猜谜/保守作答"策略。跨语言方面，模型中英文分布近乎一致（Gemini 四条件关键选项差异仅 0%–6%），整体模式（自我视角好、他人视角差）更贴近英语使用习惯，说明即便用中文作答，模型仍倾向采用英语中心的推理方式。附录预实验显示提示策略（few-shot、role-play、CoT 等）对结果无稳定影响。
AI.conclusion: 贡献四点：(i) 提出以指示词指称消解作为评估 LLM 具身认知与文化规约的新任务范式；(ii) 提供 320 人/6,400 回答的跨文化不对称实证；(iii) 为"自我中心 vs 社会中心"之争提供新视角——两种取向共存，但优势取向随语言而变（英语偏自我中心、强调近远指精确对比，中文偏社会中心、强调视角切换与语境弹性），并可用 Hall 的高低语境文化理论解释；(iv) 提出把"个体差异"作为新挑战——人类对指示词的解释高度多样（远指近/远各半等），而模型被训练为收敛到单一"专家答案"，需发展个体化、具身化、文化敏感的模型。核心结论：现有 LLM 对指示词的理解停留在表层作答策略模仿层面，未真正把握近指—远指的互斥性，也未内化语言特定的文化-语用倾向。局限：纯文本输入无法覆盖真实指示词使用所依赖的多模态与空间感知（未来需结合图像、音频与 3D 仿真）；数据集规模偏小，限制统计功效与语境多样性；跨语言覆盖仅英中，尚未纳入西班牙语等三元对立系统。

title: Think Before You Act -- A Neurocognitive Governance Model for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: The rapid deployment of autonomous AI agents across enterprise, healthcare, and safety-critical environments has created a fundamental governance gap. Existing approaches, runtime guardrails, training-time alignment, and post-hoc auditing treat governance as an external constraint rather than an internalized behavioral principle, leaving agents vulnerable to unsafe and irreversible actions. We address this gap by drawing on how humans self-govern naturally: before acting, humans engage deliberate cognitive processes grounded in executive function, inhibitory control, and internalized organizational rules to evaluate whether an intended action is permissible, requires modification, or demands escalation. This paper proposes a neurocognitive governance framework that formally maps this human self-governance process to LLM-driven agent reasoning, establishing a structural parallel between the human brain and the large language model as the cognitive core of an agent. We formalize a Pre-Action Governance Reasoning Loop (PAGRL) in which agents consult a four-layer governance rule set: global, workflow-specific, agent-specific, and situational before every consequential action, mirroring how human organizations structure compliance hierarchies across enterprise, department, and role levels. Implemented on a production-grade retail supply chain workflow, the framework achieves 95% compliance accuracy and zero false escalations to human oversight, demonstrating that embedding governance into agent reasoning produces more consistent, explainable, and auditable compliance than external enforcement. This work offers a principled foundation for autonomous AI agents that govern themselves the way humans do: not because rules are imposed upon them, but because deliberation is embedded in how they think.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「神经认知治理框架」：将人类"行动前先思考"的自我治理机制（双加工理论、执行功能、组织合规心理）形式化映射到 LLM 智能体推理中，核心是行动前治理推理回路（PAGRL）与四层级联治理架构（全局/工作流/智能体/情境）。在 Flowr 零售供应链多智能体工作流上取得 95% 合规决策准确率（38/40）、19/19 升级零误报、平均延迟开销 0.65 秒，全部推理轨迹完整可审计。
AI.motivation: 自主 AI 智能体在企业、医疗与安全关键场景快速落地，但现有治理手段（训练时对齐如 RLHF/Constitutional AI、运行时护栏如 AgentSpec/Policy-as-Prompt、事后审计如 OPA 策略引擎）均将治理视为施加于智能体之外的外部约束，而非内化的行为原则，导致不安全、不可逆动作仍可能发生，且外部过滤无法泛化到规则未覆盖的新情境。作者主张：组织心理学表明"内化式合规"比"外部强制式合规"更稳固、更具泛化性，而人类最强的治理形式恰是行动前对内化规则的审议。因此需要一个把治理嵌入智能体"如何思考"本身的架构性方案。
AI.method: 1) 理论映射：建立人脑与 LLM 的结构对应表（大脑↔LLM、指令↔提示词、组织规则集↔治理规则集、System 2↔行动前推理回路、抑制控制↔合规检查、工作记忆↔上下文窗口、认知灵活性↔上下文感知规则选择、向上级汇报↔human-in-the-loop 触发、审计记忆↔推理轨迹日志）；并论证 LLM 具备自然语言规则理解、规范性推理能力、上下文敏感规则应用与透明审议四项独特属性，同时坦诚指出类比边界（随机性、无持久内化、易受提示注入与对抗框架操纵）。2) 机制形式化：PAGRL 四阶段——意图形成、规则检索、可容许性推理（输出结构化自然语言推理轨迹）、合规决策，三种出口为 Proceed / Self-Correct / Escalate；升级触发三条件为规则绝对禁止、动作不可逆、真实不确定性。3) 架构：四层级联规则（全局→工作流→智能体→情境），规则向下级联、层间冲突高层优先；规则设计三原则（说理而非仅限制、尽可能正向表述、具体性优于泛化）。4) 实现：基于 OpenAI Agents SDK + Claude Code + Model Context Protocol，含 MCP 治理服务器（四层版本化 JSON 规则库、情境规则激活谓词、仅追加推理轨迹日志）、治理提示构造器（每次调用前检索并注入适用规则）与注入每个系统提示的 PAGRL 强制块。5) 评测：Flowr 供应链四智能体（需求预测、采购、供应商协调、库存补货）配 7 条四层规则（R1–R7）与四个场景，每场景 10 次重复（变化输入措辞），统计合规准确率、升级精确率、轨迹质量与延迟开销，并与相关工作做七维度对比。
AI.result: 40 次评测中合规决策准确率 95%（38/40），两次错误均出现在 S2、S3 的歧义措辞边缘情形——规则检索与轨迹均正确，但最终判定被"合理化"，作者类比为 Bandura 的道德脱离（moral disengagement）。升级精确率 100%（19/19，无误升级），全部 40 次推理轨迹完整且结构正确，平均延迟 +0.65 秒/动作。定性结果包括：情境层 R7 在供应中断时正确强制升级替代供应商决策；对抗性构造输入下智能体将联系未验证供应商的意图自我纠正为最近的可信供应商，体现了对规则意图的规范性泛化。
AI.conclusion: 结论：把治理作为智能体推理的内化审议过程（"governance by design" 而非 "governance by audit"）可获得比外部强制更一致、可解释、可审计且更能泛化的合规行为；PAGRL 与四层级联架构与架构无关，可应用于单智能体、多智能体分解及混合编排；四层结构与 EU AI Act 的分级风险要求、NIST AI RMF 自然对应。局限：LLM 随机性使治理结果为概率性而非确定性（需叠加确定性执行层）；规则每次从上下文重新注入、无持久记忆；无专用防篡改层，提示注入下可能合理化违规；评测仅限单一零售供应链域、40 次运行、单一实现栈，跨域跨模型泛化性待验证。后续方向：基于轨迹的自适应规则演化、多智能体间规则冲突的协商与裁决（可借社会选择理论与组织升级模型）、系统性对抗鲁棒性评测、与 EU AI Act/NIST AI RMF 的显式映射，以及规模化多域多厂商实证验证。

title: Zero Shot Coordination for Sparse Reward Tasks with Diverse Reward Shapings
summary: Many Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) agents fail to adapt properly to cooperating with agents trained with the same objectives but different seeds, algorithms, or other training differences. This is the problem of Zero-Shot Coordination (ZSC), which focuses on training agents to cooperate well with unknown agents. ZSC has been studied for a variety of tabular cases and simple games such as Hanabi, achieving excellent results. However, existing solutions to ZSC only consider identical rewards for your trained agents and all future partners. This is not realistic for the trained agents, as they do not consider the problem of cooperating with agents that have identical sparse objectives but shape the rewards for those objectives in different manner. To address this issue, we show how to train an ensemble of methods using randomized reward shapings chosen using 4 selection algorithms. Experiments done on the Overcooked environment demonstrate consistent improvements of 62.2%-119.2% in sparse reward over baseline ZSC algorithms when playing with agents that have identical sparse rewards but different reward shapings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体强化学习中的零样本协同（ZSC）问题，核心挑战是训练智能体与使用不同奖励塑形但共享相同稀疏目标的未知智能体有效合作。提出基于4种选择算法的随机奖励塑形集成训练方法，在Overcooked环境中相比基线ZSC算法实现62.2%-119.2%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有ZSC研究假设合作智能体具有完全相同的奖励函数，但实际场景中不同训练过程可能产生相同稀疏目标但不同奖励塑形的智能体。当前方法在此异构奖励场景下表现不佳，需要新的训练范式来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出采用随机奖励塑形（randomized reward shaping）训练集成方法，使用4种选择算法（论文未详述具体算法名称）从多个候选奖励塑形策略中进行采样和组合，以增强智能体对不同奖励表达形式的鲁棒性和适应性。
AI.result: 在Overcooked环境中，当合作伙伴具有相同稀疏奖励但不同奖励塑形时，所提方法相比基线ZSC算法在稀疏奖励指标上实现62.2%-119.2%的一致性改进。
AI.conclusion: 随机奖励塑形集成训练能有效提升MARL智能体在异构奖励条件下的零样本协同能力，为构建更具鲁棒性和泛化性的合作智能体提供了新的训练思路。

title: One Refiner to Unlock Them All: Inference-Time Reasoning Elicitation via Reinforcement Query Refinement
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often fail to utilize their latent reasoning capabilities due to a distributional mismatch between ambiguous human inquiries and the structured logic required for machine activation. Existing alignment methods either incur prohibitive $O(N)$ costs by fine-tuning each model individually or rely on static prompts that fail to resolve query-level structural complexity. In this paper, we propose ReQueR (\textbf{Re}inforcement \textbf{Que}ry \textbf{R}efinement), a modular framework that treats reasoning elicitation as an inference-time alignment task. We train a specialized Refiner policy via Reinforcement Learning to rewrite raw queries into explicit logical decompositions, treating frozen LLMs as the environment. Rooted in the classical Zone of Proximal Development from educational psychology, we introduce the Adaptive Solver Hierarchy, a curriculum mechanism that stabilizes training by dynamically aligning environmental difficulty with the Refiner's evolving competence. ReQueR yields consistent absolute gains of 1.7\%--7.2\% across diverse architectures and benchmarks, outperforming strong baselines by 2.1\% on average. Crucially, it provides a promising paradigm for one-to-many inference-time reasoning elicitation, enabling a single Refiner trained on a small set of models to effectively unlock reasoning in diverse unseen models. Code is available at https://github.com/newera-xiao/ReQueR.

AI.tldr: ReQueR提出将推理能力激发作为推理时对齐任务，通过强化学习训练专用Refiner策略将模糊查询重写为显式逻辑分解，并引入基于"最近发展区"理论的Adaptive Solver Hierarchy课程机制实现稳定训练，实现跨模型架构的推理能力提升。
AI.motivation: LLM因查询分布与机器所需结构化逻辑之间的不匹配而无法充分利用潜在推理能力；现有对齐方法存在O(N)微调成本高或静态提示无法解决查询级结构复杂性等问题。
AI.method: 提出ReQueR框架，核心包括：(1)将推理激发建模为推理时对齐任务；(2)训练Refiner策略将原始查询重写为显式逻辑分解；(3)冻结LLM作为环境；(4)基于Zone of Proximal Development理论设计Adaptive Solver Hierarchy课程机制，动态调整环境难度以匹配Refiner能力增长。
AI.result: 在多种架构和基准测试上获得1.7%-7.2%的绝对提升，平均优于强基线2.1%；一个Refiner可跨多个未见模型泛化推理激发能力。
AI.conclusion: ReQueR为"一对多"推理时推理激发提供了可行范式，单个Refiner在小型模型集上训练后即可有效解锁多样化未见模型的推理能力，具有良好可扩展性。

title: RADD: Retrieval-Augmented Discrete Diffusion for Multi-Modal Knowledge Graph Completion
summary: Most multi-modal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC) models use one embedding scorer to do both retrieval over the full entity set and final decision making. We argue that this coupling is a core bottleneck: global high-recall search and local fine-grained disambiguation require different inductive biases. Therefore, we propose a Retrieval-Augmented Discrete Diffusion (RADD) framework to decouple retrieve and reranking for MMKGC. A relation-aware multimodal KGE retriever serves as both global retriever and distillation teacher, while a conditional discrete denoiser performs shortlist-level entity-identity generation for reranking. Training combines KGE supervision, denoising cross-entropy, and temperature-scaled distillation from the retriever to the denoiser. At inference, the designed Diff-Rerank first forms a top-$K$ shortlist with the retriever and then reranks it with the denoiser, ensuring that recall is a strict prerequisite for precision. Experiments on three MMKGC benchmarks show that RADD achieves the best performance and consistent gains over strong unimodal, multimodal, and LLM-based baselines, while ablations further verify the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出RADD框架，通过关系感知检索器与条件离散去噪器的协同设计解耦MMKGC中的检索与重排序任务，在三个基准数据集上实现最优性能。
AI.motivation: 指出当前多模态知识图谱补全(MMKGC)模型存在核心瓶颈：将全局高召回搜索与局部细粒度消歧统一用一个嵌入评分器处理，但这两种任务需要不同的归纳偏置，因此耦合设计限制了模型性能。
AI.method: 提出Retrieval-Augmented Discrete Diffusion (RADD)框架，包含两个核心组件：1）关系感知的 multimodal KGE检索器，同时充当全局检索器和蒸馏教师；2）条件离散去噪器，执行短列表级别的实体身份生成用于重排序。训练阶段结合KGE监督、去噪交叉熵以及从检索器到去噪器的温度缩放蒸馏损失。推理阶段采用Diff-Rerank策略：先用检索器形成top-K短列表，再用去噪器重排序。
AI.result: 在三个MMKGC基准数据集上达到最优性能，相比强单模态、多模态及基于LLM的基线模型均获得一致的性能提升，各组件消融实验验证了其贡献。
AI.conclusion: RADD框架通过解耦检索与重排序，有效解决了MMKGC中全局召回与局部消歧的矛盾。实验验证了该框架在三个基准数据集上均达到最优性能，证明检索器-去噪器协同设计能够确保"召回优先于精确"的推理逻辑，各组件的消融实验进一步确认了每个模块的独立贡献。

title: Knowledge Distillation Must Account for What It Loses
summary: This position paper argues that knowledge distillation must account for what it loses: student models should be judged not only by retained task scores, but by whether they preserve the teacher capabilities that make those scores reliable. This matters because distillation is increasingly used to turn large, often frontier models into deployable systems, yet headline metrics can hide losses in uncertainty, boundary behavior, process reliability, on-policy stability, grounding, privacy, safety, and diversity. We identify the retention assumption behind current evaluation and reframe distillation as a lossy projection of teacher behavior rather than a faithful copy. We then synthesize existing evidence into a taxonomy of off-metric distillation losses, showing that these losses are concrete, recurring, and measurable. To make the position actionable, we propose scenario-specific preservation targets and a Distillation Loss Statement that reports what was preserved, what was lost, and why the remaining losses are acceptable. The goal is not lossless distillation, but accountable distillation.
